hero.sub: Contrôleur ya découverte & vérification pona réseau ya Vortex peer-to-peer. Kofungola. Ezali na chiffrement. Ekoki kopekisa te.

network.label: NETWORK .
network.body: Moninga nyonso azali na identité oyo etiamaki sinyatili. Ba clients ba vérifier avant ba connecter, ba noeuds ba prouver propriété na enregistrement. Autorité centrale moko te ekoki ko fausser oyo cryptographie esi e confirmer.
network.stat_nodes_k: REGISTERED NODES Ezali ndenge moko na .
network.stat_online_k: ONLINE NOW Ezali ndenge moko na .
network.stat_dual_k: DUAL VERIFIED Ezali ndenge moko na .
network.stat_uptime_k: UPTIME SLA Ezali ndenge moko na .
network.dual_body: Enregistré na contrôleur AND ekangami na chaîne via Solana. Ba témoins indépendants mibale ba confirmer code hash na pubkey. Safe mpo na ba sessions sensibles.
network.ctrl_body: Signature e prouver que node ezali propriétaire ya clé privée na yango, mais intégrité ya code ezali ancré na chaîne te. Fine mpo na ba sessions mingi; risque = kozala na confiance na opérateur ya contrôleur.
network.unverif_body: Eyebani na config to na gossip. Preuve cryptographique moko te nanu. Salelá kaka mpo na kosala bootstrap ya liste ya baninga — jamais lokola cible ya handoff mpo na ba sessions en direct.

security.label: SECURITY .
security.body: Ba clés minei ya Ed25519 indépendants, moko na moko na mosala moko ya moke. Kosala boyokani na fungola moko nyonso ebukaka basusu te.
security.th_verified: VERIFIED BY Ezali ndenge moko na .
security.release_verified: Ba clients — ba pinné na tango ya kotonga
security.controller_verified: Ba clients — kobanda SNS to kotonga pin
security.user_signs: Ba jetons ya session, ba enveloppes ya message
security.step1_d: Tanga vortexx.sol na monyololo. Ba dossiers signé na portefeuille Solana — impossible ya DNS-ko détourner.
security.step2_d: Client abengi /v1/integrity. Aboyi eyano nyonso longola se status: verified uta na fungola ya kobimisa oyo ekangami.
security.step3_d: Libenga nyonso ya API ezongisaka {payload, sig, signed_by}. Client azali ko vérifier signature ya Ed25519 avant ya ko confier.
security.step4_d: Noeuds scellés : client atangi code_hash na registre ya Solana. Divergence na contrôleur = libela na liste noire.
security.check_auth: Authenticité ya réponse — impossible ya ko forger /v1/nodes sans clé privée ya contrôleur.
security.check_integrity: Intégrité ya code — ba fichiers ya contrôleur hashed mpe croisé na démarrage nionso. Tampering ezongisaka 503 avant trafic nionso e servir.
security.check_identity: Identité ya node — ba noeuds esengeli ko signer enregistrement na clé na yango moko. Mobundi akoki te kokomisa nkombo na kombo ya pubkey ya node mosusu.
security.check_dns: DNS protection ya détournement — .sol ezo enregistrer en direct na Solana. Monguna asengeli kosala compromis na portefeuille, kaka te DNS enregistreur.
security.check_handoff: Bobateli ya bopesi — ba transferts ya session ememaka ba jetons signé na Ed25519 na anti-replay, valide kaka 5 minutes. Target eboyi ba sources oyo eyebani te.
security.check_transport: Bomoto ya transport — boyokani URL emonanaka na ISP / Cloudflare na yo. Salelá talatala ya Tor soki ba métadonnées ezali na ntina.
security.check_content: Contenu ya message — NOT esimbami na contrôleur. Nsuka na nsuka chiffré kati na basaleli. Contrôleur akoki kotanga eloko te ata soki azali entièrement compromis.
security.check_host: Host OS / noyau — soki VPS ezali na misisa, bafungola ekoki koyiba. Salelá signature oyo esimbami na matériel mpo na ba déploiements paranoïaques.

access.label: ACCESS .
access.heading_line1: Ntango nyonso oyo moto akoki kozwama.
access.body: Ba points d’entrée ebele elakisi que entité moko te ekoki ko bloquer accès na yo. Ba sites ya miroir esalelaka ba contenus signés ndenge moko na ba infrastructures indépendantes.
access.tunnel_body: Addresse ya ofele *.trycloudflare.com. Compte moko te esengeli. URL ebongwanaka tango tunnel ebandi lisusu — traité lokola éphémère.
access.tor_body: .addresse ya matungulu, oyo ekoki kozwama kaka na nzela ya Tor. Censor-proof mpe métadonnées-privé, kasi malembe. Esengeli na client ya Tor.
access.ipfs_body: Kopi oyo ezali na adresse ya contenus ya frontend statique. Porte nionso ya IPFS ekoki ko servir yango — serveur moko te ya ko bloquer.
access.direct_body: Domaine ya mbala na mbala + TLS. Option ya mbangu koleka. Blockable na niveau DNS/IP — kokweya lisusu na basusu soki censure.
access.mirrors_body: Ba hôtes alternatifs oyo ezali ko servir exactement contenus signé ndenge moko na contrôleur oyo. Talatala moko na moko e sondelaka mbala na mbala — point vert elakisi ekoki kozuama na kati ya 5 minutes ya suka. Ba miroirs ya Tor .onion ekoki ko vérifier santé te sans proxy ya Tor local.

start.label: GET STARTED Ezali ndenge moko na .
start.step1: Tia Vortex na appareil na yo — mobile to bureau.
start.step2: Pona mode réseau Global na assistent ya configuration.
start.step3: Coller contrôleur URL (auto-résolus via SNS) to entrée nionso URL na page ya Entrées.
start.step4: Verifier pubkey na app na yo ekokani na empreinte ya misapi ya contrôleur oyo ezali awa na se. Kozanga boyokani elimboli kobongola makambo.
start.step5: Ozali na boyokani. Liste ya ba noeuds, ba signature, na routage esimbami automatiquement.
start.fingerprint_label: CONTROLLER FINGERPRINT Ezali ndenge moko na .
start.fingerprint_note: Pin clé oyo na client na yo avant ya ko confier réponse nionso.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS .
treasury.transparency_body: Ba frais nionso ya protocole — ba frais ya registre ya noeuds mpe 20% ya coupe ya ba abonnés primes — ekotaka na portefeuille ya trésor na Solana. Transaction nionso ezali vérifiable na public na mutu nionso.
treasury.rewards_body: 70% ya sub premium moko na moko ekendaka na pool ya ba recompenses, distribué pro-rata na ba opérateurs ya noeuds actifs. 20% epesaka misolo ya développement ya moboko. 10% eziki to efandi lokola assurance.

gravitixDocs.title: Gravitix Référence ya monoko
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Langue ya scripting ya performance ya likolo pona kotonga ba bots. 96 makambo oyo ezali na kati. Rouille ya sima ya sima.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix ezali monoko ya domaine spécifique (DSL) oyo esalemi kobanda na nse mpo na kokoma ba bots ya Vortex. Epayi wapi minoko misusu esengaka ba bibliothèques, ba callbacks, mpe boilerplate, Gravitix epesi yo ba handlers ya événement ya classe ya liboso, ba flux ya masolo, mpe état intégré — nionso wana na syntaxe ya peto, ya kotangama oyo e inspiré na Rust.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Kotangama — code etangamaka lokola mokano, kasi masini te
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Safe — ba types statiques ezuaka ba erreurs avant temps d'exécution
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Expressive — ba flux, ba gardes, na matching ya modèle ezali intégré
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Minimal — ba classes te, héritage te, ba cadres ya koyekola te
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix ezali mpo na moto nyonso oyo alingi kotonga bot ya Vortex noki — ezala okoma naino code te liboso, to ozali développeur ya expérience oyo alembi na boilerplate ya Python. Référence oyo eteyaka Gravitix à partir ya ba principes ya liboso : expérience préalable esengeli te.
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Eteni mokomoko etongami likoló na oyo ya liboso. Soki ozali ya sika na programɛ, tángá banda likoló tii na nse. Soki oyebi deja monɔkɔ mosusu, salelá tableau de contenus mpo na kopumbwa mbala moko na makambo oyo esepelisi yo.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Nzela ya mbangu koleka kobanda na zéro kino na bot oyo ezali kotambola.
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: on /start { ... } — elimboli mosali oyo etambolaka tango mosaleli atindi /start. emit "..." — etindi nsango lisusu na mosaleli. {ctx.first_name} — ekɔtisaka nkombo ya liboso ya mosaleli na kati ya molongo.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Na IDE ya Gravitix, finá na bouton Run na barre ya likolo. Tyá Vortex Bot Token na yo ntango bakosɛnga yo. Bot ebandi mbala moko — etape ya kotonga esengeli te.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Programme nionso ya Gravitix etongami na ba blocs de construction misato ya base : ba handlers, ba déclarations ya émet, na logique.
gravitixDocs.anatomyOfHandler: Anatomie ya moto oyo azali kosimba yango
gravitixDocs.multipleEmits: Ba émets ebele = ba messages ebele
gravitixDocs.multipleHandlers: Ba handlers ebele pona déclencheur moko
gravitixDocs.explicitTypes: Ba annotations ya type ya polele
gravitixDocs.updatingVariables: Kosala mise à jour ya ba variables
gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Valeur nionso na Gravitix ezalaka na type. Système ya type ezali statique : ba types e vérifier na temps ya compilation, avant bot na yo ekende.
gravitixDocs.operatorsDesc: Ba opérateurs basangisaka ba valeurs pona kobimisa ba valeurs ya sika.
gravitixDocs.stringsDesc: Ba chaînes na Gravitix ezali texte encodé UTF-8. Ba soutenir interpolation riche na suite ya ba opérations intégrées.
gravitixDocs.stringOperations: Ba opérations ya molongo na nzela ya ba intégrés
gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Pattern-match motuya moko na ba modèles ebele. Kanisa yango lokola maloba ya switch ya nguya.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: Ba fonctions ezali ba blocs ya code oyo ekoki kosalelama lisusu. Basalisaka yo oboya kozongela makambo mpe kosala ete code ezala mpasi te mpo na kokanga ntina na yango.
gravitixDocs.eventHandlersDesc: Ba handlers bazali motema ya bot moko ya Gravitix. Mosali moko na moko ayokaka lolenge moko ya likambo ya sikisiki mpe atambolaka ntango likambo yango esalemi.
gravitixDocs.guardDesc: Ba gardes ba permettre yo obakisa condition na handler. Moto oyo azali kosimba yango azali kopota mbangu kaka soki mokɛngɛli azali kotalela solo.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: Objet ctx ezali automatiquement disponible na kati ya handler nionso. Ezali na makambo oyo etali nsango oyo ezali lelo mpe mosaleli oyo atindaki yango.
gravitixDocs.stateDesc: State e permettre bot na yo e rappeler makambu entre ba messages. Sans état, message nionso eza indépendant et bot eza na mémoire te.
gravitixDocs.flowsDesc: Ba flux e permettre yo okoma masolo ya ba étapes ebele na style linéaire, oyo ekoki kotangama. Flux ekoki ko pause mpe kozela message oyo elandi ya usager.
gravitixDocs.validationInFlow: Validation na kati ya flux moko
gravitixDocs.emitDesc: Kotinda ba messages ezali sortie ya liboso ya bot.
gravitixDocs.emitTo: emit_to — tinda na mosaleli moko ya sikisiki
gravitixDocs.schedulingDesc: Tambwisa code automatiquement na programme — misala ya cron te, ba services ya libanda esengeli te.
gravitixDocs.atSpecificTime: na — kopota mbangu na ngonga moko ya sikisiki ya mokolo
gravitixDocs.pipeDesc: Opérateur ya pipe |> alekisaka valeur lokola argument ya liboso na fonction oyo elandi. Ezali kosala ete misala ya kokanga na minyɔlɔlɔ ezala likoki ya kotángama, na lobɔkɔ ya mwasi tii na lobɔkɔ ya mobali.
gravitixDocs.errorDesc: Gravitix epesaka traitement ya erreur structuré na ba blocs ya try / catch / finally.
gravitixDocs.structsDesc: Structs e permettre yo o grouper ba données oyo etali yango na se ya type oyo ezali na kombo. Enums e définir ensemble fermé ya ba variantes.
gravitixDocs.mathDesc: Gravitix etindi bibliothèque ya mathématiques ya mobimba na ~180 fonctions.
gravitixDocs.complexDesc: Gravitix ezali na type complexe natif — paire ya ba flotteurs ya 64 bits oyo ezali ko représenter ba parties ya solo mpe ya imaginaire.
gravitixDocs.calculusDesc: Gravitix ezali na calcul numérique : ba dérivés na ba integrales calculés na ba fonctions arbitraires.
gravitixDocs.linearAlgebraDesc: Algèbre linéaire ezali matematiki ya ba vecteurs na ba matrices.
gravitixDocs.numberTheoryDesc: Théorie ya nombre eyekolaka ba propriétés ya ba nombres entiers. Fondation ya cryptographie ya mikolo oyo.
gravitixDocs.statisticsDesc: Statistique epesaka bisaleli mpo na kolimbola, kotalela, mpe kozwa bosukisi na ba données.
gravitixDocs.specialDesc: Ba fonctions spéciales ezali ba solutions ya ba équations différentielles ya ntina.
gravitixDocs.fftDesc: Transformation ya Fourier e décomposer signal moko na ba fréquences constituantes na yango.
gravitixDocs.listMethods: Liste ya ba méthodes (notation ya ba points) .
gravitixDocs.mapMethods: Méthodes ya carte (notation ya ba points) .
gravitixDocs.bp1: Simbá ntango nyonso makambo oyo eyebani te
gravitixDocs.bp3: Salelá bakɛngɛli na esika ya soki-minyololo mpo na ndingisa
gravitixDocs.bp5: Salelá bozongi liboso mpo na kokitisa kosala zumbu
gravitixDocs.bp8: Salelá état mpo na kopekisa ba spam
gravitixDocs.keepLearningDesc: Lolenge malamu ya koyekola Gravitix ezali kotonga. Bandá na bot ya écho simple, na nsima bakisa état, na nsima bakisa ba flux. Likanisi mokomoko ya sika oyo oyekolaka efungolaka makambo mingi oyo okoki kosala.

error.h3: Kobwaka mabunga na ndenge ya polele
error.p1: Envelopper code nionso oyo ekoki ko échouer na bloc try. Soki libunga ezali thrown — ezala na Gravitix tango ya kosala to na ndenge ya polele na code na yo — exécution epumbwaka na bloc catch. Valeur oyo ekangami ekangami na variable oyo opesi kombo ya catch.
error.p2: finally etambolaka sans condition — soki try alongaki to catch asimbaki libunga. Salelá yango mpo na kobimisa biloko, kosala journal, to kotinda nsango ya kosilisa.
error.p3: Salelá botangi ya mabunga mpo na misala oyo etali bokotisi ya libanda : kososola makomi ya mosaleli, kobenga ba API, kotanga ba variables ya environnement, to kosala matematiki ya mindondo esika mabunga ya domaine (sqrt ya négatif, journal ya zéro) ekoki kosalema. Pona ba erreurs ya logique interne, préférer ba clauses guard na ba returns ya liboso.

intro.li2: Safe — mitindo ya statique catch mabunga liboso ya tango ya kosala
intro.li3: Expressive — flows, guards, mpe motindo matching etongami na kati

intro.p1: Gravitix ezali monoko ya domaine spécifique (DSL) oyo esalemi banda na nse mpo na kokoma ba bots Vortex. Epayi wapi minoko misusu esengaka ba bibliothèques, ba callbacks, mpe boilerplate, Gravitix epesi yo ba handlers ya événement ya classe ya liboso, ba flows ya masolo, mpe state oyo etongami na kati — nionso wana na syntaxe ya peto, oyo ekoki kotangama oyo epemamaki na Rust.
intro.p2: Gravitix ezali mpo na moto nyonso oyo alingi kotonga bot Vortex noki — ezala okoma naino te code liboso, to ozali développeur ya expérience oyo alembi Python boilerplate. Référence oyo eteyaka Gravitix uta na ba principes ya liboso : expérience ya liboso esengeli te.
intro.p3: Eteni mokomoko etongami likoló na oyo ya liboso. Soki ozali ya sika na programɛ, tángá banda likoló tii na nse. Soki oyebi deja monɔkɔ mosusu, salelá tableau de contenus mpo na kopumbwa mbala moko na makambo oyo esepelisi yo.
intro.p4: Na référence oyo mobimba, → elakisi "evaluer na" to "abimisaka", mpe // ... elakisi ba commentaires oyo compilateur azali ko ignorer.

math_special.p1: Fonction Gamma Γ(n) ezali généralisation continue ya factorial : Γ(n) = (n−1)! mpo na mituya mobimba ya malamu. Ezali kopanzana na mituya factoriel kino na mituya ya solo mpe ya mindondo.
math_special.p2: Fonction ya erreur erf(x) = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(−t2)dt ezali integral ya Gaussien. Ezali na boyokani directement na CDF normal mpe emonanaka na ba équations ya chaleur mpe na théorie ya probabilité.
math_special.p3: ζ(s) = Σ 1/nˢ mpo na n=1,2,3,... (ntango Re(s)>1). Ezali ko connecter na distribution prime na nzela ya produit ya Euler. Hypothèse ya Riemann (esili kosila te!) etali ba zéro ya ζ na plan complexe.
math_special.p4: Ba fonctions ya Bessel Jₙ(x) na Y3(x) ezali ba solutions ya équation différentielle ya Bessel : x2y'' + xy' + (x2−n2)y = 0. Emonanaka na propagation ya mbonge, conduction ya chaleur na ba cylindres, pe mécanique quantique.
math_special.p5: Ai(x) na Bi(x) ezali ba solutions na y'' = xy. Bazali komonana na tunnel quantique (pproximation WKB) mpe na optique (diffraction).
math_special.p6: Ba familles polynomiques oyo ebimaka lokola ba fonctionnements propres ya ba opérateurs importants mpe esalelamaka na ba méthodes spectrales, quadrature, na mécanique quantique.
math_special.p7: K(k) na E(k) ezali ba integrales elliptiques complets ya lolenge ya liboso na ya mibale. Ba calculer période ya pendule non linéaire na périmètre ya ellipse.
math_special.td1: Γ(x) = ∫₀^∞ tˣ⁻1e⁻dt. Kokanisa ya Lanczos. Γ(n+1)=n!
math_special.td2: ln|Γ(x)|. Avoids likolo yaflow mpo na x ya monene.

math_special.td5: P3(x): orthogonale na [−1,1]. Eteni ya angle ya ba fonctions ya mbonge ya hydrogène.
math_special.td6: H3(x): na nzela ya orthogonale w.r.t. e^(−x2) oyo ezali na kati. Oscillateur harmonique quantique.
math_special.td8: L3(x): orthogonale na [0,∞) w.r.t. e^(−x) mpe ezali. Ba fonctions ya mbonge radiale ya hydrogène.

types.p12: Soki motuya moko ekoki kozala ntango nyonso te, tyá banote na yango T? mpe tyá ntango nyonso != null liboso ya kosalela yango. Ko accéder na champ null ezo crasher bot te — eza returns null na kimia.

architexDocs.title: Architex Référence ya monoko
architexDocs.subtitle: Monoko ya UI ya esakola mpo na Vortex Mini Apps. Etat réactif, ba dispositions composables, zéro étape ya kotonga.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex ezali déclaratif DSL ya moke oyo esalemi pona kotinda UI na kati ya Vortex messenger. Ozali kolimbola ndenge oyo écran esengeli kozala; tango ya kosala ebatelaka ba pixels na synchronisation na état automatiquement. DOM virtuel te, bundler te, JSX te — fichier `.arx` ezali app.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Déclaratif — okomi UI oyo olingi, ba étapes ya kotonga yango te
architexDocs.goalReactive: Réactif — `~count += 1` mpe étiquette nionso oyo etangi yango ezo mise à jour na esika na yango
architexDocs.goalPortable: Portable — `.arx` ndenge moko etambolaka na web, iOS, mpe Android ba temps d'exécution sans éditions
architexDocs.goalTiny: Tiny — parser + renderer masuwa na nse ya 30 KB, yango wana Mini Apps efungwamaka mbala moko
architexDocs.goalReadable: Kotangama — indentation ezali structure; ba modificateurs ekangami na minyɔlɔlɔ na `::`; mpako ya bilembo ya bopemi ezali te
architexDocs.whoDesc: Moto nyonso oyo alingi kotinda écran interactif na Vortex — ba formulaire ya client, ba tableaux de bord, ba pages ya vote, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Soki osilá kokoma HTML+CSS+JS, Architex ekomiyoka ete oyebi malamu kasi ekokoma mbangu. Soki osali yango te, Architex ezali mpe introduction doux na programmation réactif mpo monoko ebatelaka etando ya makolo moke.
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Eteni mokomoko etongami likoló na oyo ya liboso. Bandá na Ebandeli ya nokinoki, na nsima tángá Syntaxe, Etat, Layout, Modificateurs, Actions, mpe eteni ya liboso na nsuka. Sauter zingazinga na nzela ya tableau ya contenus soki oyebi déjà React to Svelte — ba concepts carte proprement.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Nzela ya mokuse uta na fisyé ya mpamba kino na Mini App oyo ezali kotambola.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Mbote

  ~kombo = "mokili".

  col :: pad(24) esika(12) na katikati

    motó ya likambo "Mbote, {~kombo}!" :: bonene ya moindo makasi(28)

    entrée ~kombo :: pad (8) rayon (6) ndelo (# ccc)

    text "Tyá nkombo likolo — makomi oyo ebongwani ntango ozali kokoma."
      :: taille(12) couleur(#888)
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Mbote` esakoli misisa. `~kombo = "mokili"` esali variable réactive. `col`, `motó ya likambo`, `kokɔtisa`, `makomi` ezali biloko oyo etongami na kati. `::` ekangisaka ba modificateurs (padding, ba couleurs, taille). Tango mosaleli akomi na entrée, interpolation nionso ya `{~kombo}` ezo mise à jour — câblage te, ba abonnés te, ba renders te na maboko.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Fungola onglet Architex na studio ya bot Vortex, coller code, finá Run. Tango ya kosala ezo rendre na panneau ya aperçu pe hot-recharges na save. Ntango ozali kobimisa, basaleli na yo bafungolaka appli uta na masolo nyonso — ba installations te.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Programme nionso ya Architex esalemi na biloko minei : ba déclarations oyo ebandi na `@`, ba variables réactives préfixées na `~`, ba composants oyo ekomami lokola ba identifiants nues, na ba modificateurs oyo ekangami sima ya `::`.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@screen Name`, `@theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, mpe `@for item na ~list` nyonso ebandi na colonne 0. Nyonso oyo ekɔtisami na nse na yango ezali ya bloc wana.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Ba composants efandi na ligne na yango moko: `texte`, `bouton`, `image`, `tête`, `étiquette`, `badge`, `diviseur`, `col`, `molongo`. Argument positionnelle na bango eyaka mbala moko sima ya kombo: `text ~message`, `bouton "Bomba"`, `image "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Sima ya `::` okoki ko chaîner ba modificateurs ebele ndenge olingi. Moko na moko azuaka zéro to koleka ba arguments na parenthèses: `:: pad(24) gap(16) centre gras size(20) color(#4f8ef7)`. Ba modificateurs ezali positionnels, mot clé te — ordre ezali na tina te longola se oyo ya suka-mokomi-longi lokola `color`.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` na bouton (to composante interactif nionso) ezo tambuisa assignation to appel ya fonction oyo elandi. Monyololo ebele `=>` pembenipembeni: `bouton "Tinda" => ~occupé = solo => tinda(action: "bomba", ba données: ~formulaire)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Nkombo nyonso oyo ezali liboso ya `~` ezali cellule réactive. Kokoma `~count = 0` mpo na kosakola, `~count = 5` mpo na kopesa lisusu, `~count += 1` mpo na kosala mise à jour. Noeud nionso UI oyo etangi cellule — directement to na nzela ya interpolation — ezo rendre lisusu tango cellule ebongwanaka.
architexDocs.computedVars: Ba variables oyo esalemi na calcul
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Salelá `:=` na esika ya `=` mpo na kosakola expression calculé: `~total := ~count * ~step`. Mopanzi ya loboko ya mobali etalelaka lisusu ntango nyonso oyo bozangi bondimi nyonso ebongwanaka. Abonnement manuel ezali te mpe bug ya valeur stale te — soki otangi `~a` esika moko boye na expression, o dépendre automatiquement na yango.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Ba annotations ezali optionnel kasi esalisaka na ba messages ya autocomplete mpe ya erreur: `~count: number = 0`, `~name: string = ""`, `~ok: boolean = false`, `~items: array = []`, `~user: object = {}`. Soki o sauter bango type ezo inférer na initialiser.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `motango`, `molongo`, `boolean`, `molongo`, `eloko`, `null`. Ba dates na ba blobs elekaka na kati lokola ba chaînes na ba objets respectivement. Tango ya kosala esalela mibeko ya kotindika ya JavaScript na nse ya kapoti, yango wana `~count + 1` esalaka ata soki `~count` ebandaki bomoi lokola molongo.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Molongo nyonso ekoki kokɔtisa maloba na `{...}`: `"Mbote, {~kombo.mosaleli}!"`, `"Total: {~count * ~price}"`. Interpolation ezalaka toujours réactive.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex ezali na ba récipients mibale oyo ekoki ko composer mpe douzaine ya ba composants ya nkasa. Nest bango na indentation — ba tags ya bokangami te.
architexDocs.containersDesc: `col` etambelaka bana na verticale, `row` na horizontal. Bango mibale bandimaka `gap(n)`, `pad(n)`, `center`, `grow`, mpe modificateur ya largeur/hauteur. Indent bana niveau moko na mozindo mpo na kosala zumbu.
architexDocs.containerExample:
molongo :: esika(8) pad(16) na katikati
  image "/avatar.png" :: w(40) h(40) rayon(20)
  col :: kokola esika(2)
    text ~kombo :: na moindo makasi
    texte ~bio :: bonene(12) langi(#888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: `text` — kopi nyonso ya nzoto. `motó ya likambo` — na ndenge ya ndimbola motó ya likambo. `label` — makomi ya makomi ya moke. `bouton` — contrôle oyo ekoki ko toucher. `input` — esika ya makomi ekangami na var ya réactif. `elilingi` — elilingi uta na URL. `badge` — tag oyo ezali lokola pilili. `mokabola` — ligne ya separateur mince. `toast` — bar ya kolia ya mwa ntango moke. `tabs` / `tab` — mobongoli ya ba onglets.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: `text "Mbote"` ezongisaka molongo ya statique. `text ~message` ezongisaka oyo ya réactif. Sangisa na interpolation: `texte "Total: {~count}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Mokanda ya motó ya likambo. Ezali kosala par défaut na monene, ya moindo koleka `text`. Argument positionnel moko: `tête "Paramètres"`. Ba échelles ya taille na écran — override na `size(n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Elemento oyo ekoki kobɛtabɛta. Molongo ya positionnement ezali étiquette; action ya `=>` ezo tambola na robinet. `bouton "Bomba" => ~projet = null`. Moto ebele `=>` na molongo.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Esika ya makomi oyo ekangami na nzela mibale. Variable réactif sima ya kombo esimbaka valeur ya lelo: `input ~email`. Ba modificateurs: `placeholder("...")`, `debounce(300)` mpo na ba mises à jour oyo ekangami.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Ezali kozwa mikumba uta na nzela ya HTTPS URL to `/uploads/...`. Ba modificateurs `w(px)`, `h(px)`, `radius(px)` bakati boîte. Ekweyi lisusu na silhouette ya placeholder soki ba URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Separateur ya ligne ya suki, 1px, ekumisaka couleur ya thème ya lelo. Ba arguments te.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Pilili oyo eyambaka makambo na yango: `badge ~count`, `badge "ya sika"`. Salelá mpo na ba compteurs oyo etangami te mpe ba puces ya tag.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Caption/texte ya mosungi — na miso ekangami. Good mpo na bankombo ya bisika ya formulaire.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Notification oyo ezali ko bloquer te. `toast ~emonanaka "Ebombami!" :: duration(2000)` elakisaka pendant 2 s tango nionso `~visible` ezali vrai, sima auto-dismisses. Empilé modal te, bitumba ya z-index te.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Récipient ya onglet ekangami na molongo ya réactif: `tabs ~activeTab`. Na kati na yango, `onglet moko na moko "Label" "fungola"` esakolaka onglet moko; nzoto oyo ekɔti na nse emonisami ntango fungola ekokani.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Ba modificateurs ezali seul moyen ya ko styler composante. Bokanga bango na minyɔlɔlɔ nsima ya `::`. Bazali na mabota mitano: esika, bonene, langi, typographie, mpe bizaleli.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` — kozipa na ngambo nyonso. `pad(x, y)` — horizontal + vertical. `pad(likolo, na loboko ya mobali, na nse, na loboko ya mwasi)` — CSS-order. `gap(n)` — esika kati na bana ya `col` / `row`. `margin(n)` — esika ya libanda na bandeko.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` — bonene oyo ebongwani. `h(px)` — bosanda oyo ebongwani. `kola` — kotondisa esika oyo etikali na molongo/col. `kati` — katikati na nzela ya axe ya ekulusu; na `col` ezali na centre horizontal, na `molongo` ezali na centre vertical.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `langi(#rrggbb)` — esika ya liboso. `bg(#rrggbb)` — ya sima. Bango mibale bandimaka bilembo ya motó ya likambo: `color(~primary)` etangi uta na bloc `@theme` ya lelo. Opacité elekaka na hex ya 8 chiffres: `#00000080` ezali 50 %% noir.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `size(px)` — bonene ya makomi. `bold` / `italic` — kilo mpe lolenge ya kosala. `align(gauche|centre|droite)` — bobongisi ya makomi.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `hidden(~flag)` — elongolaka node tango drapeau ezali solo. `emonanaka(~drapo)` — inverse. Ba noeuds non monté esopaka DOM na bango, donc UI conditionnel eza moins cher.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce(ms)` na `entrée` ezo accélérateur ba mises à jour. `placeholder("...")` ezali kolakisa molongo ya makanisi. `format(lolenge, arg)` na `texte` e formataka motango: `format("mbongo", "USD")`, `format("percent")`, `format("compact")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius(px)` ezo rond ba coins. `border(#rrggbb)` ebendaka AVC ya 1 px. `border(px, #rrggbb)` etie épaisseur trop.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Misala ebongola état to elobelaka na mokili ya libanda. Bazali kotambola synchrone na mosali ya tap/keypress.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~computer = 0`, `=> ~occupé = solo`, `=> ~liste = []`. Variable réactive nionso ekoki kokomama.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~count += 1` ezali idiomatique mpo na ba compteurs.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: Multiple `=>` na ligne moko ezo tirer likolo-na-nse na tick moko, yango wana UI ezo mise à jour mbala moko na suka: `bouton "Soma" => ~busy = solo => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false`. Mpo na mosala ya async, linga `@reaction` oyo esalemi na calcul.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `tinda(action: "kombo", ...args)` ezali pont ya kozonga na bot. Hôte (Vortex tango ya kosala) azuaka yango lokola message JSON RPC mpe akoki kobenga code ya bot na yo. Salelá yango mpo na kokɔta, API kozwa, kofuta — eloko nyonso oyo DSL yango moko ekoki kobimisa te.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto("Nkombo ya Ecran", arg: motuya, ...)` epusi `@écran` mosusu na ebele; `nsima ()` ezo bima. Tango ya kosala ezo anima na ndenge ya défaut.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~text)`, `haptic("pele" | "moyenne" | "kilo")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("...")`, `confirm("...") => ~ok = it` — raccourci `it` ezali motuya ya bozongisi ya expression oyo eleki.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Sakola palette moko mbala moko, salela lisusu bisika nyonso. Ba jetons ekomaka ba variables réactives régulières po app na yo ekoki kotinda toggle ya mode noir na ba lignes misato.
architexDocs.themeExample:
@motó ya likambo
  ~ya liboso = #4f8ef7
  ~likama = #e53935
  ~bg = #ffffff
  ~mokanda = #212121
  ~rayon = 12. Ezali na ntina mingi
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` ebendaka `@component` mpe `@screen` nyonso uta na fisyé wana na kati ya portée ya lelo. Banzela ezali na boyokani na fisyé oyo ezali kokɔtisa; ba importations circulaires e détecté pe e rapporter na temps ya parse.
architexDocs.components: @component — biloko oyo esalemi na ndenge ya moto ye moko
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Limbola mbala moko, salela mbala mingi: `@component Avatar taille ya url\n image url :: w(taille) h(taille) rayon(taille / 2)`. Na kati ya nzoto ya composante ba paramètres oyo epesami kombo ezali na portée lokola ba identifiants ya pamba (sans `~`).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@mpo na eloko na ~list` elakisaka molongo moko na élément moko. `@mpo na eloko, idx na ~list` ekangisaka mpe index oyo esalemi na zéro. Tango ya kosala elandaka identité na nzela ya élément yango moko, yango wana kobakisa biloko na likolo ya liste ya 10 000-row efutaka O(1) DOM mosala.
architexDocs.forExample:
@mpo na eloko, idx na ~biloko
  molongo :: esika(8) pad(4) .
    elembo ya elembo ~idx
    text ~item :: kokola
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `cond ? a : b` esalaka esika nionso expression moko endimami. Zubu mpo na ba enums: `~ezalela >= 10 ? "likolo" : ~ezalela >= 5 ? "kati" : "na nse"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Na kati ya déclaration ya composante, `slot` e marquer esika nzoto ya mobengi e brancher Kanisa yango lokola slot par défaut ya React children / Vue.
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: `~var` moko na moko ezali elembo. Tango otangi yango na kati ya argument calculé, modificateur, to interpolation, temps d'exécution e noter botangi na graphique ya dépendance ya lelo. Tango okomi, noeud nionso oyo etangi yango ezuaka re-évaluation — mbala moko, na suka ya microtask ya lelo.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Ba écrits ebele na handler moko ezali batched. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` e déclenchaka exactement passe moko ya render.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Na ndenge ya libela tango ya kosala esalela bokokani ya makasi (`===`). Kokoma valeur moko ezo re-runs eloko te. Lekisa objet/array ya sika pona ko forcer mise à jour; inmutability elendisami kasi esengeli te.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Ba applis canoniques minei, moko na moko ezali na yango moko mpe na se ya 40 lignes. Kopi moko na yango na onglet Architex mpe finá Run.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Compteur — état réactif, calculé, ba manipulateurs ya boutons, bokangami ya makomi.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo — botalisi ya liste, kobakisa / kolongola, bobongisi na kati ya molongo.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profil — elilingi, bilembo, visibilité conditionnelle, navigation.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Ba fonctionnalités ya killer — ba thèmes, importations, ba onglets, ba toasts, ba nombres formatés, ternaries, ba vars typed.
architexDocs.errors: Mabunga oyo emonanaka mingi mpe oyo esengeli kosala
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `kombo eyebani te ~foo` — osaleli variable réactive liboso ya kosakola yango. Bakisa `~foo = ...` na likolo ya `@screen` oyo ekangami.
architexDocs.errIndent: `indent oyo ekanisamaki te` — bana basengeli kozala na mozindo ya niveau moko koleka moboti na bango. Architex esalelaka mpenza bisika mibale na nivo moko; ba onglets eboyami mpo na koboya ba bugs invisible-whitespace.
architexDocs.errModifier: `modificateur inconnu` — okomaki `:: shadow` kasi tango ya kosala esungaka yango te. Tala liste ya ba modificateurs oyo ezali likolo; Architex ezali strict na ba kombo oyo eyebani te pona kobatela compatibilité ya liboso.
architexDocs.errType: `kozanga boyokani ya lolenge` — e.g. olekisaki molongo moko esika bazelaka motango moko. Annoter variable réactive (`~count: nombre`) mpe parser akoyebisa yo esika valeur ya mabe ewuti.
architexDocs.errDebug: Mpo na kosala débogage na tango ya kosala, envelopper expression suspect na `debug(...)` — tango ya kosala ekomaka évaluation nionso na console sans ko affecter valeur.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Web — ezo rendre na vanille DOM na ba variables CSS pona ba jetons ya thème. Dépendance ya React / Vue / Svelte te.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS — `.arx` moko wana e parser mpe e rendre na ba vues ya SwiftUI na nzela ya hôte Vortex iOS. Modificateur nionso esalaka carte na style ya SwiftUI.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android — hôte a rendre na Jetpack Compose. Ba modificateurs ya ba gestes (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) ebongolami na ba équivalents ya Composer.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Politiki ya version — Architex epesaka garantie ya compatibilité ya sima pona ba fichiers `.arx` na ba versions ya mike. Fisyé `.arx` oyo ekomami contre 0.1 ezali kaka kosala na 0.9.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Tanga buku ya kolamba mpo na ba modèles (ba listes infinies, ba formulaires, ba paiements), guide ya outils mpo na plugin ya Code CLI mpe VS, mpe guide ya contribution soki olingi kobakisa composant intégré. Liziba mobimba ezali na github.com/vortex/Architex.

meta.title: Vortex Botangi ya mokanda
meta.subtitle: Sous-système nionso ya Vortex na esika moko.
meta.intro: Référence oyo ezali exhaustive par design. Bandá esika nyonso — mokapo mokomoko ezali na yango moko. Liloba nyonso ezongaka lisusu na banzela ya source soki ezali na ntina. Invariant nionso babengi yango polele.
meta.howToUse: Tableau ya makambo oyo ezali na lobɔkɔ ya mwasi ezali komonisa mikapo oyo ezali awa. Finá mokapo moko mpo na kopumbwa epai na yango; mokapo mokomoko ezali na mitó ya makambo mikemike mpe baliste oyo okoki kosala scanner na boumeli ya segɔnde 30 liboso ya kozinda na kati.
