architecture.title: Botali ya architecture ya monene
architecture.subtitle: Ba processus misato — client, noeud, contrôleur — na protocole moko oyo ekangisaka bango.
architecture.intro: Vortex azali motindami ya décentralisé. Au lieu ya back-end moko oyo ezali ya entreprise moko, e fédéré maille ouverte ya **noeuds** indépendants, découvrir mpe garantie na **contrôleur** compact oyo e publier manifeste signé ya code oyo e attesté. **Ba clients** basimbaka ba clés privées nionso pe ba rendre UI. Mokapo oyo etikali etambolaka na ba processus misato, bandelo na yango, mpe ba données oyo ezali koleka kati na yango.
architecture.h1p1: Ba messagers centralisés bazali point unique ya coercition. Mobeko ya tribunal, bokati ya cloud-provider, to acquisition ya bonguna nionso ebongolami na "ba usagers ba perdre accès". Vortex azali ko couvrir yango na kotika mutu nionso asala noeud mpe kotika ba clients ba tambola entre ba noeuds sans ko re-inscription.
architecture.h1p2: Décentralisation esengeli kobatela sekele mpe bosembo. Fédération ya ba serveurs oyo ba confier te esalaka kaka soki ba serveurs bakoki kotanga plaintext te mpe bakoki ko forger ba messages te. Vortex ezo enforcer ezala na nzela ya encryption ya suka na suka pe ba attestations Ed25519 na message nionso ya croix-node.
architecture.h1p3: Contrôleur ezali eteni moko ya centralisé-ish, kasi ezali moke. Ezali kobimisa kaka `INTEGRITY.sig.json` mpe liste ya bisika ya bokoti oyo ekoki kotyelama motema. Moto nyonso akoki komiyamba na talatala, yango wana ata contrôleur azali ata point moko te ya échec — kaka source moko ya vérité mpo na "oyo pubkey e signer ba sorties officielles".
architecture.h1l1: Bokangami ya motekisi te : ba clients bakoki ko migrer identité na bango entre ba noeuds tango nionso na ko signer lisusu pubkey X25519 na JWT ya sika.
architecture.h1l2: Corrélation ya panne te : tango noeud moko ekiti, ba usagers na ba noeuds misusu ba remarquer te.
architecture.h1l3: Jurisdiction moko te: ba opérateurs ba ponaka ndaku na bango ya legal, pe ba usagers ba pona opérateur na bango.
architecture.h1l4: No single UI: iOS, Android, web ezali baninga ya kelasi ya liboso — plateforme moko te ezali enveloppe mince likolo ya mosusu.
architecture.h2p1: Client ezo tambola na appareil ya usager. Yango ezali esika se moko oyo ba messages ya texte ya pamba, ba touches privées, mpe ba fichiers-in-the-clear en direct. Node emonaka bango ata mokolo moko te.
architecture.h2p2: Plateforme nionso oyo esungami esalelaka ba protocoles ya fil ndenge moko (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-split modules ya fonctionnalités (`api/` protocoles, `impl/` code, `ui/` vues) ebatelaka contrat serré mpe code spécifique plateforme localisé.
architecture.h2p3: Bobombi na dispositif: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / Cookie ya HttpOnly mpo na ba jetons; SQLite (GRDB na iOS, Salle na Android, enveloppe IndexedDB na web) mpo na texte chiffre caché + index FTS.
architecture.h2l1: iOS — Paquet Swift na 30+ modules ya fonctionnalités. Min cible ya déploiement iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Android — Kotlin + Kosala + Kosimba. minSdk 26, mokanoSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Web — vanille JS PWA, mosali ya service, pas ya kotonga etape oyo eleki ES module bundling.
architecture.h2l4: Bureau — Enveloppe ya Tauri zingazinga ya client web; bundle moko, mosali ya Chrome ya mboka.
architecture.h3p1: Node ezali processus Python (`python -m app.main`, to `run.py` oyo ekangami) oyo ezali koyoka na 9000 na ndenge ya libela. Ezali ko persister chiphertext, ko fans libanda WebSocket ba événements, kosimba TURN credentiels, mpe ko courtier fédération na ba noeuds mosusu.
architecture.h3p2: Couche ya noeud ezali délibérément mince. Ezali kobimisa banzela soki 120 na kati ya nzete ya `/api/*` bakisa `/ws` mpo na fan-out na tango ya solo. Kotombola kilo (crypto, présence, programmation) ezali factoré na `app/sécurité/`, `app/transport/`, `app/peer/`.
architecture.h3p3: Node moko na mode SQLite par défaut esimbaka ~50 usagers concurrents confortablement na M1. Na Postgres na Redis activé, code moko e échelle horizontalement — noeud nionso ekomaka sans état eleki DB na fan-out.
architecture.h3l1: Ba points ya entrée : `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/integrité` na `/santé` pona bomoyi.
architecture.h3l2: Dépendances: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptographie (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-multipart, Oreiller, Rust extension `vortex_chat` mpo na crypto ya nzela ya molunge.
architecture.h3l3: Na bolingi: Redis (présence fan-out na kati ya ba noeuds ebele), Postgres (production DB), coturn (TURN relais), fluent-bit (envoi ya journal).
architecture.h3l4: Taille binaire: ~60 MB Python deps + ~10 MB Rust bobakisi. Docker image soki 400 MB liboso ya squash.
architecture.h4p1: Contrôleur ezali processus Python ekeseni (`vortex_controller`) na tina ya moke : kobimisa pe ko vérifier `INTEGRITY.sig.json`, ko exposer ba URL ya entrée, pe kolandela santé ya ba camarades fédérées.
architecture.h4p2: Na démarrage contrôleur atambolaka na nzete ya source, a hashes fichier nionso, pe a comparer contre manifeste. Soki hash moko ezo correspondre te contrôleur aboyi kobanda. Yango elakisi ete fisyé oyo ebongwani na disque ekoki te kosala `status:"verified"`.
architecture.h4p3: Ba clients ba betaka `/v1/integrity` avant ba confier noeud moko. Soki bamoni `status != "verified"` baboyi kopesa ba credentiels, période. Yango nde ancre ya confiance.
architecture.h4l1: Etiamaki maboko na `bafungola/bobimisi.fungola` (Ed25519). Public demi cuite na ba sorties ya ba clients.
architecture.h4l2: Bokotisi ya manifeste: `{nzela, sha256, bonene}` mpo na fisyé nyonso oyo ezali gitignoré te.
architecture.h4l3: Kotonga lisusu: `python -m vortex_contrôleur.intégrité.esaleli_ya_elembo`. Ebimisi `INTEGRITY.sig.json` na misisa ya repo.
architecture.h4l4: Rotation: ba opérateurs forking Vortex ba remplacer `release.key`. Ba clients configuré na pubkey na bango alors ba confier fourchette wana.
architecture.h5p1: Tambola na oyo esalemaka tango Alice atindi "bonjour" na Bob:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Client alukaka fungola ya misisa ya chambre na magasin na ye ya mboka. Soki ezali te, ezwaka enveloppe ya sika na `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` mpo na pubkey na yango moko. Ba DM ya mbala ya liboso basalaka Diffie-Hellman ya tour moko na ba préclés.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node ebombaka molongo mpe e ventilateur libanda `{type:"m", salle:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}` na WebSocket nyonso oyo azali na boyokani oyo azali abonné na chambre.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Client ya Bob azuaka cadre, a déchiffrer na clé ya misisa moko, a vérifier pseudo ya motindi a correspondre na membres oyo bazelaka, pe a rendre bulle.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Client ya Bob a poster `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` na id ya message ya suka ya kotanga. Yango e déclenchaka émission ya `{type:"r"}` po bulle ya Alice elakisaka tick.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) ezali makasi, binaire, mpe mbangu mpo na ko coder. Comparé na JSON ekata taille ya charge utile na ~30 % na chiphertext typique ya chat mpe elongolaka ambiguïté ya espace blanc.
architecture.h6p2: Comparé na Protobuf esengaka générateur ya schéma te mpe e congeler ba numéros ya champ te. Yango ezali na ntina mpo Vortex evoluer — tobakisi `thread_id`, `reply_to`, `reactions_count`, `kind` likolo ya ba sorties sans kobuka ba clients ya kala.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR ezali pe oyo Signal, Matrix, na NIP-29 basalelaka pona ba raisons oyo ekokani mingi. Ko correspondre na choix na bango elakisi protocole na biso ezali facile ya ko auditer na ba chercheurs ya sécurité oyo bayebi déjà encodage.
architecture.h7p1: Cadre nionso ememaka `v:<int>`. Version ya lelo ezali 1. Cadre oyo ezali na version eyebani te ebwakami; ba clients bakomaka likebisi mpe bakoba na cadre oyo elandi.
architecture.h7p2: Compatibilité ya sima ezali garantie pona cadre nionso oyo ememaka kaka `v:1`. Compatibilité ya liboso ezali meilleur-effort : ba champs ya sika ebakisami na suka ya dict, ba clients ya kala ba ignorer yango.
architecture.h7p3: Bobukani ya makasi ebombami mpo na mbongwana ya ntina ya bokengi (e.g. kobongola HKDF ba chaînes ya contexte). Na ba cas wana version ezo bump na 2 pe fenêtre ya migration e publier.
architecture.h1_a: Réseau Vortex ekabwani na ba processus misato. Moko na moko etambolaka yango moko, esololaka na basusu na nzela ya ba protocoles ya nsinga oyo elimbolami malamu, mpe ekoki kozongisama na esika na yango na lipanda. Ezali na monolith te — fonctionnalité nionso ekangami na moko ya ba rôles misato.
architecture.h1_b: Client moko asimbi ba clés pe a rendre UI. Node moko e persister chiphertext, e fans out ba événements likolo ya WebSocket, mpe ba courtiers WebRTC signalisation. Contrôleur abimisaka ba URL ya manifeste mpe ya entrée oyo e signer. Basololaka na nzela ya HTTPS + WebSocket na kosalelaka ba charges utile codées CBOR na kati ya ba enveloppes AES-GCM.
architecture.h1_c: Bokabwani ekotisama na v0.0.3 sima ya version ya monolith ya liboso ekutanaki na ba problèmes mibale : attestation ya sortie ekangamaki na noeud oyo ezali kosala (yango wana noeud oyo ezali na compromis ekokaki kokosa na ntina ya code na yango moko), mpe fédération ezalaki impossible mpo état ya noeud na état ya confiance ezalaki kofanda na ba tableaux moko. Kokabola attestation libanda na processus na yango moko epesaki opérateur nionso pubkey moko mpo na ko pin mpe tika to échelle fédération na N arbitraire.
architecture.h2_a: Bokabwani ya noeud/contrôleur elongolaka artifact oyo ezali na sensibles mingi na sécurité (manifeste signé) na surface ya attaque ya munene (serveur API).
architecture.h2_b: Contrôleur ebombaka SQLite DB ya moke: ba pubkeys ya confiance, ba URL ya miroir, na ba scores ya santé. Eboyi kobanda soki INTEGRITY.sig.json ekokani te na nzete ya disque — fisyé oyo ebongwani ekoki ata moke te kosala `status:"verified"`. Node etambolaka na Postgres/SQLite na yango moko mpe esimbaka ata moke te fungola ya kobimisa.
architecture.h2_c: Modèle euti na bokabwani ya root-store ya Chrome (ba certs efandaka na piste ya sortie ya navigateur, origine web te) mpe Release.gpg ya Debian (manifest signé, ba paquets sans signature). Adopté mpo ba designs nionso mibale ebikaki ba décennies ya revue adversarial.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 na saut nionso, ba charges utile chiffrées ya suka na suka na kati. TLS azali kosimba transport; AES-GCM esimbaka makambo oyo ezali na kati.
architecture.h3_b: Kati na client na node : HTTPS (`/api/*`) na WSS (`/ws`). Kati na ba noeuds : HTTPS (`/fédération/*`). Kati na node na contrôleur: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Nyonso basalelaka TLS 1.3 na ba empreintes ya misapi Chrome 120 mpo na kotelemela DPI.
architecture.h3_c: Vortex ya ebandeli ezalaki kosalela TCP brut na kosimbana na maboko ya protocole ya makelele oyo esalemi na kolanda bamposa ya moto. Ebongwani na TLS 1.3 na v0.0.4 sima ya ko réaliser que ba protocoles personnalisés signaler "intéressant" na ba observateurs passifs. TLS 1.3 ezali ennuyeux, ubiquitous, mpe ECH-prêt — ba propriétés misato tolingaki.
architecture.h3_f:
couche ya transport: TLS 1,3 (RFC 8446) + optionnel ECH (RFC 9460)
couche ya contenus: AES-256-GCM ekangami na kati CBOR
architecture.h4_a: Message moko ya sortie elekaka na ba étapes minei: cadre → chiffrer → poste → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Client a calculer clé ya chambre (X25519 + HKDF), a cadrer message lokola CBOR, a cadre na AES-256-GCM na nzela ya nonce ya 96 bits aléatoire, a POST na `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Node ebombaka molongo ya chiphertext mpe e ventilateur libanda na WebSocket nyonso oyo ekangami na abonné na chambre. Client ya récipient a déchiffrer na clé moko. Latence ya retour na se ya 50 ms na LAN local, ~120 ms typique WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Pipeline ya ba étapes minei ezali ndenge moko Signal oyo esalelamaki na 2014; to changeaki kaka transport (WebSocket na esika ya TCP ya Signal) na encodage (CBOR na esika ya protobuf). Kokokanisa design oyo e prouvé eleki ko inventer design ya sika.
architecture.h5_a: Toponaki CBOR likolo ya JSON mpe Protobuf nsima ya kokokanisa bonene ya charge utile, évoluabilité, mpe ergonomie ya débogage na ba charges ya mosala ya solo ya chat.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR ebimisaka ~30% ya ba charges utile ya mike koleka JSON na ba messages oyo ezali na unicode kilo, ezali na ambiguïté ya espace blanc te, mpe esungaka addition ya champ sans générateurs ya schéma. Proto elingaki kozala na mposa ya fichier .proto na sortie moko mpe elingaki ko congeler ba numéros ya champ.
architecture.h5_c: Signal e changeaki de protobuf na cadrage CBOR-like na 2017 pona ba raisons moko. Matrix esalela CBOR na couche na yango ya résolution ya état. CBOR ezali norme IETF (RFC 8949) mpe monoko nionso oyo tozali ko cibler ezali na bibliothèque oyo ekoli.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR taille: ~0.7 × JSON na utf-8 oyo esangani
          ~1.05 × protobuf na schéma moko
Kobakisa esika = kobakisa na suka. Ba clients ya kala ba ignorer.
architecture.h6_a: Mpo na nini CBOR — eteni ya mokapo ya architecture. Oyo ezali moko ya ba mécanismes ya moboko oyo etalisami na référence mobimba ya Vortex. Tángá mokapo oyo ezali zingazinga mpo na koyeba makambo oyo ezali na kati; eteni oyo ezali kosala zoom na bizaleli ya sikisiki.
architecture.h6_b: Botali ya bosaleli pona "Pourquoi CBOR". Mecanisme esalemi na module oyo ekokani na se ya `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, to `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README ebengaka banzela ya sikisiki ya ba fichiers.
architecture.h6_c: Mecanisme ya "Pourquoi CBOR" evoluaki na kati ya ba sorties Vortex. Bokeli yango ebandi na bolukiluki mpe misala ya kobimisa oyo ebimisamaki ya bamemi-nsango ya kala. Histoire ya version na `CHANGELOG.md` ekomaka tango pièce moko na moko ekita pe nini e motiver yango.
architecture.h7_a: Version ya protocole — eteni ya mokapo ya architecture. Oyo ezali moko ya ba mécanismes ya moboko oyo etalisami na référence mobimba ya Vortex. Tángá mokapo oyo ezali zingazinga mpo na koyeba makambo oyo ezali na kati; eteni oyo ezali kosala zoom na bizaleli ya sikisiki.
architecture.h7_b: Botali ya bosaleli mpo na "Versioning ya protocole". Mecanisme esalemi na module oyo ekokani na se ya `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, to `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README ebengaka banzela ya sikisiki ya fisyé.
architecture.h7_c: Mecanisme ya "versioning ya protocole" evoluaki na kati ya ba sorties Vortex. Bokeli yango ebandi na bolukiluki mpe misala ya kobimisa oyo ebimisamaki ya bamemi-nsango ya kala. Histoire ya version na `CHANGELOG.md` ekomaka tango pièce moko na moko ekita pe nini e motiver yango.

crypto.title: Ba primitifs ya cryptographie
crypto.subtitle: Algorithme nionso na stack, but na yango, ba paramètres na yango, RFC na yango.
crypto.intro: Vortex esalela kaka ba primitifs oyo ba peer-reviewed. Ba chiffres ya bloc personnalisé te, ba KDF oyo ekolisami na ndako te, ba schemes ya signature ya sika te. Mokapo oyo ezali kokoma primitif nionso oyo tosalelaka, ba paramètres ya sikisiki, mpe rationale oyo ezali sima ya choix moko na moko.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) na lolenge na yango ya Montgomery, esalelamaka mpo na Diffie-Hellman ya courbe-elliptique. Ba clés privées ya 32 octets, ba clés publiques ya 32 octets, sortie secrete partagée ya 32 octets.
crypto.h1p2: Esalemi mpo na : identité ya dispositif statique, ba clés ya session éphémère, ba enveloppes ya poussée scellés, enveloppe ya ba clés ya chambre, ba enveloppes ya fédération.
crypto.h1p3: Bosaleli ya iOS: `Curve25519.Boyokani ya fungola.Fungola ya moto ye moko` uta na CryptoKit. Android: `x25519-dalek` na nzela ya JNI. Node: `cryptographie.hazmat.primitifs.asymétrique.x25519` na nzela ya OpenSSL.
crypto.h1p4: Nyonso misato esalaka interop bit-for-bit. Mobembo ya kokende mpe kozonga oyo emekami na RFC 7748 ba vecteurs ya komeka Alice/Bob na botongi nyonso.
crypto.h1p5: Performance: ~100 μs na Diffie-Hellman moko na iPhone ya 2020, ~30 μs na Mac ya 2020. Ronde ya enveloppe ya ba clés ya chambre pona groupe ya 200 membres ezo zua soki 10 ms mur-horloge.
crypto.h1p6: Constant-time: oui, ezala na arithmétique ya courbe mpe na nzela ya décodage ya octets brut.
crypto.h1p7: Posture ya canal côté: Escalier ya Montgomery ezali immune na classe ya ba attaques ya temps oyo ezo beta ba courbes ya Weierstrass; OpenSSL na Swift CryptoKit bango mibale basalelaka yango.
crypto.h1p8: Sérialisation ya ba clés: 32 octets ya petit-endian. Ba clés publiques ekangami na importation po ba entrées malformées esala ba fuites ya point ya ordre bas te.
crypto.h1l1: Mpo na nini X25519 mpe P-256 te: mbangu, moke, mitungisi ya NIST-courbe te.
crypto.h1l2: Pourquoi sortie ya 32 octets et non 64: ekokani na longueur ya entrée HKDF-SHA256 exactement.
crypto.h1l3: Pourquoi Montgomery et non Edwards: toza na besoin kaka ya DH, ba signature te, na matériel clé oyo. Edwards akozala na mposa ya litambe ya mbongwana mbala nyonso.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) likolo ya edwards25519. Fungola ya bato nyonso ya 32 octets, signature ya 64 octets.
crypto.h2p2: Esalemi mpo na : ba attestations ya noeuds na ba messages ya fédération, ba signature ya clé ya kobimisa likolo ya manifeste ya intégrité, signature ya déploiement ya bot, identité ya dispositif ya tango molayi mpo na Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Déterminisme : variante RFC 8032 oyo tosalelaka ebimisaka signature moko mbala mibale pona message + clé moko. CryptoKit ya Apple na iOS 17+ esalelaka variante randomisée RFC 8032bis — bango mibale bazali valides mpe bango mibale ba vérifier na vérifieur nionso oyo ezali na boyokani.
crypto.h2p4: Coût ya vérification: ~200 μs na CPU ya mikolo oyo. Batch vérifier (`batch_verify ([msg, sig, pk] * N)`) ezali ~ 10× mbangu na signature moko.
crypto.h2p5: Format ya signature: `R || S`, 32 octets moko na moko, petit-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Bomonisi ya bafungola ya bato banso: Point comprimé ya 32 octets. Toujours valide — eza na cas ya "point na infini" te.
crypto.h2l2: Bomonisi ya fungola ya privé: mboto ya 32 octets. Scalaire oyo epanzani ezwami na mopepe na nzela ya SHA-512.
crypto.h2l3: Pourquoi pas ECDSA: ECDSA esengeli na RNG ya qualité ya likolo pona signature nionso; RNG moko oyo ezali na bias ebimisaka clé privée. Ed25519 ezali déterministe, RNG esengeli te na tango ya signe.
crypto.h3p1: AES na Mode Galois/Computer (NIST SP 800-38D). Ba touches ya 256 bits, ba nonces ya 96 bits, ba balises ya authentification ya 128 bits.
crypto.h3p2: Esalemi mpo na: enveloppe ya texte chiffre ya message, ba enveloppes ya chunk ya fichier, ba charges utile ya sauvegarde chiffrées, ba charges utile ya push scellés.
crypto.h3p3: Construction ya Nonce : message nionso ebimisaka nonce ya sika ya 96 bits aléatoire. Node elandaka ba nonces 10^6 ya suka na chambre moko mpe ebwakaka ba doublons na ndenge ya défensive — client asengeli te kobimisa ba doublons na esika ya liboso, kasi kanisá-eloko moko te ezali ya talo moke.
crypto.h3p4: Pourquoi ba nonces ya 96 bits et non ya 128 bits: 96 bits ezali longueur ya nonce "déterministe" standard GCM, pe epesaka biso 2^32 nonces aléatoires avant ba collisions ya anniversaire ekoma soucis. Fungola moko ya shambre ebalukaka kala liboso ya likambo yango, yango wana ezali na likama te.
crypto.h3p5: Taille ya tag: mobimba 128 bits. To truncate te — ba économies ya stockage ezali négligeable mpe truncation ematisaka probabilité ya faux.
crypto.h3l1: Accélération ya matériel: AES-NI (x86), ba extensions ya crypto ARMv8-A, ba blocs crypto dédiés na Apple Silicon. Débit ya chiffrement ~3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: Na ba appareils ya kala ARM oyo ezangi ba extensions crypto: ~300 MB/s na nzela ya logiciel. Encore mbangu koleka disque IO.
crypto.h3l3: Ba données associées : tête ya cadre (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) elekisami lokola AAD donc tête ya forgé eko vérifier te.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) na SHA-256. Ezuaka ba sous-clés ebele ya 32 octets na entrée moko ya 32 octets.
crypto.h4p2: Esalemi mpo na: kokabola bobimisi X25519 na fungola ya chiffrement + fungola MAC + fungola ya motó; kozwa fungola ya ratchet ya misisa na rond ya Diffie-Hellman; kotonga bafungola ya fisyé na eteni moko uta na misisa ya fisyé.
crypto.h4p3: Ba chaînes ya info ezalaka toujours déterministe ASCII: `"v1:encryption"`, `"v1:mac"`, `"v1:tête"`, `"v1:sauvegarde"`. Versioning e permettre biso to roter hiérarchie ya clé mobimba na nzela ya changement ya info-string.
crypto.h4p4: Mungwa ezali optionnel. Na Vortex tosalelaka id ya chambre lokola mungwa pona dérivation ya chambre-clé po ba salles différentes ekoki ko réutiliser par accident te ba clés dérivées ata soki sortie X25519 moko ebimi.
crypto.h4l1: Pourquoi SHA-256 et non SHA-512 : ba plateformes nionso ezalaka na accélération matériel SHA-256; SHA-512 ezali mwa mbangu na ba CPU ya 64 bits kasi na ba téléphones te.
crypto.h4l2: Pourquoi pas un KMAC-based KDF: KMAC ezali niche. HKDF ezali na bibliothèque nionso ya crypto oyo tosalelaka.
crypto.h5: Argon2id hashing ya mot de passe
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106) Ezali na ntina mingi. Ba paramètres: m=64 MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5p2: Esalemi mpo na: hash ya mot ya nzela ya côté serveur (`users.password_hash`), fungola ya enveloppe ya sauvegarde locale, dérivation ya importation ya fraze ya mboto.
crypto.h5p3: Mpo na nini ba paramètres oyo: OWASP 2023 makanisi. 64 MiB + 3 iterations ezuaka ~0.5 s na iPhone X — dispositif na biso oyo esungami na malembe. Attaquant ASIC oyo azali na 100× bande passante ya mémoire ya téléphone azali kaka na besoin ya ~5 ms par tentative. Ba mots de passe ya milayi (entropie > 40 bits) ekomaka computationally infeasible ya ko craquer na échelle.
crypto.h5p4: Format ya bobateli: `argon2:<encoded>` esika encodé ezali molongo ya format RFC esangisi mungwa, mémoire, ba iterations, na hash.
crypto.h5l1: Pourquoi Argon2id et non Argon2i to Argon2d: 2id ezali hybride — passe ya liboso ezo résister ba côté-canaux (mode i), ba passes oyo elandi ezo résister na GPU/ASIC (mode d). Signal esalelaka ndenge moko.
crypto.h5l2: Comparaison dummy-hash : ata tango usager azali te, tosalaka kaka faux vérification Argon2 na hash constant. Yango ekokanisi tango ya bokɔti mpo ete ba attaquants bakoka kotanga ba kombo ya basaleli te na tango ya eyano.
crypto.h5l3: Rehash na login: soki admin ya serveur a bumps coût ya mémoire, ba hashes ya kala ezo re-hashed na login ya succès oyo elandi. Transparent na mosaleli.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024) Ezali na ntina mingi. ML-KEM-768. Fungola ya bato banso ya 1184 octets, makomi ya chiffre ya 1088 octets, sekele ya kokabola ya 32 octets.
crypto.h6p2: Esalemi mpo na: ba clés hybrides ya session post-quantique. Tango baninga nyonso mibale basalaka piblisite ya lisungi ya Kyber fungola ya session ezali `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: Pourquoi hybride: ata soki Kyber ebukani sima (ezali comparatif jeune), eteni ya X25519 ebatelaka biso kaka. Kosangisa epesaka malamu-ya-nyonso mibale.
crypto.h6p4: Pourquoi Kyber et non ba candidats NIST misusu : ezalaki oyo baponaki pona standardisation. Disponibilité ya code ezali ya monene (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Performance: génération ya clé ~100 μs, encapsulation ~30 μs, décapsulation ~50 μs. Negligible soki tokokanisi yango na latence ya voyage aller-retour.
crypto.h6l2: Ntalo ya bande passante: 1088 octets na texte chiffre ya session moko, 1184 octets mpo na clé publique. Session efutamaka na contact ya liboso; na sima eza zéro.
crypto.h6l3: Mopanzi ya mosaleli: `pqcrypto` Python ensemble na `kem.ml_kem_768`. Côté client: liboqs via ba liaisons ya plateforme.
crypto.h7p1: Double Ratchet ya Signal (ndenge elakisami na spec public ya 2016). Esangisaka trichette Diffie-Hellman na monyololo ya bafungola ya symétrique.
crypto.h7p2: Esalemaka mpo na: ba messages directs entre ba appareils mibale. Ba chambre ya groupe esalela schéma ya "fungola ya motindi" ya pete oyo ekangami na mosisa ya chambre.
crypto.h7p3: Propriétés : sekele ya liboso (ko compromettre appareil e exposer kaka ba messages oyo esi ezui, oyo ya mikolo ekoya te), sécurité après compromis (re-ratcheting heals après compromis clé), livraison hors commande (jusqu’à 1000 messages ya saut).
crypto.h7p4: Misala na biso ezali na `app/security/double_ratchet.py` mpe `ios/Modules/Sources/Chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.swift` / `android/app/src/main/.../chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.kt`.
crypto.h7l1: Capuchon ya longueur ya chaîne: 1000 messages par chaîne avant re-ratchet forcé. Ezali kopekisa kobebisama oyo euti na fungola ya monyololo oyo bayibi.
crypto.h7l2: Cache ya ba touches skipped: kino 1000 touches hors ordre oyo ebombami na mémoire na chaîne moko. Longola yango nsango yango eboyami lokola ya kala.
crypto.h7l3: Encryption ya motó: na ndenge ya libela. Motó ya likambo ememaka ba métadonnées ya ratchet mpe ezali chiffré na fungola ya motó oyo epesameli oyo euti na misisa na nzela ya HKDF.
crypto.h8: BLAKE3 hashing mpo na ba fichiers
crypto.h8p1: Identité ya fichier non cryptographique mpe intégrité esalela BLAKE3 mpo ezali 10× mbangu koleka SHA-256 na ba blobs ya minene.
crypto.h8p2: Esalemi mpo na: colonne ya fichier `sha256` na DB (kombo ya histoire; ya solo BLAKE3 na se ya capote banda v0.1.2), dédup ya attachement, vérification ya intégrité ya fichier-upload.
crypto.h8p3: Posture ya sécurité: BLAKE3 ezali makasi na cryptographie (256-bit); tobengi colonne `sha256` mpo na compatibilité ya migration kaka.
crypto.h9p1: Ba nonces nionso, ba prékeys, ba valeurs ya défi esalemi na nzela ya OS RNG: `SecRandom` na iOS, `java.security.SecureRandom` na Android, `secrets.token_bytes` na Python (ko envelopper `/dev/urandom` to équivalent).
crypto.h9p2: Jamais `random.random ()`, jamais `Math.random ()`, jamais `rand ()`. Mibeko ya Lint epekisi bosaleli na yango na ba modules crypto.
crypto.h10p1: HMAC bokokanisi, botalisi ya signature, botalisi ya hash ya mot de passe — nyonso esalelaka ba primitifs ya tango ya ntango nyonso mpo na kopekisa ba canaux côtés ya tango.
crypto.h10p2: Python: `hmac.kokanisa_digest`. Swift: Mosungi ya `Kokokanisa ntango ya ntango nyonso`. Kotlin: `MessageDigest.ezali ndenge moko`.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 ezali Diffie-Hellman ya courbe elliptique likolo ya Curve25519 na lolenge na yango ya Montgomery. Ba touches ya 32 octets, secret ya 32 octets oyo bakabolaka. Clé privée nionso / identité ya dispositif statique / clé ya session na Vortex esalela yango.
crypto.h1_b: Alice na Bob moko na moko azali na ba touches privées a, b mpe ba touches publiques A = a·G, B = b·G esika G ezali point de base ya courbe. Bazali kosala calcul ya s = a·B = b·A. Sekele oyo ya 32 octets oyo bakabolaka ekendaka na HKDF-SHA256 mpo na kozwa ba touches symétriques AES-GCM. Arithmétique ya courbe esalemaka na tango constant na kosalelaka escalier ya Montgomery; ba branches ezali te na ba données secretes.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 ebimisamaki na Daniel J. Bernstein na 2005 mpe eponami na IETF na RFC 7748 (2016). Ezwami na Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard. Vortex esalela yango mpo ezali mbangu koleka P-256, ezali na taille ya clé ya 32 octets ya seresere, ekimi ba soucis ya courbe NIST, mpe plateforme nionso etindi mise en œuvre oyo ekómi makasi.
crypto.h1_f:
Fungola ya moto ye moko: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 octets little-endian) .
Fungola ya bato nyonso: A = a · G (point comprimé ya 32 octets) .
Sekele ya kokabola: s = a · B = b · A (32 octets, →HKDF bokɔti)
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 ezali ndeko ya signature ya X25519, kosalelaka courbe moko na forme na yango ya torsion-Edwards. Ba clés publiques ya 32 octets, ba signature ya 64 octets, déterministe par défaut.
crypto.h2_b: Pona ko signer message m na clé privée d : calculer r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. Sinyatili ezali (R, S). Vérification : vérifier R + c·A = S·G. Signature déterministe ekimi risque ya kosalela lisusu te mobimba — ba signature mibale ya message moko na clé moko ezali bit-identique.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) ebimaki na mokanda ya Bernstein ya 2011 elongo na Duif, Lange, Schwabe, mpe Yang. Ezwami mingi sima ya 2013. CryptoKit ya Apple, Tink ya Google, libsodium, OpenSSH nionso esalelaka yango. Vortex a signer enveloppe nionso ya fédération na attestation nionso ya noeud na Ed25519.
crypto.h2_f:
Elembo(d, m): r = SHA-512(d∥m);  R = r·G ezali na kati
              c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  S = r + c·a, oyo ezali na kati
              zonga (R, S) .

Botalisi: c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
crypto.h3_a: AES na Mode Galois/Computer. Ba touches ya 256 bits, ba nonces ya 96 bits aléatoires, ba balises ya authentification ya 128 bits. Blob nionso chiffré na Vortex esalela GCM.
crypto.h3_b: GCM ezo tambola AES na mode CTR pe ezo calculer GHASH likolo ya texte chiffre + AAD na kosalelaka clé différente oyo ezuami na clé ya chiffrement. Tag = GHASH(AAD, makomi ya chiffre) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Déchiffrement ezo ré-computer GHASH pe ekokanisi — bit-flip nionso moko elongi te vérification. Matériel-accelré na chaque moderne CPU via AES-NI to ARMv8-A crypto extensions.
crypto.h3_c: AES alongaki momekano ya NIST AES na 2001. GCM ezalaki standardisé na NIST SP 800-38D na 2007 mpe ezali AEAD par défaut na TLS 1.3. Vortex aponaka ba touches ya 256 bits atako 128-bit ekokaki contre ba ennemis classiques — saut na 256-bit epesi biso environ 128 bits ya sécurité post-quantique sous algorithme ya Grover.
crypto.h3_f:
Encrypter(k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR (k, n, pt) Ezali na ntina mingi kozala na bomoi ya malamu.
                          tag = GHASH_h(aad∥ct∥lente) ⊕ AES(k, n∥1) Ezali na ba mbongo mingi te.
                          zongisa ct∥tag
Nonce kosalela lisusu ⇒ sekele + bosolo ebukani.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC-based KDF, RFC 5869) ebongoli fungola moko na ebele. Ezuaka entrée ya entropie ya likolo na étiquette ya contexte; ebimisaka 32 octets na étiquette moko.
crypto.h4_b: Matambe mibale: Kobimisa mpe Kopanzana. Extrait = HMAC-SHA256(mungwa, IKM) → PRK. Panza = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥counter) ekangami mpo na ba octets ya len. Tosalelaka yango pona kokabola sortie X25519 na clé ya chiffrement, clé MAC, pe clé ya tête na ba chaînes ya info "v1:encryption", "v1:mac", "v1:header".
crypto.h4_c: HKDF ebimisamaki na Hugo Krawczyk na EUROCRYPT 2010 mpe e standardisé lokola RFC 5869 na 2010. Esalemi na TLS 1.3 mpo na programme na yango, na Signal for Double Ratchet, na WireGuard mpo na ba clés ya session. Versioning na ba chaînes ya info e permettre biso to roter hiérarchie ya clé mobimba na ko bumping "v1" → "v2".
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(mungwa, IKM) .
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ info ∥ i) Ezali ndenge moko na ba .
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... ekatami na ba octets ya len
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id ezali hash ya mot de passe oyo ezali na mémoire makasi oyo ebongisami mpo na koboya ba attaquants GPU mpe ASIC. Ba paramètres m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id esangisaka Argon2i (etelemela ba canaux côtés na ko brancher te na ba données dérivées na mot de passe) na Argon2d (etondisaka mémoire imprévisiblement donc matériel parallèle ekoki kokata ba coins te). Demi-passe ya liboso ezali indépendant ya ba données (mode i); reste ezali dépendant ya ba données (mode d). 0,5 secondes ya calcul na iPhone X na ba paramètres na biso, environ 5 ms na ASIC — vitesse ya ~100× ezali moke soki tokokanisi yango na ba hashes basées na SHA-256 esika ba ASICs elongi na 1 000 000×.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 elongaki Concours ya Hashing ya mot de passe na 2015 oyo ebongisamaki na Dmitry Khovratovich na Alex Biryukov. Standardisé lokola RFC 9106 na 2021. Esalemi na 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Ba paramètres ya Vortex ewuti na ba recommandations ya OWASP 2023, oyo ebongwani mpo na kosala login na dispositif na biso oyo esungami malembe (iPhone X) na se ya 1 seconde.
crypto.h5_f:
motuya(m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ≈ 0,5 s na iPhone X
motuya ya mobundi: m × t × (p / parallèlisme_ya_attaque)
Na 1010 devinette/s na entropie ya mot de passe ya 40 bits:
  1012 secondes = mbula 32 000
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) ezali mécanisme ya encapsulation ya clé post-quantique oyo esalemi na NIST-standardisé. Epesaka ba clés ya session quantique-safe esangani na X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Alice azali kobimisa (pk, sk). Bob abengi Encapsuler(pk) → (c, ss) oyo ezali na kati; atindi c epai ya Alice. Alice abengi Décapsulate(sk, c) → ss. Ba côtés nionso mibale bakabolaka sikoyo ss, secret ya 32 octets. Bobateli ekiti na mokakatano ya Module-LWE, oyo bakanisaka ete ezali quantum-hard. Tosangisaka yango na X25519: fungola_ya session = HKDF(x25519_sortie ∥ kyber_output). Soki ndambo moko to mosusu ebiki, session yango ebiki.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber aponama na NIST na sanza ya nsambo 2022 sima ya momekano ya mibu 6. Standardisé lokola FIPS 203 na août 2024. Vortex etindi Kyber lokola optionnel mpo ebakisi ~2 KB par session handshake; efungolami na ndenge ya libela mpo na ba niveaux oyo efutami, opt-in esika mosusu. Approche hybride e recommandé na Signal na 2023 mpe e adopter na Chrome na 2024.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B. Ezali na ntina mingi kozala na bomoi ya malamu
Encaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B. Ezali na ba mbongo mingi te
Ba décaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256
session hybride = HKDF(x25519_kobima ∥ kyber_kobima, info="session-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Double Ratchet ya Signal epesaka sekele ya liboso mpe bokengi ya sima ya boyokani mpo na masolo ya 1:1.
crypto.h7_b: Minyɔlɔlɔ mibale: monyololo ya kotinda mpe monyololo ya koyamba. Message moko na moko e avancé chaîne na yango via HKDF. Mbala na mbala, ratchet ya Diffie-Hellman ekendeke liboso na mosisa, kozongela kofungola minyɔlɔlɔ nyonso mibale. Compromis ya clé ya chaîne e exposer kaka ba messages oyo e chiffré directement. Sima ya DH ratchet, ba messages ya mikolo ekoya ezalaka sûr ata soki attaquant ayibi clé ya chaîne.
crypto.h7_c: Esalemi na Trevor Perrin mpe Moxie Marlinspike na 2013, etiamaki na Signal 2014, ezwamaki na WhatsApp (2016), Masolo ya sekele ya Facebook Messenger, Masolo ya sekele ya Skype. Public spec na 2016. Misala ya Vortex ezali port direct; interop na ba clients mosusu ya Signal-protocol ezali na feuille de route v0.4.
crypto.h7_f:
tinda: CK = HKDF(CK, "litambe");  MK = HKDF(CK, "nsango")
kozwa: CK' = HKDF(CK', "litambe"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "nsango")
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(eph_na biso, eph_na bango), RK_ya liboso)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing mpo na ba fichiers — eteni ya mokapo ya crypto. Oyo ezali moko ya ba mécanismes ya moboko oyo etalisami na référence mobimba ya Vortex. Tángá mokapo oyo ezali zingazinga mpo na koyeba makambo oyo ezali na kati; eteni oyo ezali kosala zoom na bizaleli ya sikisiki.
crypto.h8_b: Botali ya bosaleli mpo na "BLAKE3 hashing mpo na ba fichiers". Mecanisme esalemi na module oyo ekokani na se ya `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, to `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README ebengaka banzela ya sikisiki ya ba fichiers.
crypto.h8_c: Mecanisme ya "BLAKE3 hashing pona ba fichiers" evoluaki na kati ya ba sorties Vortex. Bokeli yango ebandi na bolukiluki mpe misala ya kobimisa oyo ebimisamaki ya bamemi-nsango ya kala. Histoire ya version na `CHANGELOG.md` ekomaka tango pièce moko na moko ekita pe nini e motiver yango.
crypto.h9_a: Génération ya nombre aléatoire — eteni ya mokapo ya crypto. Oyo ezali moko ya ba mécanismes ya moboko oyo etalisami na référence mobimba ya Vortex. Tángá mokapo oyo ezali zingazinga mpo na koyeba makambo oyo ezali na kati; eteni oyo ezali kosala zoom na bizaleli ya sikisiki.
crypto.h9_b: Botali ya bosaleli mpo na "Génération ya nombre aléatoire". Mecanisme esalemi na module oyo ekokani na se ya `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, to `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README ebengaka banzela ya sikisiki ya fisyé.
crypto.h9_c: Mecanisme ya "Génération ya nombre aléatoire" evoluaki na kati ya ba sorties Vortex. Bokeli yango ebandi na bolukiluki mpe misala ya kobimisa oyo ebimisamaki ya bamemi-nsango ya kala. Histoire ya version na `CHANGELOG.md` ekomaka tango pièce moko na moko ekita pe nini e motiver yango.
crypto.h10_a: Misala ya ntango nyonso — eteni ya mokapo ya crypto. Oyo ezali moko ya ba mécanismes ya moboko oyo etalisami na référence mobimba ya Vortex. Tángá mokapo oyo ezali zingazinga mpo na koyeba makambo oyo ezali na kati; eteni oyo ezali kosala zoom na bizaleli ya sikisiki.
crypto.h10_b: Botali ya bosaleli mpo na "Misala ya tango ya ntango nyonso". Mecanisme esalemi na module oyo ekokani na se ya `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, to `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README ebengaka banzela ya sikisiki ya fisyé.
crypto.h10_c: Mecanisme ya "Opérations à temps constant" evoluaki na kati ya ba sorties Vortex. Bokeli yango ebandi na bolukiluki mpe misala ya kobimisa oyo ebimisamaki ya bamemi-nsango ya kala. Histoire ya version na `CHANGELOG.md` ekomaka tango pièce moko na moko ekita pe nini e motiver yango.

cryptoWire.title: Ba formats ya fil crypto
cryptoWire.subtitle: Ba layouts ya octets ya sikisiki pona blob nionso chiffré.
cryptoWire.intro: Mokapo oyo ezali kolimbola ba octets oyo ezali na nsinga. Moto nyonso oyo azali kosalela client alternatif to esaleli ya forensic akoki kotanga elongo.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Bokeli: `{v:1, nonce:<hex ya 12 octets>, texte chiffre:<hex ya variable>, pseudo_ya_motindi:<32-hex>, atindami_na:<unix_ms>}`. Etindami likolo ya HTTPS (POST) mpe WebSocket (lolenge ya cadre `m`).
cryptoWire.h1p2: `ciphertext` contenus sima ya AES-GCM déchiffrement: CBOR `{v:1, texte?:<string>, ba pièces jointes?:[<id_fisyé>, ...], eyano_na?:<msg_id>, ebongoli?:[<texte_ya liboso>, ...], elobeli?:[<id_ya_mosaleli>, ...]}`.
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag ezali kolanda: `ciphertext` molongo ya ba octets ezali (charge utile chiffrée || tag ya 16 octets). Client akabwani na bolai.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: id ya salle hexagonal ya makomi mike elekisami lokola ba données associées. Kokangisa id ya chambre epekisaka cross-room replay.
cryptoWire.h2p1: Fungola ya misisa ya fisyé ezali ya kozanga kokana 32 octets. Fungola moko na eteni moko: `HKDF(mosisa, info: "fisyé:eteni:" + <offset>, lent: 32)`.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Texte chiffre ya eteni: AES-GCM na fungola ya eteni moko, nonce ya 96 bits ya pamba pamba, AAD: `<id_fisyé> || <offset>`. Max taille ya chunk 512 KiB.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Intégrité ya fichier mobimba : client a calculer BLAKE3 likolo ya texte ya pamba mpe atindaka lokola `plain_blake3` na moyambi na nzela ya message ya chambre. Recipient a re-computer sima ya téléchargement mpe a vérifier.
cryptoWire.h3p1: Client azali ko uploader `p256dh_pub` (32 octets X25519) na node.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Tango push moko esengeli, node ebimisaka clé X25519 éphémère, esalaka DH na `p256dh_pub`, ezuaka clé AES-GCM via HKDF.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Blob oyo ekangami: `{point ya suka, p256dh: pub ya client, auth: 16 octets, ba données: chiphertext||tag}`. Ba APN/FCM tala kaka `donnée`.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Client a déchiffrer sur receive en utilisant clé privée na ye na `p256dh` (oyo ezali vraiment pub éphémère ya noeud na enveloppe).
cryptoWire.h4p1: Mot de passe ezuaka clé ya sauvegarde na nzela ya Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, mungwa=<16B aléatoire>, hashLen=32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{mungwa, nonce, texte chiffre}`. Chiffretexte ezali CBOR ya `{v:1, ba chambre:[{id,fungola,ct_refs}...], profil:{...}, ba contacts:[...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Ebombami soit na esika (iCloud / Google Drive) to na node moko na chambre privée ya mosaleli.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Message ya cross-node: `{source_node: <pubkey>, cible_user: <id>, ya kati: {... ndenge moko na enveloppe ya chambre ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` ezipi CBOR-sérielisé `{node_ya_source, mosaleli_ya_cible, ya kati}`. Cible e vérifier contre pubkey ya `source_node` uta na `trusted_nodes`.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Message ya chambre moko na fil ezali dict CBOR na charge utile chiffrée, nonce, pseudonyme ya motindi, mpe timbre ya temps. Enveloppe ezali ndenge moko ezala emati HTTPS (POST) to WebSocket (type ya cadre `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Client azali ko sérialiser nzoto ya message `{v:1, texte, réponse_na, kotinda_na}` lokola CBOR → `pt`. Ezali kobimisa nonce ya 12 octets ya kozanga kokana. Ezali kosala calcul ya `aad = hex (id_ya_shambre)`. Ebengi `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt (fungola_ya_shambre, nonce, pt, aad)`. Ezali kozinga na `{v:1, chiphertext: hex (ct), nonce: hex (nonce), motindi_pseudo: hex (pseudo), kotinda_na: unix_ms}` mpe kotinda. Moyambi azali ko vérifier tag GCM na tango ya ko déchiffrer, sima CBOR-a parser texte ya pamba.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Shape ya fil ezali version-tagged banda v0.0.4 sima ya sortie abortive v0.0.3 oyo ezalaki na champ `v` te — tosengelaki ko bump format mobimba tango tobakisaki `thread_id` mpo ba clients ya kala ba crasher na clé oyo eyebani te. Liteya oyo ezuami : forme nionso ya fil ya mikolo ekoya ememaka `v:N` na domaine na yango ya liboso donc compatibilité avant ezali explicite.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Ba fichiers ekabolami na biteni ya taille fixe, moko na moko ezali na fungola na yango oyo euti na misisa ya fisyé mpe na offset ya biteni. Encryption par-chunk e permettre motindi a pause/resume na ndelo nionso ya chunk.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Fungola ya misisa ya fisyé ezali ya kozanga kokana 32 octets. Fungola moko na eteni moko ezali `HKDF(mosisa, info="fisyé:eteni:" + str(offset), len=32)`. Chunk moko na moko ezali AES-GCM chiffré na clé na yango moko, nonce ya 96 bits aléatoire, mpe `aad = file_id ∥ offset`. Ba chunks na défaut na 512 KiB; 4 Capuchon ya MiB. Fichier mobimba BLAKE3 etindami lokola `plain_blake3` na message ya chambre oyo ezo référer na fichier po ba récepteurs bakoka ko vérifier sima ya déchiffrement.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chiffrement E2E chunked na ba clés par chunk ezalaki pionnier na Mega.nz na 2013 mpe e refiné na soutien ya fichier munene ya Signal na 2019. Vortex ya 512 KiB par défaut ezali taille oyo contrôle ya débit TCP e garder tuyau plein sans mikila milayi na 4G mobile. Tomekaki 256/512/1024/4096 KiB mpe 512 ezalaki esika ya sukali na ba mesures na biso.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Enveloppe ya poussée oyo ekangami ebombaka charge utile ya notification na Apple / Google / Mozilla na ko chiffrer na clé X25519 spécifique ya dispositif.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Client akomisaka `p256dh_pub` na `auth` na node. Tango poussée moko esengeli, node ezo tambola éphémère-ECDH na p256dh_pub, e dériver clé + nonce via HKDF na secret auth lokola mungwa. Ezali ko chiffrer `{titre, nzoto, id_ya chambre, id_ya message}` na AES-GCM. Etindi enregistrement lokola esika ya `données` opaque na fournisseur ya push. Extension ya dispositif ezo dériver, ezo déchiffrer, ezo rendre.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Push oyo ekangami ezali spec ya Encryption ya Message ya Push Web (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple a adoptaki yango na ba Extensions ya Service ya Notification ya iOS 16. Yambo ete push scellée ekomaki ko soutenir mingi, Signal mpe WhatsApp etindaki ba pings silencieux "eloko ekomaki" sans contenus mpe esalaki que app ezua message na wake-up — oyo ezalaki malembe. Poussée scellée epesaka biso vie privée ya suka na suka plus render instantané.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Blob ya sauvegarde chiffré e permettre usager a zongisa ba clés ya chambre + profil + ewumela mikolo 90 na appareil ya sika à partir ya mot de passe kaka.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Fungola ya sauvegarde ewutaka na mot de passe na nzela ya Argon2id na mungwa ya 16 octets ya pamba pamba. Charge utile ezali CBOR: `{v:1, ba chambre: [{id, fungola, msg_ref_ids}], profil, ba contacts}`. Chiffré na AES-GCM na se ya clé dérivée. Ebombami soit na esika (iCloud / Google Drive) to lokola fichier na salle ya cloud privée ya mosaleli. Bozongisi: kotia mot de passe → Argon2id → ko déchiffrer → ko reimporter ba clés na ba références.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Format yango esalemi na modèle ya OPVault ya 1Password (2013) mpe exportation chiffrée ya Bitwarden (2017). Bango mibale basalelaka KDF-na nsima-AEAD na ba métadonnées oyo esangisi mungwa. Vortex abakisaki trimming ya mikolo 90 mpo ba sauvegarde ya histoire mobimba ezalaki 100 MB+ na test; mingi mingi ya ba restaurations esengeli kaka na ba messages ya sika, mpe contenus ya kala ezali kaka kozuama na nzela ya chiphertext ya serveur tango mosaleli azali na connectivité.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Message ya fédération cross-node enveloppe enveloppe ya kati oyo esi e chiffré na enveloppe ya libanda oyo e signer oyo ezali ko authentiquer noeud ya source.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A e sérialiser `{node_ya_source, mosaleli_ya_cible, ct_ya kati, nonce_ya kati, etindamaki_na}` lokola CBOR. Ezali ko signer na clé na yango ya sortie privée Ed25519 → `sig`. POSTs `{enveloppe, sig}` na `/fédération/déliver` ya node B. B e vérifier `sig` contre pubkey pona `source_node` na `fédérations`, e vérifier timestamp na kati ya fenêtre ya skew ya 5 minutes, sima ekomi chiphertext ya kati na tableau na yango moko `messages` pona mosaleli oyo alingi.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Ba enveloppes ya libanda oyo ezali na signature edefami na spec ya fédération ya Matrix (2015) mpe na ba Signatures HTTP ya ActivityPub (2018). Fenêtre ya 5 minutes ekokani na recommandation ya SMTP RFC 5321 mpe epekisaka ba attaques ya replay esika attaquant akanga fédération moko POST mpe azongeli yango ba heures sima. Vortex aponaki Ed25519 na esika ya RSA-PSS mpo ba signature ya Ed25519 ezali 64 octets vs 256 octets ya RSA-PSS-2048 — etali tango fédération ezali na masolo.
cryptoWire.h2_f:
misisa_ya_fisyé = rand(32) .
fungola_ya_chunk (o) = HKDF(mosisa_ya_fisyé, "fisyé:eteni:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct (o) = AES-GCM (chunk_key (o), rand (12), makomi ya polele, aad = id_ya_fichier ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3(bytes_ya_mokanda_ya_fichier_ya_mokonzi) // etindami lokola plain_blake3
cryptoWire.h3_f:
ya ntango mokuse = (priv, pub);  ikm = ECDH(ephémère.priv, lok.256dh_pub) Ezali na ntina te.
prk = HMAC-SHA256(mokonzi, ikm)
fungola = HKDF-Kopanzana (prk, "Kokɔtisa makambo-ya: aes128gcm\0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Kosala encodage ya makambo: nonce\0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM(fungola, nonce, CBOR{titre, nzoto, id_ya_shambre, id_ya_nsango})
nsinga = mungwa(16) ∥ rs(4) ∥ occupé(1) ∥ éphémère.pub(32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
mungwa = rand(16) .
fungola = Argon2id (mot de passe, mungwa, m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, len = 32)
mbala moko = rand(12) .
ct = AES-GCM(fungola, nonce, CBOR{ba chambre, profil, ba contacts}, aad="vortex-sauvegarde-v1")
fichier = {v:1, mungwa, nonce, ct}.

auth.title: Bondimi ya bondimi
auth.subtitle: Inscrivez-vous, kota, kozongisa sika, kolongolama. JWT + X25519 + fungola ya nzela ya kopona / mboto / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex ebimisaka ba JWT ya ntango mokuse (15 min accès, 30 jours refresh) na clé public X25519 ya mosaleli ekangami na Point final sensible nionso e vérifier JWT + e vérifier que clé elongolami te. Mokapo oyo etali bopanzani nyonso ya nsuka na nsuka.
auth.h1p1: Client abandi na kobimisa clé privée ya sika ya 32 octets X25519 na OS RNG. Ezuaka clé publique, e codaka lokola 64 chars hex.
auth.h1p2: Client atie `POST /api/authentication/register` na `{nkombo ya mosaleli, mot de passe, x25519_fungola_ya bato banso, kombo_ya_elakiseli, telefone, email, avatar_emoji, kyber_fungola_ya bato banso?}`.
auth.h1p3: Node e valider: kombo ya mosaleli ekokani na `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (ba makomi mike mpo na koboya ba squats ya homographe); mot de passe elekaka makasi ya ndenge ya zxcvbn (min score 2); telefone ekokani na E.164 soki epesami; email ekokani RFC 5322 regex ya moboko soki epesami.
auth.h1p4: Node etalaka bokeseni ya `x25519_public_key` — pubkey moko na moko ekoki kokomisa compte moko mpenza. Yango etelemisaka ba attaques ya enregistrement en masse oyo esalelaka lisusu pubkey moko.
auth.h1p5: Node esalaka Argon2id na mot de passe (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) mpe ebombaka `argon2:$...$` na `users.password_hash`.
auth.h1p6: Node e minter ba JWT mibale: accès (15 min, `jti:<id_device>`) na refresh (30 d). Ba réclamations: `{sub: id_ya_mosaleli, jti: id_ya_esaleli, typ: accès|kozongisa sika, exp: ...}`. Signé HS256 na sekele ya serveur ya 64 octets oyo e charger depuis `.env`.
auth.h1p7: Node esali molongo ya `ba dispositif_ya mosaleli`: `{id_ya_mosaleli, id_ya_esaleli, agent_ya_mosaleli, esalemi_na}`. Refresh moko na moko ekangami na device_id na yango; kolongolama ya aparɛyi moko ebomaka kaka mopɛpɛ yango.
auth.h1p8: Eyano: `{ok, id_ya_mosaleli, kombo ya mosaleli, elembo_ya_accès, elembo_ya_kozongisa sika, x25519_fungola_ya_mokonzi, kyber_fungola_ya_etali, nkombo_ya_lakisa, avatar_url, telefone, email}`.
auth.h1p9: Client ebombaka ba jetons na Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Ba cookies ya makasi (web).
auth.h1l1: Limite ya taux: 5 inscriptions na 60 secondes na IP. TESTING=solo e désactiver likambo oyo.
auth.h1l2: Mode ya kobengisa: soki `REGISTRATION_MODE=kobengisa`, nzoto esengeli kozala na `code_invite` ya malamu. Ba codes esalemaka na nzela ya admin API.
auth.h1l3: Mode ya kokangama: `REGISTRATION_MODE=ekangamaki`. Kaka admin ya mboto nde akoki ko inscrire. Ba usagers oyo elandi bakomaka na nzela ya ba liens ya invitation na ba chambres spécifiques.
auth.h2p1: Client a poster `POST /api/authentification/login` na `{nkombo ya mosaleli, mot de passe}`.
auth.h2p2: Node etunaki `basaleli` na nkombo ya mosaleli na makomi mike. Soki ezwami te, ezali kaka kosala vérification ya mannequin Argon2 contre hash constant mpo na ko égaliser timing (~0.5 s soit façon).
auth.h2p3: Soki Argon2 verify elongi mpe compte ezali désactivé te, node ezongisaka enveloppe moko na registre. Molongo ya sika ya `user_devices` esalemi; milɔngɔ oyo ezali etikali yango moko mpo ete mosaleli akoki kokɔta na baaparɛyi mingi.
auth.h2p4: Soki verify elongi te, node ezongisaka 401 na `{error:"ba credentiels invalids"}`. Bokeseni te kati na "nkombo ya mosaleli ya mabe" mpe "mot ya nzela ya mabe" na eyano.
auth.h2l1: Limite ya taux: 10 tentatives oyo elongi te na 60 secondes na IP. Koleka ezongisaka 429 na motó ya `Retry-After`.
auth.h2l2: Blocage ya compte: 20 tentatives oyo elongi te na kati ya 24 h drapeau ya compte pona revue ya admin. Ba usagers ya Legit kaka mot de passe-reset nzela na bango na kati.
auth.h2l3: Bolandi ya session: `/api/authentication/devices` etangi ba sessions nionso oyo ezali kosala; mosaleli akoki kolongolama nyonso.
auth.h3p1: Tango jeton ya accès ezali pene ya kosila (client alandi `exp` na esika) to tango bosengi ezongisi 401 na `token expired`, client atie `POST /api/authentication/refresh` na `{refresh_token}`.
auth.h3p2: Node e décoder refresh, e vérifier `jti` ezali kaka na `user_devices` (elongolami te), e vérifier `exp`, pe e minter jeton ya accès ya sika.
auth.h3p3: Rotation ya refresh ezali off par défaut. Activer na `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` mpo na kobimisa bozongisi ya sika mpe.
auth.h3p4: Soki bozongisi ya sika esili, elongolami, to esalemi na lokuta, node ezongisaka 401. Client abimi na esika na ye mpe akosenga kokota lisusu.
auth.h4p1: Ba clients web bakoki ko enregistrer authenticateur ya plateforme (Touch ID, Elongi ID, Windows Mbote, biométrique Android). Serveur ebombaka `{id_ya_bondimi, fungola_ya bato banso, motángi}`.
auth.h4p2: Kokota: `POST /api/bondimi/fungola ya nzela/banda` → mosaleli ezongisaka mokakatano; ba signes ya client na clé de passe privée (esimbami na Secure Enclave / TPM); `POST /api/authentification/passkey/finish` → serveur e vérifier pe ebimisaka JWT.
auth.h4p3: Vérification ya monotonique ya compteur : vérification nionso esengeli e incrementer compteur. Soki esali bongo te, passe-clé etalemaka lokola cloné mpe eboyami.
auth.h5p1: Lokola nzela ya kozongisama na likama, mosaleli akoki kotinda momboto ya maloba 24 BIP-39. Ko kotisa yango na dispositif nionso ezo reconstruire identité X25519 (seed → HKDF → clé statique) pe ezo prouver possession via défi oyo e signé.
auth.h5p2: Momboto elongwaka ata moke te na aparɛyi yango. Node emonaka kaka clé public X25519 dérivée mpe signature likolo ya défi ya serveur.
auth.h5p3: Entropie: 256 bits (32 octets). BIP-39 checksum ezali standard, yango wana ba typos ekangamaka avant ekoma na serveur.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) na ba étapes ya 30-s na ba codes ya 6 chiffres. Optional na mosaleli moko.
auth.h6p2: Bokomisi nkombo: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` ezongisaka sekele + otpauth URI + QR. Mosaleli azali kosala scanner na Google Authenticateur / Authy / 1Mot de passe. Mosaleli azongisaka nsima ya ndakisa ya code ya 6 chiffres mpo na komonisa ete programɛ yango ezali kosala.
auth.h6p3: Kokota na 2FA: sima ya koleka ya mot de passe, node ezongisaka `{needs_2fa: true}`. Client asengi code mpe atie na `/api/authentication/login/2fa`.
auth.h6p4: Limite ya taux: 5 TOTP tentatives na 5 min na mosaleli moko. Koleka e déclenchaka cooldown ya 60 secondes mpe likebisi ya email.
auth.h6p5: Ba code ya sauvegarde: Ba code ya 12 × 10 chiffres oyo elakisami mbala moko na tango ya bokomisi nkombo. Code mokomoko ekoki kosalelama mbala moko mpenza.
auth.h7p1: Telephone oyo okɔti na site ekoki kokɔtisa tablette ya sika oyo ezali na code QR. Dispositif A etie `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` → serveur ezongisaka nonce moko na TTL.
auth.h7p2: Dispositif A elakisaka QR oyo ezali na `nonce + user_id + server_url`. Dispositif B e scanner pe e poster `POST /api/authentification/qr/verify` na nonce.
auth.h7p3: Serveur e vérifier nonce ezali encore en direct (TTL 60 s, lisasi moko), ekangisaka pubkey ya sika ya X25519 ya dispositif B na compte ya mosaleli A (molongo ya sika ya `user_devices`), mpe ezongisaka JWT na dispositif B.
auth.h7p4: Dispositif A ezuaka WebSocket notification `{type:"n", event:"new_device"}` po mosaleli akoki ko confirmer / ko révoquer na temps réel.
auth.h8p1: Tozongisaka na nko libunga ndenge moko mpo na "kombo ya mosaleli eyebani te" mpe "mot ya nzela ya mabe". Ba limite ya taux ya signature ebombaka ba kombo nini ya basaleli ezali.
auth.h8p2: Ba points ya suka ya profil (`/api/basaleli/{kombo ya mosaleli}`) esengaka auth. Attacker akoki kotanga ba kombo ya basaleli te sans jeton valide.
auth.h8p3: Limite ya taux na `/api/authentication/login` ebatelaka brute force na crawl.
auth.h1_a: Enregistrement esala identité ya sika : X25519 keypair na appareil, hash ya mot de passe Argon2id na serveur, JWT paire ebimi na succès.
auth.h1_b: Etape 1: client azali kosala `crypto.randomBytes(32)` mpo na clé privée X25519, azuaka clé publique (~100 μs na téléphone). Etape 2: POST /api/bondimi/komisa nkombo na `{nkombo ya mosaleli, mot ya nzela, x25519_fungola_ya bato banso, nkombo_ya_alakiseli, telefone, email, avatar_emoji}`. Etape 3 : node e valider via Pydantic (kombo ya mosaleli regex, mot de passe ≥ 8 chars, téléphone E.164, email RFC-5322-lite). Etape 4: node etambolaka Argon2id(mot de passe) → `argon2:...`, ebombaka na `basaleli.mot ya nzela_hash`. Etape 5: node ebimisaka accès JWT (15 min) + refresh JWT (30 jours), e persister na molongo ya `user_devices`.
auth.h1_c: Flux ezali évolution moderne ya époque ya mysql_real_escape_string ya PHP. Stack nionso ya auth ya mikolo oyo — Auth0, Firebase, Supabase — esalaka environ forme oyo. Torsion spécifique na Vortex ezali kotinda pubkey X25519 na appel ya registre : elingi koloba compte ekangami na identité E2E ya long terme à partir ya cadre moko, ebakisami sima te. Inspiré na design ya protocole ya Signal ya 2013.
auth.h2_a: Login e vérifier mot de passe contre hash Argon2 oyo ebombami pe ebimisaka paire JWT ya sika soki ekokani.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/bondimi/kokɔta na `{nkombo ya mosaleli, mot ya nzela}`. Node etunaki `basaleli` na nkombo ya mosaleli na makomi mike. Soki ezwami, e vérifier Argon2id na temps constant contre `users.password_hash`. Soki ezwami te, ezali kaka kosala vérification ya mannequin Argon2 contre chaîne constante mpo na ko égaliser timing. Succès → paire ya sika JWT + molongo ya sika `ba appareils_utilisateurs` (moko na dispositif moko oyo ekoti). Kozanga te → 401 na "ba credentiels invalides" ya générique — bokeseni te kati na kombo ya mosaleli ya mabe mpe mot de passe ya mabe, mpo na kotelemela botangi.
auth.h2_c: Vérification ya temps constant mpe hashing ya mannequin mpo na ba usagers oyo bazali te ezali modèle Signal adopté na 2014 sima ya ba chercheurs kolakisa enumeration ya temps na point fin ya login na bango. Banda wana e adopter mingi — django-axes, authelia, Keycloak nionso esalelaka yango. Momesano ebakisi ~0.5 s na komeka nyonso ya kokota oyo elongi te, oyo ezali malamu; to rate-limit login na 10/min/IP de toute façon.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id ("__equaliser_ya_timing__", mungwa=ebongwani, ...)

kokota (u, p): .
  molongo = basaleli.luka(nkombo ya mosaleli=u.na nse ())
  soki molongo ezali Te:
      Argon2Verify (dummy_hash, p) // kokokanisa ntango
      kotombola 401
  soki te Argon2Verify (molongo.mot ya nzela_hash, p):
      kotombola 401
  zongisa issue_jwt(molongo)
auth.h3_a: Ba jetons ya accès esili sima ya 15 minutes. Refresh echanger jeton ya refresh oyo ewumeli mingi na jeton ya accès ya sika sans kosenga lisusu mosaleli mot de passe na ye.
auth.h3_b: Client alandaka `exp` na esika. Tango `sikoyo + 30s > exp`, to tango bosengi ezongisaka 401 na `token_expired`, client a POST jeton ya bozongisi na `/api/authentication/refresh`. Node e décoder, e vérifier `jti` ezali na `user_devices` et non `revoked_at`, e vérifier `exp`, pe e minter jeton ya sika ya accès ya 15 minutes. Rotation ya refresh ezali opt-in via `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` — off par défaut mpo rotation ya ba jetons ya refresh na refresh nionso ya accès esala course tango ba clients mibale ba refresher mbala moko.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) ekotisaki bokabwani ya accès + refresh. Bomoi ya bozwi ya miniti 15 ezali mediane na kati ya industrie — Google esalela ngonga 1, Auth0 esalelaka ngonga 24 na ndenge ya libela, Okta na ngonga 1. To ponaki 15 min pona ko minimiser fenêtre pendant oyo jeton d'accès oyo bayibi ezalaka utile. Kozongisa sika mikolo 30 ekokani na oyo mingi ya ba applis mobiles esengeli mpo na kobatela basaleli na kati na boumeli ya sanza moko ya kozanga kosala.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / login ya clé de passe esalela authenticateur ya plateforme (Touch ID, Elongi ID, Windows Mbote, biométrique Android) na esika ya mot de passe.
auth.h4_b: Inscription: serveur atie défi; authenticateur ya client ebimisaka clé ya sika na kati ya enclave na yango ya sécurité mpe etindi lisusu clé publique + attestation. Serveur ebombaka `{id_ya_bondimi, fungola_ya bato banso, motángi}`. Bokoti: `POST /api/bondimi/fungola ya nzela/banda` → mosaleli ezongisaka mokakatano; client a signer na clé privée ya authenticateur (esimbami na Secure Enclave, etikaka puce jamais); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → serveur e vérifier signature contre clé public oyo ebombami. Compteur monotonique e détecter ba authenticateurs clones.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn ezalaki standardisé na W3C na 2019 sima ya ba mbula ya mosala na Alliance FIDO. Apple abakisaki lisungi ya plateforme-authenticateur na iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Mot ya nzela elandaki. Vortex ezwaki WebAuthn na v0.0.8. Ezali optionnel kasi recommandé makasi — basaleli ya clé ya passe bamonaka ata moke te bozui ya compte basé na phishing mpo clé privée ekatisaka jamais ndelo ya dispositif.
auth.h5_a: Bozongisi ya fraze ya mboto etongaka lisusu identité X25519 na dispositif ya sika à partir ya mnémonique BIP-39 ya maloba 24. Jamais esengaka serveur asimba matériel moko ya déchiffrement.
auth.h5_b: Mosaleli akomaka mnémonique na lancement ya liboso (optionnel, prompt ya mbala moko). Pona ko récupérer : na appareil ya sika, usager akoti na mnémonique; client azali kosala PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(mnémonique, "mnémonique", 2048 tours) → 64 octets ya mboto. Ba octets 32 ya liboso ya mboto ekomi clé privée X25519; clé public ezali dérivée. Serveur eyebisami kaka clé publique ya sika; yango e vérifier possession na challenge-response ya Ed25519 (signé nonce), sima ebimisaka ba JWT.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Proposition ya amélioration ya Bitcoin 39, 2013) ezali lolenge ya canonique ya ko encoder ba secrets cryptographiques lokola ba listes ya maloba oyo ekoki kobosana te. Diksionɛrɛ ya Lingelesi ya maloba 2048 oyo ezali na checksum ya 4 octets na nsuka. Vortex esalela maloba 24 mpo norme ya industrie mpo na ba portefeuilles ya sécurité makasi (Trezor, Ledger) ezali 24. Maloba 12 ekokaki mpo na sécurité ya 128 bits kasi emonanaka substantielle te mpo na basaleli mingi.
auth.h5_f:
maloba = BIP39_Encode(entropie=256_bits + 8_bits_checksum)
mboto = PBKDF2-SHA512(maloba, "mnémonique", ba rond=2048, len=64)
sk = mboto[0:32] // X25519 ya moto ye moko
pk = sk · G // X25519 ya bato banso
auth.h6_a: Bondimi ya makambo mibale ebakisi litambe ya mot de passe ya mbala moko (TOTP) oyo esalemi na tango sima ya botalisi mot de passe.
auth.h6_b: Bokomisi nkombo: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → serveur ebimisaka sekele ya 160 bits ya kozanga kokana, ezongisaka yango lokola molongo ya base32 + otpauth:// URI mpo na scanner ya QR. Mosaleli azali kosala scanner na Google Authenticateur / Authy / 1Mot de passe; postes back un échantillon code ya 6 chiffres pona ko prouver setup esalaki. Bokoti: sima ya koleka ya mot de passe, serveur ezongisaka `{needs_2fa: true}` na esika ya ba JWT. Client asengi code ya 6 chiffres na ba POSTs `/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Serveur e vérifier HOTP(sekele, T=sikoyo_unix / 30) contre code.
auth.h6_c: TOTP ezalaki standardisé lokola RFC 6238 na 2011 na Mark Pei. Yambo na yango, RSA SecurID ezalaki kosalela algorithme propriétaire; sima, app nionso ya 2FA e se installer na TOTP. Etape ya Vortex ya 30 secondes mpe bolai ya 6 chiffres ezali ba RFC par défaut. Ba code ya sauvegarde (12 × 10 chiffres, elakisami mbala moko) edefami na design ya GitHub kobanda 2012.
auth.h6_f:
sekele = rand(20 octets) // 160 bits na RFC 6238
TOTP(sekele, t) = HOTP(sekele, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP(k, c) = kokata( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106

fenêtre: ±1 étape toléré mpo na skew ya montre
auth.h7_a: QR login ezo coupler appareil ya sika na compte oyo ezali sans ko koma lisusu mot de passe. Telephone oyo esi okɔti na site e signer nonce oyo appareil ya sika esalela mpo na ko authentiquer.
auth.h7_b: Dispositif A etie `/api/bondimi/qr/ebandi`. Serveur ebimisaka nonce ya 128 bits na TTL 60s, ekangisaka yango na user_id ya A, ezongisaka yango. A elakisaka nonce oyo e codé lokola QR (ezali na `nonce + user_id + server_url`). Dispositif B e scanner, e poster `/api/authentification/qr/verify` na nonce. Serveur: nonce valide mpe ya mbala moko? Associer B ya sika X25519 pubkey na user_id (ya sika `user_devices` molongo), mint JWTs mpo na B. Dispositif A ezwi WebSocket notification mpo mosaleli akoki komona mpe optionnellement kolongolama.
auth.h7_c: QR-based pairing esalemaki mpo na mbala ya liboso na WhatsApp Web na 2015. Telegram elandaki; Signal e copiaki yango mpo na soutien na bango ya ba dispositifs ebele na 2021. Torsion ya Vortex : événement moko na moko ya couplage ebimaka na dispositif original na bouton "confirm", donc attaquant oyo azui QR na capture d'écran akoki kosilisa couplage te sans interaction ya usager na dispositif A.
auth.h8_a: Résistance ya enumeration ya compte — eteni ya mokapo ya auth. Oyo ezali moko ya ba mécanismes ya moboko oyo etalisami na référence mobimba ya Vortex. Tángá mokapo oyo ezali zingazinga mpo na koyeba makambo oyo ezali na kati; eteni oyo ezali kosala zoom na bizaleli ya sikisiki.
auth.h8_b: Botali ya bosaleli pona "Resistance ya botangi ya compte". Mecanisme esalemi na module oyo ekokani na se ya `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, to `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README ebengaka banzela ya sikisiki ya fisyé.
auth.h8_c: Mecanisme ya "Resistance ya enumération ya compte" evoluaki na kati ya ba sorties Vortex. Bokeli yango ebandi na bolukiluki mpe misala ya kobimisa oyo ebimisamaki ya bamemi-nsango ya kala. Histoire ya version na `CHANGELOG.md` ekomaka tango pièce moko na moko ekita pe nini e motiver yango.

rooms.title: Ba chambre na ba messages
rooms.subtitle: Mitindo minei ya ba chambre, membre, rotation ya ba clés, ba messages.
rooms.intro: Lolenge nyonso minei ya bashambre — DM, groupe privé, groupe public, chaîne — bakabolaka mesa moko ya `ba chambre` oyo ezali na se. Comportement ezali gated na ba drapeaux boolean.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: exactement ba membres mibale, `ezali_dm=solo`, `ezali_privé=solo`. Kombo auto-set na manche ya membre mosusu.
rooms.h1p2: **Etuluku ya privé**: kobengisa-kaka, `ezali_privé=solo`, `ezali_channel=lokuta`. Max 5000 membres par défaut.
rooms.h1p3: **Lisanga ya bato banso**: `ezali_privé=lokuta`. Moto nyonso oyo azali na lien ya invitation akoki kosangana; oyo etangami na répertoire public soki nkolo a opter.
rooms.h1p4: **Channel**: bopanzi sango-kaka, `ezali_channel=solo`. Kaka ba propriétaires/admins nde bakoki ko poster; bandimi ya mbala na mbala batángaka.
rooms.h2p1: Misala: `nkolo`, `mokambi`, `mosangani`. Kaka nkolo moko na chambre moko (assignable).
rooms.h2p2: Ba administrateurs bakoki ko inviter, ko kick, ko muter, pe ko modifier ba paramètres ya salle. Ba membres bakoki kotinda ba messages, ko réagir, ko modifier bango moko, ko supprimer bango moko.
rooms.h2p3: Permissions cascade: ba propriétaires baza na pouvoir ya admin nionso. Ba administrateurs bakoki ko démoter propriétaire te.
rooms.h2p4: Mbongwana ya mokumba ebimisaka nsango ya système (`lolenge: "role_changed"`) oyo emonanaka na mosangani nyonso.
rooms.h3p1: Salle moko na moko ezali na **fungola ya misisa** ya 32 octets oyo esalemi na bokeli na nzela ya `secrets.token_bytes(32)` na dispositif ya mokeli.
rooms.h3p2: Membre moko na moko azuaka enveloppe `{member_id, enveloppe: X25519_encrypt(member_pubkey, root_key)}` oyo ebombami na `room_keys`.
rooms.h3p3: Tango membre moko akoti, enveloppe ya sika esalemi pona bango na client nionso ya membre oyo azali. Minting ya enveloppe ezali O(1) na joint moko.
rooms.h3p4: Tango membre abimi, chambre ebalukaka : mokeli (to admin actif ya liboso) azuaka misisa ya sika, azongeli enveloppe na ba membres oyo batikali, a poster `{type:"k", chambre:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` via WebSocket. Chiphertext ya kala etikalaka kotangama na clé ya kala oyo ba clients bazali kaka na cache.
rooms.h3l1: Variant-B key publish: pona ba salles publiques na > 1000 membres, ba enveloppes etika ko échelle. Na esika na yango, nkolo atie sinyatili mpe abimisi fungola ya misisa ya lelo na tableau `room_public_keys`. Ba clients ba vérifier signature contre pubkey ya propriétaire ya chambre. Rotation na conge ya membre ezali donc no-op pona ba salles ya Variant-B.
rooms.h3l2: Pseudo par chambre : chambre moko na moko ezali pe na `chambre_pseudo_salt`. Ba pseudonymes ya membre na ba messages ezali `HMAC-SHA256(salt, user_id)` truncés na 16 chars hexagoliques. Node ekoki koyeba te mosaleli nini atindaki message nini sans cartographie côté client.
rooms.h4p1: Ba messages ezali na ba ID monotoniques na chambre moko (auto-increment ya 64 bits, `bigserial` na Postgres, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` na SQLite).
rooms.h4p2: Kosala komande ezali oyo serveur azali kopesa. Ba clients babundaka te mpo na ba timestamps; ba rendre na ordre ID pe ba lakisa temps ya montre mur ya motindi lokola ba métadonnées UI kaka.
rooms.h4p3: Bobongisi: makomi ya sika ya cipher ezwi esika ya bozongisi ya kala na esika, `edited_at`. Ba clients balakisi elembo ya `(ebongisami)`.
rooms.h4p4: Elongolami: tia `elongolami_na`, null out chiphertext. `{type:"m", elongolami:solo}` emission.
rooms.h4p5: Biyano: `reply_to` = id ya nsango oyo etalisami. Ba clients ba rendre tête ya devis ya muke.
rooms.h5p1: Ba réactions ezali ba lignes na `ba réactions(id_message, id_ya mosaleli, emoji, created_at)`. Ba POST ya client `/api/ba messages/{id}/ba réactions/{emoji}`. DELETE mpo na ba un-réaction.
rooms.h5p2: Node fans libanda `{type:"m", réactions:[...]}` na abonné nionso. Ba clients ba aggregaka.
rooms.h5p3: Epekiseli moko te na emoji — Unicode nyonso. Ba clients ba de-dupe pe ba rendre ba comptes.
rooms.h6p1: Nsinga ezali pseudo-shambre oyo ezwami na misisa na nsango. `POST /api/messages/{id}/thread` esali `{id: <id_ya_shambre_ya sika>, id_ya_message_ya_moboti: <id_ya_msg>, id_ya_shambre_ya moboti: <original>}`.
rooms.h6p2: Ba salles ya thread e hériter membres na parent. Membre nionso ya parent-room akoki ko poster na thread nionso.
rooms.h6p3: Dérivation ya fungola: fungola ya misisa ya nsinga = `HKDF(mosisa_ya_moboti, info: "nsinga:" + <id_ya_nsango_ya_moboti>, len: 32)`. Compromis ya clé ya thread ezo fuite te parent.
rooms.h7: Ba messages oyo ekangami na pin
rooms.h7p1: Ba administrateurs bakoki ko piner jusqu'à 10 messages par chambre. `POST /api/ba chambre/{id}/pin` na `{id_ya_message}`.
rooms.h7p2: Ensemble pinné ezali chargé na chambre ouverte; ba clients ba rendre tête oyo ekangami na pin na likolo.
rooms.h8p1: Ba projets ya chambre moko ewumeli na node: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` na `{text}`. `GET` ezongisaka courant. `DELETE` ezali kopɛtola.
rooms.h8p2: Ba clients ba synchroniser ba projets na ba appareils nionso donc ko type na téléphone esilaka na bureau. Ba projets ezali chiffré na suka na suka te — ezali texte plain oyo emonanaka na serveur. Yango ezali commerce délibéré pona cross-appareil UX. Ba usagers oyo ba objecter bakoki ko désactiver synchronisation par-chambre.
rooms.h9: Ba messages oyo esalemi na programme
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/programmé` na `{id_ya_shambre, texte chiffre, tinda_na}`. Node ebombaka na `ba messages_scheduled`; mosali ya cron amipesi na tango.
rooms.h9p2: Editable mpe cancellable tiii tango tick ya send_at ekosila. Sima ya kotinda, message ekomi molongo ya ordinaire na `messages`.
rooms.h1_a: Lolenge nyonso minei ya bashambre (DM, groupe privé, groupe public, chaîne) bakabolaka mesa moko ya `ba chambre`. Bokeseni ezali na ba drapeaux boolean misato.
rooms.h1_b: Drapeaux: `ezali_dm`, `ezali_privé`, `ezali_channel`. DM: ezali_dm=solo, ezali_privé=solo, exactement 2 membres. Groupe privé: is_private=vrai, is_channel=lokuta, kino na ba membres 5000. Groupe public: is_private=false, etangami na répertoire soki nkolo a opter.Chaîne: is_channel=vrai, kaka ba propriétaires/admins post. Nyonso bakabolaka gestion ya ba clés, fan-out, ba réactions, ba threads.
rooms.h1_c: Polymorphisme ya tableau moko ezali modèle oyo euti na *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002) ya Martin Fowler. Telegram esalela mitindo misato ya bashambre ekeseni na kati; Slack esalela ba chaînes + ba DM + ba DM ya ba partis ebele lokola ba types minei; Discord esalelaka "ba canaux" pona nionso. Toponaki tableau moko sima ya profil elakisaki coût principal ezali fan-out (oyo ezali uniforme na ba types) mpe sima ya v0.0.3 refactor esangisaki ba tableaux misato ya ndenge moko na moko.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE ba chambre (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, .
  type VARCHAR(16), -- héritage, redundant na ba drapeaux
  nkombo VARCHAR(256), .
  ezali_ya_moto BOOLEAN, .
  ezali_channel BOOLEAN, .
  ezali_dm BOOLEAN, .
  motango_ya_bandimi INT, .
  avatar_url VARCHAR(512), Ezali ndenge moko na ba .
  ekelamaki_na TIMESTAMP, .
  esalemi_na BIGINT REFERENCES basaleli(id)
);
rooms.h2_a: Misala ezali na niveau misato : propriétaire, admin, membre. Exactement propriétaire moko par chambre, au moins admin moko, arbitrairement ba membres ebele.
rooms.h2_b: `ba membres_ya_chambre(id_ya_chambre, id_ya_mosaleli, rôle, basangisaki_na, ekangami_kino)`. Roles cascade: ba propriétaires baza na pouvoir ya admin nionso. Ba administrateurs bakoki ko inviter, ko kick, ko muter, pe ko éditer ba paramètres ya salle mais bakoki ko démoter propriétaire te. Ba membres bakoki kotinda ba messages, ko réagir, ko modifier bango moko, ko supprimer bango moko. Transfert ya propriétaire via `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` na `new_owner_id` — nkolo ya kala akiti na admin.
rooms.h2_c: Nkolo/admin/membre ezali modèle tripartite IRC op/voix/utilisateur ya 1988, oyo sima e adopter na Slack, Discord, Telegram. Pona ya sikisiki ya kozala na nkolo moko mpenza (ebele mingi te) euti na botali ya mibeko : na ba jurisdictions oyo ezali na mibeko ya responsabilité ya groupe, kozala na nkolo moko ya polele e simplifier DMCA mpe ba demandes ya ndenge wana.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE bato_ya_shambre (
  id_ya_shambre BIGINT, .
  id_ya_mosaleli BIGINT, .
  mokumba VARCHAR(16) CHECK(mosala IN ('nkolo','mokambi','mosangani')),
  basangani_na TIMESTAMP,
  ekangamaki_kino TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (id_ya_shambre, id_ya_mosaleli)
);
rooms.h3_a: Salle moko na moko ezali na clé ya misisa ya symétrique ya 32 octets. Ba membres basimbaka ba copies ezingami na se ya pubkey na bango ya X25519.
rooms.h3_b: Na bokeli, client azali kobimisa `root_key = secrets.token_bytes(32)`. Mpo na membre moko na moko, client azali ko chiffrer `root_key` na se ya `X25519(member_pubkey)` → enveloppe. Ba enveloppes efandaka na `bafungola_ya_shambre(id_ya_chambre, id_ya_mosaleli, enveloppe)`. Tango mosaleli akoti, client nionso ya membre oyo azali déjà asala enveloppe ya sika pona bango. Tango mosaleli atiki, nkolo to administrateur ya liboso oyo azali kosala azali kobaluka — azali kobimisa root_key ya sika, azali kozongisa ba enveloppes mpo na ba membres oyo batikali, azali ko diffuser `{type:"k", room:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` likolo ya WebSocket.
rooms.h3_c: Enveloppement par membre ezali modèle Signal e pionnier na 2014 pona ba groupes na yango-v2. Megolm ya Matrix asalelaka lolenge moko ya "bafungola ya motindi". Vortex akendaki na ba enveloppes par membre mpo ezali simple ya ko raisonner: pas de drift ya sekele ya liboso entre ba tindi. Trade-off ezali O(N) enveloppe minting na changement ya membres, oyo ezali amende jusqu'à ~5000 membres; public-channel Variant-B ezo kende pembeni ya ndelo.
rooms.h3_f:
na kokela:
  fungola_ya_misisa = rand(32) .
  mpo na m na bandimi:
    enveloppe[m] = X25519_Encrypt(m.fungola ya pub, fungola_ya_misisa)

na konje:
  misisa_ya_ya sika = rand(32) .
  rebroadcast(ba enveloppes ya sika pona ba membres oyo batikali)
rooms.h4_a: Variant-B key publish e remplacer ba enveloppes ya membre moko na clé moko oyo ezali na signature, oyo etie na tableau oyo bato batangaka. Ba échelles na 100k+ membres.
rooms.h4_b: Na esika ya kosala minting ya enveloppe O(N), nkolo a signer root_key mpe a poster na `room_public_keys(room_id, key, signed_by, signed_at)`. Ba clients bazuaka, ba vérifier contre pubkey ya nkolo Ed25519, pe basalelaka. Rotation ezali no-op mpo na mbongwana ya membre — moto nyonso oyo azalaki na fungola azali naino na yango ata soki babɛtaki ye makolo. Yango endimami mpo na ba annonce-channels publics esika "histoire profonde" ezali modèle ya menace te kasi reach mpe échelle ezali.
rooms.h4_c: Variant-B ezali modèle na visibilité ya histoire "monde lisible" ya Matrix esangani na rotation ya clés signée. Ebakisami na Vortex na v0.0.8 sima ya beta ezalaki na chaîne public ya 50k membres oyo ba explosions périodiques ya re-enveloppe na yango e saturé noeud. Approche oyo e signer-pe-publié e échelle linéaire na ba rotations clés (oyo ezalaka rare) au lieu ya ba changements ya membres (oyo ezali constant).
rooms.h4_f:
Variante-B: 1 .
  bilembo ya nkolo: sig = Ed25519Sign(priv_ya_nkolo, id_ya_shambre ∥ fungola_ya_misisa ∥ version)
  kobimisa: bafungola_ya_ba_ya_ba_shambre += {id_ya_shambre, fungola_ya_misisa, version, sig}
  client: GET /api/ba chambre/{id}/fungola-ya bato nyonso → vérifier sig contre propriétaire_pubkey
rooms.h5_a: Ba code ya invitation ezali 32 chars hex. Optional max_uses, expires_at, kopesa_rôle, ekoki kozongisama sima.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (admin-seul) esali molongo na `invites(code, room_id, esalemi_na, max_uses, used_count, expires_at, assign_role, revoked_at)`. `POST /api/rooms/join` na code e vérifier validité (elongolami te, esili te, used_count < max_uses), ematisaka `used_count`, esali `room_members` molongo, ezongisaka ba métadonnées ya chambre. Bolongola na nzela ya `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` — bosangisi ya sima elongi te.
rooms.h5_c: Ba codes ya kobengisa lokola primitif ezali ya kala lokola mode `+i` ya IRC (1988). Telegram's public invitation links with expiry and use limits were introduced in 2017. Variante ya Vortex ebakisi `assign_role` mpo ete bankolo bakoka kokabola ba codes ya kopesa administrateur na bozangi likama na format ya mbala moko — ya ntina mpo na ko onboarding moderator ya sika kozanga ete oyeba id ya mosaleli na bango ya sikisiki liboso.
rooms.h5_f:
abengisi molongo:
  code : VARCHAR(64) -- 32 bilembo ya hex
  id_ya_shambre : BIGINT .
  max_uses : INT -- NULL = ezangi ndelo
  motángo_ya_basaleli : INT .
  esili_na : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = ata mokolo moko te
  kopesa_mosala : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = mosangani
  elongolami_na : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = na bomoi
rooms.h6_a: Molongo ya nsango ebombaka texte chiffre + ba métadonnées; motindi ebombamaka ata moke te na makomi ya pɛtɛɛ.
rooms.h6_b: `messages (id, id_ya_shambre, id_ya_motindi, texte chiffre, nonce, pseudo_ya_motindi, atindami_na, ebongolamaki_na?, elongolami_na?, eyano_na?, id_ya_thread?, lolenge)`. `sender_id` ezali mpo na contrôle ya accès mpe ezali indexé. `sender_pseudo` ezali hash déterministe ya chambre moko ya sender_id yango wana fan-out ezali na besoin te ya kosimba tableau ya ba usagers. `lolenge` ezali moko ya: makomi, elilingi, fisyé, mongongo, kobenga, système. `ciphertext` ezali kobima AES-GCM opaque; kaka ba membres ya chambre oyo baza na clé nde bakoki ko déchiffrer.
rooms.h6_c: Likanisi ya sender_pseudo euti na Signal sealed-sender (2018). Signal esalela yango mpo na kokanga miso serveur mpo na identité ya motindi; tosalelaka yango mpo na ntina ya ndenge moko kasi tobombaka `sender_id` cleartext mpo na ACL mpe ndelo ya taux. Split e permettre biso to enforcer "seulement membres nde bakoki ko poster" sans que serveur ayekola nani alobaki nini na dump DB mobimba.
rooms.h7_a: Ba édits ekomi likolo ya `ciphertext` na esika mpe ezo bump `edited_at`. Elongolaka chiphertext null out mpe etie `deleted_at`.
rooms.h7_b: Bobongisi: `PATCH /api/messages/{id}` na `{ciphertext, nonce}` ya sika. Kaka motindi nde akoki kobongisa nsango na ye moko. Chiphertext/nonce ya molongo ezwaki esika, `edited_at = sikoyo`, `lolenge` ebongwanaki te. Fan-out `{lolenge:"m", id, ct, nonce, ebongisami_na}`. Bolongola: `DELETE /api/ba messages/{id}`. Motindi to admin akoki ko effacer. `elongolami_na = sikoyo`, `texte chiffre = NULL`. Row etikalaka donc ba réponses ezalaka kaka na sens. Fan-out `{lolenge:"m", elongolami:solo, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Edit-in-place ezali motindo ya Telegram/Slack; Discord ebombaki histoire ya édition mobimba na ebandeli mpe sima ebwakaki yango mpo na vie privée. Vortex ebombaka kaka ya sika — lisolo ya bobongisi ezali liziba ya PR makambo ntango bobongisi-elongolami ekoki kozongisama. Soft-delete na chiphertext null ezali ya playbook Telegram moko mpe ebatelaka ba chaînes ya réponse sans ko garder contenus.
rooms.h7_f:
bobongisi: UPDATE ba messages SET texte chiffre = $1, nonce = $2, ebongolami_na = NOW() WHERE id = $3
kosilisa: UPDATE ba messages SET elongolami_na = NOW(), texte chiffre = NULL WHERE id = $1
rooms.h8_a: Ba projets — eteni ya mokapo ya ba chambre. Oyo ezali moko ya ba mécanismes ya moboko oyo etalisami na référence mobimba ya Vortex. Tángá mokapo oyo ezali zingazinga mpo na koyeba makambo oyo ezali na kati; eteni oyo ezali kosala zoom na bizaleli ya sikisiki.
