files.title: Ba fichiers na ba pièces jointes
files.subtitle: Single-shot mpo na moke, resumible mpo na monene, encryption côté client mpo na bango mibale.
files.intro: Upload nionso ya fichier elekaka na pipeline ya chiffrement moko. Bokeseni kati na banzela ezali kaka mpo na bokasi ya réseau : resumible e tolére ba liens flaky.
files.h1: Nzela ya botiami na lisasi moko
files.h1p1: Cap: 5 MB. Esalelamaka mpo na ba photos, ba notes ya mongongo, ba clips ya mikuse.
files.h1p2: Client azali ko chiffrer fichier mobimba na AES-GCM, nonce ya 96 bits aléatoire, clé = `file_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)`.
files.h1p3: POSTs `multipart/form-data` na `/api/files` na ba champs `fichier` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (reclamation ya intégrité), `mime_type` (like; serveur ezo vérifier lisusu na `python-magic`).
files.h1p4: Node ebombaka na se ya `uploads/<category>/<sha256>.bin` mpe ezongisaka `{file_id, url}`.
files.h1p5: Na sima client a poster message ya chambre oyo ezo référer na file_id pe ememaka file_root na chiphertext na yango po ba membres ya chambre bakoka ko déchiffrer.
files.h2: Nzela ya kokɔtisa oyo ekoki kozongisama na mosala
files.h2p1: Cap: 5 GB (ekoki kobongisama na nzela ya `RESUMABLE_MAX=5368709120`).
files.h2p2: Etape 1: `POST /api/fichiers/resumable/init` na `{nkombo ya fisyé, bonene, chunk_size_hint}`. Node ekabolaka id ya botiami, ezwi bonene ya eteni (512 KiB ya liboso, ekangami na 4 MiB), ezongisaka `{upload_id, chunk_size}`.
files.h2p3: Etape 2 : mpo na eteni moko na moko, `PUT /api/files/resumible/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` na nzoto ya chiffretexte brut. Ba offsets esengeli ezala aligné na `chunk_size`.
files.h2p4: Etape ya 3: `POST /api/fichiers/resumable/{id_upload}/finalise` na `{plain_blake3}`. Node ezo sangana lisusu, ezo vérifier taille, ezo bomba, ezo zongisa `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2p5: Traitement ya échec : ba uploads interrompu ekoki kozongela na ko re-poster kaka ba offsets oyo ezangi. Node elandaka ba offsets nini ekomaki na Redis (to na kati ya mémoire mpo na mode SQLite).
files.h2p6: TTL: ba uploads oyo esilaki te e purger sima ya 24 h.
files.h3p1: Ba uploads ya bilili (MIME `image/*`) e déclenchaka générateur ya ba miniature basé na Oreiller na 256×256 JPEG q=80. Ebombami na nse ya `uploads/thumbs/<hash>.jpg`.
files.h3p2: Ba miniatures ezali pe chiffrées côté client — moyambi azali na besoin ya file_root pona ko rendre. Abomba bande passante mpo na ba aperçus ya liste.
files.h3p3: Ba uploads ya vidéo (MIME `video/*`) e déclenchaka extraction ya affiche basé na ffmpeg na 10 % ya durée ya clip, ebombami ndenge moko.
files.h4p1: `mime_type` oyo client atindeli ezali likanisi. Serveur esalaka `python-magic` contre 1 KB ya liboso mpe eboyi soki type sniffed ezali na liste ya koboya: `application/x-dosexec`, `application/x-sharedlib`, `application/x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: Yango epekisaka basaleli naïf bákabola na mbalakaka ba logiciels ya mabe na nzela ya motindami. Ba attaquants motivés bakoki kaka ko contourner na ba conteneurs correctement-étiqueté — défense ezali koboya ko dérouler côté client, sniff côté serveur te.
files.h5p1: Na ndenge ya liboso: système ya ba fichiers ya esika. Good mpo na ba déploiements ya noeud moko.
files.h5p2: S3: tia `STORAGE_BACKEND=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...`. Ba fichiers ezo streamer directement na S3 sans ko toucher disque ya node. Ba URL oyo etiamaki maboko liboso esalelamaka mpo na ba téléchargements.
files.h5p3: IPFS: ya komeka. Ba uploads esakolaka ba CID na nzela ya DHT; ba téléchargements ezuaka node nionso ya pinning.
files.h1_a: Upload ya mbala moko ezali nzela ya mbangu mpo na eloko nyonso oyo ezali na nse ya 5 MB — bafɔtɔ, banɔti ya mongongo, ba clips mikuse. HTTPS POST moko, blob moko chiffré, molongo moko na `ba fichiers`.
files.h1_b: Client azali ko chiffrer ba octets ya fichier suka na suka na AES-GCM na se ya `file_root` ya 32 octets ya kozanga kokana. POSTs `multipart/form-data` na `/api/fichiers` na ba champs `fichier` (texte chiffre), `plain_blake3` (reclamation ya intégrité), `mime_type` (lise). Node e forcer cap ya 5 MB na niveau ya tampon ya boyambi, esala `python-magic` pona détection ya type, eboyi soki MIME ezali na liste ya koboya, ebombaka na se ya `uploads/<category>/<hash>.bin`, ezongisaka `{file_id, url, mime_type, size}`. Na sima client a poster message ya chambre oyo ezo référer na `file_id` pe amemi `file_root` na chiphertext na ye.
files.h1_c: Cap ya 5 MB ezali numéro moko oyo Slack na Telegram basalelaka pona nzela na bango ya upload "inline". Ba fichiers ya minene ekendaka na nzela oyo ekoki kozongisama na mosala. Vortex ya ebandeli ezalaki na casquette ya 100 MB ya masasi moko; tokiti na 5 MB sima ya profilage elakisaki que ba uploads ya tir unique likolo ya 5 MB ezalaki na taux ya ba chutes ya 40 % na ba réseaux mobiles. Nzela oyo ekoki kozongisama na mosala ezali strictement malamu mpo na ba fichiers ya minene atako ezali ba roundtris mingi na ba nzela ya esengo.
files.h2_a: Upload resumible ezali nzela ya ba fichiers ya minene. Client a uploadaka ba chunks ya taille fixe, akoki ko pause, akoki kozongela na ndelo ya chunk nionso, akoki ko récupérer na ba blips ya réseau.
files.h2_b: Protocole ya ba étapes misato. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` na `{nkombo ya fisyé, bonene, chunk_size_hint}` → node epesi `upload_id` + endimisi bonene ya chunk. Biteni : mpo na offset moko na moko, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` na nzoto ya chiffretexte brut. Ba offsets esengeli kozala ba multiples ya chunk_size. Finaliser: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` na `{plain_blake3}` — node esanganaka lisusu, e vérifier taille + tag, ebombaka, ezongisaka `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2_c: Protocole ya ba étapes misato ezali na forme moko na tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 ba uploads ya ba parties ebele, mpe Google Drive ba uploads oyo ekoki kozongisama na mosala. Vortex a adoptaki forme ya tus.io po ezalaki match ya pete pona FastAPI + streaming. Ba 24 h TTL na ba uploads oyo esilaki te ekokani na par défaut ya S3 mpe ba équilibres ya kozongela flexibilité contre usage ya disque ya serveur.
files.h3_a: Ba miniatures esalemaka côté serveur na tango ya upload kasi etikalaka chiffré na se ya misisa ya fichier moko, yango wana kaka ba membres ya chambre nde bakoki ko rendre yango.
files.h3_b: Mpo na `elilingi/*` MIME, Pillow ebimisaka 256×256 JPEG q=80 uta na aperçu déchiffré. Zela — te, serveur ezalaka ata moke te na makomi ya polele. Flux correct : client a produire pouce localement, a chiffrer na même file_root + nonce ya sika, a uploader lokola blob ya ndeko, pe a référencer `thumb_id` na message ya chambre. Serveur ebombaka makomi ya chiffre. Mpo na `video/*`, client asalaka ndenge moko na cadre clé oyo euti na ffmpeg.
files.h3_c: Na ebandeli Vortex ezalaki na bokeli ya ba miniature côté serveur na texte ya pamba — tolongolaki makoki wana na v0.0.4 sima ya botali ya bokengi elakisaki ete ebukaki garantie ya E2E. Ba pouces côté client ezali modèle oyo Signal esaleli banda 2018 mpe WhatsApp banda 2020. Coût ya bande passante ezali négligeable — JPEG ya 256×256 ezali na se ya 20 KB.
files.h4_a: Serveur e forcer liste ya koboya MIME na couche ya sniff mpo na kopekisa ba exécutables oyo ekabolami na mbalakaka.
files.h4_b: Sima ya upload mobimba (single-shot) to finaliser (resumable), serveur ezo tambuisa `python-magic` likolo ya 1 KB ya liboso ya conteneur hôte ya chiphertext pona ko détecter type ya solo. Soki sniff epesi lapolo ya `application/x-dosexec` (Windows PE), `application/x-sharedlib` (Linux ELF), to `application/x-mach-binary` (macOS Mach-O), botiami eboyami na 415 Lolenge ya Media oyo esungami te. Oyo ezali politique ya serveur, ndelo ya sécurité te — ba membres ya chambre ya client bakokaki kaka ko installer format ya enveloppe oyo ezo contourner sniff.
files.h4_c: MIME ko sniffir lokola politique ya koboya ezali IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X ya 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram nionso basalaka yango. Limite (zipped/containerised executables bypass sniff) eyebani banda 2016 — défense na biso ezali couches: plus ba avertissements côté d'utilisateur na fichier nionso oyo ezali na extension exécutable.
files.h5_a: Backends ya bobateli — eteni ya mokapo ya ba fichiers. Oyo ezali moko ya ba mécanismes ya moboko oyo etalisami na référence mobimba ya Vortex. Tángá mokapo oyo ezali zingazinga mpo na koyeba makambo oyo ezali na kati; eteni oyo ezali kosala zoom na bizaleli ya sikisiki.
files.h5_b: Botali ya bosaleli mpo na "Ba backends ya bobateli". Mecanisme esalemi na module oyo ekokani na se ya `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, to `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README ebengaka banzela ya sikisiki ya fisyé.
files.h5_c: Mecanisme ya "Storage backends" evoluaki na kati ya ba sorties Vortex. Bokeli yango ebandi na bolukiluki mpe misala ya kobimisa oyo ebimisamaki ya bamemi-nsango ya kala. Histoire ya version na `CHANGELOG.md` ekomaka tango pièce moko na moko ekita pe nini e motiver yango.

presence.title: Ba signaux ya présence na ya livraison
presence.subtitle: Ba indicateurs ya type, ba récépissés ya kotanga, ya suka oyo emonanaki — nionso ya éphémère.
presence.intro: Ba signes wana ezalaka na makelele. Vortex ebatelaka bango hors persistence par défaut : ko type e vivre na Redis (to na mémoire), ba récépissés ya kotanga ezali signal seul oyo ebikaka na restart.
presence.h1p1: Client atindaka `{type:"t", chambre:..., état:"banda"|"kotelema"}` na kofina ba touches. Débounced na au moins événement moko par 3 s.
presence.h1p2: Node ezo diffuser `{type:"t", salle:..., usager:..., état:...}` na ba WebSockets nionso oyo ba abonné.
presence.h1p3: Auto-expire: `kobanda` kozanga `kotelema` oyo elandi tango ya kosila sima ya 10 s na ngambo ya client.
presence.h2p1: Ba POST ya client `POST /api/ba chambre/{id}/tanga` na `{id_message_ya_ya_ya_kotanga}`.
presence.h2p2: Node ewumeli na `read_receipts(id_ya_chambre, id_ya_mosaleli, id_ya_nsango, kotanga_na)` mpe epanzani `{lolenge:"r", salle:..., mosaleli:..., id_ya_message:...}`.
presence.h2p3: Ba clients ba rendre "emonani na N" na se ya ba messages oyo ezo bima.
presence.h2p4: Bomoi ya moto ye moko: mosaleli akoki ko désactiver "seen" mobimba; alors node e persister te ba récépissés pona bango. Trade-off : ba monaka pe ba récépissés ya batu misusu te (symétrie).
presence.h3: Emonani mpo na mbala ya nsuka
presence.h3p1: Node elandaka `presence.last_seen_at` (unix ms) na mosaleli moko. Mikolo oyo na cadre nionso ya WebSocket.
presence.h3p2: Niveau ya granularité (oyo mosaleli akoki kopona): ya sikisiki, ya rond na 5 min ya penepene, ya rond na ngonga ya penepene, "kala mingi te", to ekangami.
presence.h3p3: Batunaki na nzela ya `GET /api/basaleli/{id}/bozali`. Abonnemi na nzela ya `{type:"sub_présence", mosaleli:...}`.
presence.h4p1: Mosaleli azali "en ligne" soki azali ata na WebSocket moko oyo ezali kosala na aparɛyi moko na bango.
presence.h4p2: Visible na ba contacts kaka — ba non-contacts ba monaka dernière-visible mais point vivant te.
presence.h1_a: Indicateur ya kokoma etindamaka na nzela ya cadre WebSocket `{type:"t", chambre, état: "start"|"stop"}` mpe e diffuser na node na abonné nionso na chambre.
presence.h1_b: Client a débounces na 3 s — touche ya liboso etindi `start`, oyo elandi na kati ya 3 s esalaka eloko te. 10 s sima ya kofina ba touches ya suka, client atindi `stop`. Node ezo diffuser cadre verbatim, préfixe na `user_id`. Persistance te — état ya ko typer e vivre na ba dicts in-mémoire par chambre (to Redis pub/sub pona multi-node). Auto-expire 10 s na côté ya récepteur : soki mise à jour ekomi te, ba clients ba assumer ete etelemi.
presence.h1_c: Ba indicateurs ya type ezongaka na AIM / ICQ (1997). Moderne designs debounced trace to Skype 2006 and iMessage 2011. Ba nombres ya 3 s / 10 s ezali ya comportement observé ya iMessage — biso A/B testaki 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 mpe 3/10 tozalaki na ba retours subjectifs ya malamu koleka "ekokani na rythme humain".
presence.h2_a: Boyambi ya botangi ewumeli: client POSTs id ya message ya kotanga ya suka; node ebombaka na `read_receipts` mpe na ba émissions.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/ba chambre/{id}/tanga` na `{id_ya_message_ya_kotanga_ya_nsuka}`. Node ezo mise à jour `read_receipts(id_ya_chambre, id_ya_mosaleli, id_ya_message, kotanga_na)` na UPSERT sémantique. Emissions `{type:"r", chambre, mosaleli, message_id, kotanga_na}`. Ba clients ba rendre "emonani na N" na se ya ba messages oyo ezo bima. Bomoi ya moto ye moko: mosaleli akoki kokanga ba récépissés mobimba; alors node e persister te pona bango AND ba monaka ba récépissés ya ba misusu te (symétrique).
presence.h2_c: Ba récépissés ya kotanga ekomaki bisika nyonso sima ya iMessage 2011 mpe WhatsApp 2014. Mobeko ya symétrie (soki obombi oyo ya yo, omoni ya basusu te) ezali ya Telegram 2014 mpe ezali lolenge se moko ya koboya chaîne ya bokengeli ya nzela moko. Vortex e forcer symétrie na serveur — kaka client te — donc ba clients oyo bakosaka na drapeau bazuaka kaka visibilité te.
presence.h3_a: Last-seen ezali timestamp moko ya mosaleli moko, oyo ezongisami na mikolo na cadre nionso ya WebSocket mpe ekómaka mibange ntango ba cadres ekomi te.
presence.h3_b: Node elandaka `presence.last_seen_at` lokola unix ms. Mikolo oyo na cadre nionso ya WebSocket oyo endimami uta na mosaleli wana. Tanga na nzela ya `GET /api/basaleli/{id}/bozali`. Abonnez-vous via `{type:"sub_presence", user}` mpo na kozwa push en direct na changement. Granularité ezali configurable na mosaleli : timbre ya temps exact, rond na 5 min, rond na 1 h, "kala mingi te", to off.
presence.h3_c: Ba niveaux ya granularité ezo tracer na mise à jour ya vie privée ya WhatsApp na 2012 sima ya ba plaintes sur stalking ya suka oyo emonanaki. Telegram na 2013 abakisaki ba seau "kala mingi te / na kati ya poso moko / na kati ya sanza moko". Vortex ya 5 min / 1 h / "kala mingi te" ezongeli Telegram. Option "off" ebombaka symétriquement mosaleli mpo na komona basusu ya suka mpo na ntina moko na ba récépissés ya kotanga.
presence.h4_a: Indicateur en ligne : mosaleli azali "en ligne" soki azali ata na WebSocket moko ya bomoi na moko ya ba appareils na ye.
presence.h4_b: Node ebombaka `active_ws_count(user_id)` na mémoire. Ba increments na WS mise à niveau, ba diminutions na ferme. `en ligne = active_ws_count (id_ya_mosaleli) > 0`. Visible na ba contacts kaka — ba non-contacts ba monaka dernière-vous (soumise na granularité) mais jamais point vert vivant. Bobongola makambo moto ntango motango ekatisi zéro na ngámbo moko to mosusu.
presence.h4_c: Visibilité ya ba contacts kaka ezali modèle oyo messenger nionso ya sérieux a se installer sima ya ba incidents ya stalking ebele (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Vortex ya ebandeli esalemaki na internet emonanaka na moto nyonso; tobalusaki default nsima wana motali moko ya beta amonisaki ete bashambre ya bato nyonso ekofuka présence ya bankóto ya bapaya epai ya bankóto ya bapaya mosusu.

calls.title: WebRTC kobenga
calls.subtitle: Mongongo + video, 1:1 mpe groupe, signalé likolo ya WebSocket, relavé na nzela ya coturn.
calls.intro: Vortex esalelaka ebele ya stock WebRTC. Node ezali signalisation-seul. Soki baninga ba connecter ba candidats na bango ICE, ba médias ezo flux directement (peer-to-peer) to na nzela ya TURN relais na mabe NAT.
calls.h1p1: Mobengi: `POST /api/abengi/{id_ya_chambre}/banda` na `{vidéo: bool, audio: bool}`. Node ekabolaka id_ya_kobenga, epanzani `{type:"c", lolenge:"kobengisa", id_ya_kobenga, video, audio}` na chambre.
calls.h1p3: Bosangisi ya offrande/eyano: `{lolenge:"likabo", sdp:...}` → `{lolenge:"eyano", sdp:...}` → `{lolenge:"kandida", glace:...}` × N kino ekokangama.
calls.h1p4: Kobenga esili: `POST /api/mabenga/{id_ya_kobenga}/suka`. Mopanzi moko to mosusu ekoki kokanga telefone. Node ekomaka `call_records(id_call, durée_s, vidéo, audio, ba parties)`.
calls.h2p1: Établissement ya Connexion Interactive ya Serveur. Ba camarades ba échanger ba candidats (hôte, srflx, prflx, relais).
calls.h2p2: STUN: ekangami na coturn. Mode ya stun-seul oyo esalelamaka pona détection symétrique-NAT.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn na ba credentiels ya ntango mokuse oyo etiamaki sinyatili HMAC. Chaque appel ezuaka ba creds ya sika valide pendant 24 h.
calls.h2p4: Ba credentiels: `{nkombo ya mosaleli: <timbo ya ngonga>:<id_ya mosaleli>, mot ya nzela: base64(HMAC-SHA1(sekele, nkombo ya mosaleli))}`. Bobongisi ya momesano RFC 5389.
calls.h3p1: Audio: Opus 48 kHz bitrate oyo ekoki kobongwana (6-128 kbps). DTX na mpo na kopekisa kimia.
calls.h3p2: Video: VP9 (elingi) / H.264 / AV1 (kopona). Simulcast mpo na ba appels ya groupe : mobengi azali ko coder ba résolutions misato na mbala moko.
calls.h3p3: FEC: ntango nyonso na mosala mpo na koyoka; mpo na video soki bitrate headroom epesi nzela.
calls.h4p1: Mpo na > 2 participants, Vortex ebotaka SFU (Unité ya Envoi sélective) na noeud. Participant moko na moko a uploader mbala moko, SFU ba fans libanda.
calls.h4p2: Sikoyo audio-seul jusqu’à 100 participants; ba groupes ya vidéo ekangamaki na 8 na v0.1 (vidéo SFU durcissement na v0.3 feuille de route).
calls.h4p3: SFU esalelaka relais ya coturn moko mpo na traversal; esengeli kosala misala mosusu te.
calls.h5p1: Na nzela ya `getDisplayMedia`. Client abakisi piste ya sika na PeerConnection oyo ezali; ezo négocier lisusu offre/réponse.
calls.h5p2: Bato oyo bazwi yango bamonisaka écran oyo bakabolaka lokola piste ya video oyo ekabwani. Na mobile, kokabola écran esengaka ndingisa ya niveau OS — iOS esengi, Android elakisaka dialogue ya système.
calls.h6p1: WebRTC's built-in NetEQ esimbaka perte na jitter. Na dégradation makasi client akitisaka résolution to a désactiver vidéo mobimba tout en gardant audio en vie.
calls.h6p2: Congelation ya 500 ms e déclenchaka tentative ya reconnect (ICE restart). Ba usagers bamoni "Reconnecting..." superposition.
calls.h1_a: Signalisation ya appel ezo monter ndenge moko na WebSocket oyo basalelaka pona chat. Node ezali signalement-seulement — e courtier SDP na ICE entre baninga kasi jamais esimbaka ba médias.
calls.h1_b: Mobengi azali POST `/api/calls/{room_id}/banda` na `{vidéo, audio}`. Node ekabolaka `id_call`, ezo diffuser `{type:"c", kind:"invite", call_id, vidéo, audio}` na chambre. Mobengi azali kotinda `/api/calls/{id_call}/ndima` → `{lolenge:"c", lolenge:"endimi"}`. SDP bosangisi ya offrande/eyano: `{lolenge:"kopesa", sdp}` → `{lolenge:"eyano", sdp}`. ICE ba candidats: `{lolenge:"candidat", glace}` × N kino PeerConnection ekopesa lapolo ya `connecté`.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE signalisation ezali modèle standard WebRTC oyo elimbolami na RFC 8839 na 8841. Vortex a inventer eloko moko te awa; ezali flux moko Chrome, Firefox, mpe WebRTC nyonso esaleli ya bibliothèque. Pona ya node-comme-signalling-seul ewuti na réalisation que envoi ya médias ya style SFU ekangisaka bande passante mpe esengaka matériel oyo tolingi te kotinda na installation ya base.
calls.h2_a: ICE ezuaka nzela na nzela ya ba NAT na kosalelaka ba candidats hôte + serveur-reflexif + relais. coturn manzaka STUN mpe TURN na ngambo Vortex.
calls.h2_b: Peer moko na moko atanga ba candidats : hôte (IPs locales), srflx (serveur-reflexif via STUN), relais (TURN-alloqués). Baninga ba échanger ba candidats nionso; paire moko na moko esali "paire", vérification ya connectivité etindi demande ya liaison STUN likolo ya UDP. Paire ya liboso oyo elongi ekomi nzela oyo eponami. Nsima ya NAT symétrique, kaka ba paires ya relais nde esalaka — wana nde tango relais TURN e relais vraiment ba médias.
calls.h2_c: ICE ezalaki standardisé lokola RFC 5245 na 2010 mpe ezongisamaki sika lokola RFC 8445 na 2018. Nsima ya carrier-grade-NAT, STUN elongi te soki 15 % ya tango mpe TURN ezali inévitable. coturn ezali serveur ya source ouverte ya référence TURN; totindaka yango mpo alternative (Twilio/Vonage TURN ya mombongo) efutaka na minute moko ya audio relais.
calls.h3_a: TURN ba credentiels ezali ba paires ya kombo ya mosaleli/mot de passe oyo e signer HMAC oyo eumelaka te oyo epesamaka na appel moko, kasi ba secrets ya tango molayi te.
calls.h3_b: Na ebandeli ya kobenga, node ebimisaka `kombo ya mosaleli = "<expire_unix>:<id_ya_mosaleli>"` mpe `mot ya nzela = base64(HMAC-SHA1(sekele_ya_serveur, nkombo ya mosaleli))`. Bango mibale bazali na TTL 24 h. Client esalela bango na config na ye ya RTCPeerConnection. coturn e vérifier HMAC na setup ya session. Ba creds oyo esilaki elongi te na vérification HMAC — etiki kosala automatiquement sans base de données ya revocation.
calls.h3_c: Ba creds HMAC oyo eumelaka mokuse ewutaka na RFC 5389 (STUN) mpe ezali modèle oyo déploiement nionso ya production WebRTC esalela. Twilio, Google, Xirsys bango nyonso basalaka yango. Alternative — ba creds TURN statiques — e fuite soki client moko azali na compromis. Ba creds oyo eumelaka te e limitaka fenêtre ya dégâts na 24 h.
calls.h4_a: Audio ezali Opus na 48 kHz na DTX; video ezali VP9 ya liboso / H.264 fallback / AV1 opt-in.
calls.h4_b: Mongongo: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR. DTX (Transmission discontinue) etiki kotinda na tango ya silence, ezongeli na mongongo. FEC na tango nionso. Video: VP9 na ebandeli; H.264 esalemaki piblisite mpo na ba dispositifs oyo ezangi matériel VP9 décodage (iOS avant A10 Bionic); AV1 epesami lokola opt-in mpo na premium na matériel ya mikolo oyo. Simulcast mpo na ba appels ya groupe : mobengi azali ko coder ba résolutions misato na mbala moko, SFU azali ko fans libanda oyo ya malamu na telespectateur moko na moko.
calls.h4_c: Opus ezali codec audio ya IETF oyo ezali na lotomo te (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 ezali équivalent ya H.265 ya polele ya Google. H.264 ezali fallback mpo Apple esimbaki na soutien VP9 tii na 2021. AV1 ekomaki viable na ba téléphones sima ya iPhone 15 Pro (2023) na Pixel 8 (2023) ebakisaki décodage matériel. Vortex ya codec mix ezali ndenge moko Google Meet esalela.
calls.h5_a: Ba appels ya groupe esalelaka SFU (Unité ya envoi sélective) na noeud. Mosangani moko na moko azali ko upload mbala moko; SFU ba forwards na mutu nionso.
calls.h5_b: Mpo na > 2 baninga mobengi atie `/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start`. Node ezo tourner instance SFU oyo ekangami na appel. Mosangani moko na moko afungoli PeerConnection na SFU na esika ya na moninga mosusu nyonso. Uplink: moko na moko atindaka 1 flux. Lien ya nse: SFU liboso na ba flux N-1. Ba couches ya simulcast elakisi SFU eponaka résolution oyo ebongi na bande passante ya telespectateur moko na moko oyo ezali.
calls.h5_c: SFU architecture ebandi na Videobridge ya Jitsi (2013). Yambo ya SFU, ba appels ya groupe WebRTC ezalaki full-mesh — peer moko na moko encodé ba flux N-1, oyo e échelle quadratiquement. Zoom, Google Kokutana, Jitsi, Signal groupe appels nionso esalela SFU. Vortex ba appels ya groupe audio-seul oyo etindami na v0.0.8; ba appels ya groupe vidéo ezali na feuille de route v0.3.
calls.h6_a: Kokabola écran ezali nzela ya sika ya media na PeerConnection oyo ezali, oyo esalemi lisusu na nzela ya offrande/eyano.
calls.h6_b: Mosaleli azali kobɛta na Écran ya kokabola → navigateur / iOS / Android abengi `getDisplayMedia()`. MediaStream oyo ezongisami ezali addTrack-ed na PeerConnection. Renegociation moto: offrande/eyano ya sika na piste oyo ebakisami. Bato oyo bazwi yango bamonisaka écran oyo bakabolaka lokola eloko ya video oyo ekabwani. Na iOS, kokabola écran esengeli na Extension ya Upload ya émission; na Android, service ya liboso + ndingisa ya MediaProjection.
calls.h6_c: getDisplayMedia ezalaki standardisé na 2017 mpe ezali na navigateur nionso banda 2019. Extension ya Upload ya émission ya iOS eyaki na iOS 11 (2017). Android MediaProjection ezali stable banda Lollipop (2015). Vortex kokabola écran etindami na v0.0.8.
calls.h2_f:
ba candidats:
  moyambi : rtp:addr (ya mboka IP)
  srflx : STUN a découvrir discours public
  relais : adresse ya relais oyo epesami na TURN

vérification ya paire: STUN bosenga ya bokangami likolo ya UDP .
paire oyo eponami: ya liboso mpo na kolonga
calls.h3_f:
kombo ya mosaleli = "{expire_unix}:{id_ya_mosaleli}".
mot ya nzela = base64(HMAC-SHA1(sekele_ya_mosaleli, nkombo ya mosaleli))
TTL = 24 h
coturn: e validaka HMAC na bosenga ya AUTH; aboyaka sima ya expiration
calls.h4_f:
audio: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR, DTX na, FEC na
video: VP9 (ya liboso)
         ↓ kozonga nsima
        H.264 ya ebandeli (ezali na bopekisami) .
         ↓ kopona na kati
        AV1 (esengeli ko décoder matériel)
groupe : ba résolutions L1 + L2 + L3 na mbala moko
calls.h5_f:
maille mobimba (N baninga): moko na moko etindi ba flux N-1 → O(N2) lien ascende
SFU (N peers): moko na moko atinda 1 flux → O(N) uplink na peer moko
calls.h6_f:
getDisplayMedia({vidéo: {curseur: "ntango nyonso"}, audio: lokuta})
  → Ezali na ba MediaStream
pc.addTrack(kokabolaVideoTrack, kokabolaStream)
  → kosolola lisusu (kosalaOffer → setLocalDescription → échange)

federation.title: Fédération oyo ezali
federation.subtitle: Ba pubkeys ya confiance, ba bilobaloba oyo ba signaki, ba DM ya ba noeuds croisés.
federation.intro: Fédération e permettre ba usagers na node A ba usagers ya message na node B. Ezali opt-in par opérateur. Ba pubkeys ya node ezali polele ya kotyelama motema; ezali na mode automatique "noeud nionso ekoki ko fédéré na oyo ya ngai" te.
federation.h1p1: Node moko na moko ebatelaka `ba fédérations(pubkey, point final, santé_score, added_at, added_by)`.
federation.h1p2: Kobakisa peer esengaka action ya admin oyo opérateur a signer. Admin UI elakisaka empreinte ya misapi ya télécommande po ba opérateurs bakoka ko vérifier hors-bande.
federation.h1p3: Baninga oyo balongolami batikali na DB oyo batye elembo `revoked_at` mpo na audit. Ba demandes ya sika ya fédération oyo ewutaka na même pubkey eboyamaka tiii tango admin ako un-revoquer.
federation.h2: Routage ya message ya ba noeuds croisées
federation.h2p1: Kobima uta na A kino na mosaleli@B: node A ezinga enveloppe ya nsango na blob oyo etiamaki sinyatili mpe etindi `/federation/deliver` na node B.
federation.h2p2: Enveloppe: `{node_ya_liziba, mosaleli_ya_cible, texte_cipher_ya kati, nonce_ya kati, etindamaki_na, sig}`. Sig ezipaka nionso sauf sig yango moko.
federation.h2p3: Node B e vérifier signature contre `source_node` pubkey uta na tableau na yango ya `fédérations`. Sig → 401 + likambo ya audit oyo ezali malamu te.
federation.h3p1: Soki B ezali oyo ekoki kozuama te, A azali kosala molongo na `fédération_outbox(cible_node, charge utile, ba tentatives, next_retry_at)`.
federation.h3p2: Retour exponentiel : 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, ekangami na 6h. Echec ya libela sima ya mikolo 14.
federation.h3p3: Alerte ya opérateur epeli tango bozindo ya boîte de sortie > 1000 messages — elakisi lien ya fédération ekangami.
federation.h4p1: Nsima ya 60 s node moko na moko esalaka ping `GET /v1/santé` na moninga moko na moko. Tango ya eyano + ezalela elandami.
federation.h4p2: Point ya santé: ya ebandeli 100. Tango moko na moko ya suka elongolaka 1; succès moko na moko ebakisi 1 (cap 100). Score 0 → fédération epemamaki mpo na moninga wana.
federation.h4p3: Ebimisami na nzela ya `GET /v1/peers` mpo na ba tableaux de bord ya opérateur.
federation.h1_a: Fédération na Vortex ezali relation mutuelle-confiance entre ba opérateurs mibale ya noeuds. Node moko na moko ebimisaka fungola ya bato nyonso Ed25519 ya 32 octets; node mosusu ebakisi yango na tableau ya `trusted_nodes` pembeni ya esika na yango ya suka mpe score ya santé.
federation.h1_b: Kobakisa pubkey ya confiance esengaka opérateur a signer demande ya admin na clé ya sortie ya node ye moko. UI elakisaka empreinte ya misapi ya télécommande na forme ya 64 hex-char po ba administrateurs bakoka ko vérifier hors bande. Soki ebakisami, enveloppe nionso ya fédération oyo ekoti e vérifié contre signature Ed25519 ya pubkey wana — ba faux e détecté mbala moko pe e enregistrer. Bolongoli ezali pete: molongo etikalaka na elembo `revoked_at` mpo na audit, kasi signature ya enveloppe elongi sikoyo te.
federation.h1_c: Modèle ewutaka na fédération ya Matrix (esika serveur nionso asala publicité ya clé ya signature mpe événement nionso e signer na yango) mpe na DKIM ya email (esika DNS abimisaka pubkey ya signature). Matrix a prouvé modèle esalaka na échelle — réseau na bango ezali na plus de 100k ya ba serveurs fédérés. Variante ya Vortex ekeseni na kosenga opt-in mutuel explicite na esika ya mobeko ya Matrix "serveur nionso ekoki ko fédéré par défaut"; to trader commodité pona défense ya makasi contre fédération ya ba rogues.
federation.h1_f:
molongo ya ba noeuds_ya_confiance:
  fungola ya pub : 32 octets Ed25519
  esika ya suka : https://...
  score_ya_bokolongono : int [0, 100] .
  ebakisami_na : unix_ms
  added_by : id_ya_mosaleli_ya_mokambi
  elongolami_na : unix_ms | NULL .
federation.h2_a: Message ya noeud croisé emata na enveloppe E2E ndenge moko na oyo ya esika, ezingami na enveloppe ya libanda oyo ezali na signature oyo e authentiquer node oyo etindi na noeud oyo eyambaka.
federation.h2_b: Node A alingi kopesa na user@B. Etape 1: A e sérialiser `{node_ya_source, mosaleli_ya_cible, texte_cipher_ya kati, nonce_ya kati, etindami_na}`. Etape 2: A a signer ba octets sériealisés na clé privée na ye Ed25519 → `sig`. Etape 3: A a POST tuple na `POST /federation/deliver` na node B. Etape 4: B alukaka `source_node` na `trusted_nodes` na yango, a vérifier `sig`, a vérifier `sent_at` contre replay-window, pe a persister enveloppe ya kati na tableau na yango ya `messages` local. Client oyo azali kozwa yango amonaka yango mpenza lokola nsango ya esika — couche ya fédération ezali komonana te na basaleli ya nsuka.
federation.h2_c: Enveloppe ya libanda oyo ezali na signature edefami na ba événements ya fédération ya `m.room.message` ya Matrix. Fenêtre ya replay (5 minutes) mpe bosenga ete ba timbres ya temps oyo e signer source ekokana na montre ya mur edefami na DKIM. Na ebandeli Vortex (v0.0.2) amekaki fédération oyo e signaki te na ba certs ya client TLS; to changeaki na ba signature ya charge utile na v0.0.5 après ko réaliser ba certs ya client ebikaka na ba balanceurs ya charge te pe ebombaka authentification ya solo na couche ya application.
federation.h2_f:
enveloppe = {
  node_ya_liziba : hex32, .
  mosaleli_ya_cible : int64, .
  texte_ciffre_ya kati: ba octets, .
  inner_nonce : ba octets, .
  batindi_na : unix_ms, .
} .
sig = Ed25519Sign(priv_ya_liziba, CBOR(enveloppe))
POST /fédération/kopesa { enveloppe, sig } .
federation.h3_a: Tango node ya mosika ekoki kozuama te, node oyo ezali kotinda etie molongo ya enveloppe na `federation_outbox` na yango mpe emekaka lisusu na retour exponentiel.
federation.h3_b: Programme ya retour: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, capped na 6h. Na tentative moko na moko oyo elongi te colonne `attempts` ya molongo emati mpe `next_retry_at` etiamaki na sikoyo + current-step. Mosali ya sima (`app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) alamukaka sima ya 5 s mpe azuaka milɔngɔ esika `next_retry_at <= now()`. Succès elongolaka molongo; 14 jours ya ba échecs e marquer yango permanent pe tinda alerte ya admin.
federation.h3_c: Backoff exponentiel na plafond ezali modèle moko oyo Kafka asalelaka pona ba retries ya producteur mpe SMTP asalelaka pona mail rebond. Cap ya mikolo 14 ekokani na toli ya SMTP 5321. Ba versions ya liboso esalelaki ba retries fixes ya 60 secondes oyo esalaki ba spikes ya thundering-herd tango moninga moko azongaki na internet sima ya panne; exponentiel spread ebongisi yango na v0.0.7.
federation.h3_f:
retard(n) = min(6h, 1s · 2−) mpo na n = 0, 1, 2, ...

manaka ya komeka lisusu: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, ..., 6hs
alerte: outbox_depth > 1000 mpo na > 5 min
federation.h4_a: Chaque 60 secondes node moko na moko e ping na point final ya `/v1/health` ya moninga nionso. Score emati na succès, ekiti na échec, e limiter na [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Score ebandi na 100 na add. Succès moko na moko ebakisi +1 (capped na 100), timeout moko na moko elongolaka -1 (floor na 0). Score 0 pauses fédération na peer wana — ba messages ya sika ezali molongo na outbox, ba tentatives ya livraison ya sika ya sortie te tiii score ekomata lisusu likolo ya 20. Point ezo exposer na nzela ya `GET /v1/peers` pona ba tableaux de bord ya opérateur pe na nzela ya `/metrics` pona Prometheus. Kokita ya mbalakaka ya score na kati ya baninga ebele na fenêtre mokuse e déclenchaka alerte "partition ya réseau suspecte".
federation.h4_c: Point ya style AIMD e inspiré na fenêtre ya congestion ya TCP na amortisseur ya vérification ya santé ya Akamai. Etape ya ±1 asymétrique (na esika ya TCP ya kokata na ndambo) esalaka ete bozongisi ezala malembe koleka kozanga kolonga, oyo ezali kosala ete système ezala bias na bokebi — tokolinga kosala pause ya fédération tango tozali na ntembe na esika ya kotinda ba messages doubles na nzela ya lien flapping. Ebakisami na v0.0.6 nsima ya moninga moko oyo azalaki na bizaleli mabe atondisaki baninga mibale ya malamu na komeka lisusu.
federation.h4_f:
na elonga: score = min(100, score + 1)
na tango ya suka: score = max (0, score - 1)
soki score == 0: pause_fédération(moninga) .
soki score >= 20: résumé_fédération(peer) // hystérèse

gossip.title: Gossip mpe bokutani ya baninga
gossip.subtitle: Ndenge nini ba noeuds ezuaka moko na mosusu sans registre central.
gossip.intro: Longola liste ya contrôleur oyo e attesté, ba noeuds Vortex elobaloba ba camarades entre bango. Yango e découvrir ba noeuds ya sika tango ba opérateurs ba tourner yango, ata soki contrôleur a attesté yango nanu te.
gossip.h1p1: Chaque 60 s, node ezuaka peer ya pamba pamba pe etindi filtre Bloom ya 256 bits ya peer oyo eyebani. Peer ayanoli na baninga NOT na filtre, bakisa filtre na yango moko. Bande passante ezali `O(baninga ya sika × 32 octets)`, mingi mingi na se ya 1 KiB na tour moko.
gossip.h1p2: Peer moko na moko oyo asali piblisite azali na signature na node ya piblisite. Ba clients ba vérifier ba signature na contact ya liboso — attaquant akoki ko forger te peer na ba gossip.
gossip.h1p3: Ronde ezali na taux limité : échange moko par peer par 30 s (fenêtre coulissante).
gossip.h2p1: Ba noeuds ya sika ebandi na 8 contrôleurs ya bootstrap hardcoded. Ronde ya liboso ya maloba mabe emoni ebele ya baninga; réseau e converger na ~1 minute.
gossip.h2p2: Liste ya ba bootstrap ekoki kobongisama na nzela ya `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=fungola ya kobimisa1@point ya suka1,fungola ya kobimisa2@point ya suka2,...`.
gossip.h3p1: Moninga moko na moko oyo asali piblisite asengeli kozala na sinyatili na fungola ya kobimisa Ed25519 ya opérateur. Kosala liyebisi ya baninga esɛngaka koyiba fungola oyo ezali na ntina.
gossip.h3p2: Preuve-de-travail (justable, par défaut 2^18 zéros leading) na ba enregistrements ya sika ya baninga ebatelaka ba mbonge ya Sybil-bot en masse impratique.
gossip.h3p3: Système ya réputation : baninga oyo ba se comporter mabe (ba signature ya mabe, ba annonce ya lokuta, ba temps d’extraits repetitifs) ba détérioration ya réputation na bango. Zéro réputation → liste ya moindo.
gossip.h1_a: Chaque 60 s node moko na moko eponaka peer ya pamba pamba pe etindi filtre Bloom ya 256 bits oyo ezo résumer ba peer oyo eyebani. Peer ayanoli na baninga ya sika + filtre na yango moko. Bande passante ezali `O(baninga_ya sika × 32 octets)`.
gossip.h1_b: Filtre ya bloom k=5 hashes, m=256 bits. Node A ekotisaka ba peer_ids na yango nionso eyebani. Etindi na moninga B. B atunaki filtre na moko na moko ya baninga na ye; eloko nionso oyo ezangi, B atindaka na A (plus filtre na yango moko). A asalaka vérification ya ndenge moko na inverse. Sima ya échange ba noeuds nionso mibale bakabolaka environ connaissance moko. Echange typique: 200-800 octets. Ba mises à jour e converger na réseau mobimba na ~5 tours (5 minutes) grâce na propriété ya gossip.
gossip.h1_c: Masolo ya bloom-filter ebandi na papier multidiffusion bimodal ya Cornell ya 1998. Apache Cassandra asalelaka yango mpo na kozala membre; Bitcoin mpo na relais ya transaction; IPFS mpo na DHT entretien. Propriété ya convergence O(log N) ezali oyo ekomisaka yango malamu pona usage na biso — tozali na besoin ya ba vues mondiales te, kaka conventionnelle-consistent connaissance ya baninga. Taille ya filtre (256 bits) ezali tuned donc taux ya lokuta-positif ezali < 1 % na 100 peers.
gossip.h2_a: Ba noeuds ya sika ebandi na 8 contrôleurs ya bootstrap hardcoded. Ronde ya liboso ya maloba mabe e découvrir mingi; e converger na ~1 minute.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` etindami na `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=fungola1@point1,fungola2@point2,...`. Na démarrage, node emekaka moko na moko na ordre. Ya liboso mpo na koyanola epesaka liste ya baninga ya liboso (na nzela ya `GET /v1/trusted_nodes`). Node ekotisaka ba oyo na tableau ya baninga na ye ya mboka, e marquer bango lokola bootstrapped, mpe ebandi boucle ya gossip ya 60 s. Ba tour oyo elandi e découvrir ba peers-of-peers.
gossip.h2_c: Ba bootstraps hardcoded ezali motindo moko Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS kosalela. Alternative — DHT-based découverte — esengaka bokoti ya liboso ata ndenge nini. Vortex's 8 bootstrap count ezwamaki mpo kozala na > 4 epesaka résilience contre 2-3 événements ya arrêt simultané, mpe < 16 e garder fichier `.env` lisible. Bobongisa par-déploiement na kobongola `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS`.
gossip.h3_a: Peer moko na moko oyo asali piblisite asengeli kozala na signature na clé ya sortie Ed25519 ya opérateur d’origine na ye. Moto oyo azali kobundisa akoki kosala ete baninga na ye na kati ya réseau te.
gossip.h3_b: Tango node A esali piblisite ya peer P na gossip na node B, A esangisi `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, mpe timestamp, nionso oyo e signer na clé ya sortie ya P ye moko. B a vérifier signature avant atie confiance na P. Soki B a contacter sima P na P na TLS cert + première beat ya motema ekokani te na pubkey oyo esalemi piblisite, piblisite e marqué poisonné mpe e propager na se.
gossip.h3_c: Ba piblisite ya baninga oyo e signer ezali primitif anti-Sybil standard oyo euti na Chord (2001) na Kademlia (2002). Ba messages adr ya Bitcoin esalelaka modèle ya faible (ba signature te, etie motema na coût ya connexion lokola déterrent ya Sybil); Ba signes ya discv5 ya Ethereum. Vortex a adoptaki ba publicités signées na v0.0.6 sima ya attaquant ya testnet asala publicité ya ba faux peers 1000 na nzela ya noeud moko légitime.
gossip.h1_f:
filtre: k=5, m=256 bits
