stealth.title: Réseau ya kobombana
stealth.subtitle: Couches mitano, ba mécanismes 28. Nionso kobanda na TLS padding ti na ba services ya matungulu ya Tor.
stealth.intro: Vortex azali kozwa monguna ya kelasi ya ekolo. Stack ya kobombana ezali na couches donc ata soki ba couches ya libanda ezo contourner, oyo ya kati epesaka kaka service dégradé-mais-travail.
stealth.h1p1: Couche 1 — normalisation ya empreinte ya misapi. Ezali kopekisa ba classificateurs passifs.
stealth.h1p2: Couche 2 — morphing ya forme / taille. Ezali kopekisa ba classificateurs ya analyse ya trafic.
stealth.h1p3: Couche 3 — camouflage ya protocole. Etiki kosala DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Couche 4 — ba transports oyo ekoki ko brancher. Esalaka na ba réseaux oyo e bloquer primaire na biso.
stealth.h1p5: Couche 5 — fallback ya resort ya suka. Litungulu, BMP, relais ya ba sauts ebele. Esalaka tango eloko mosusu esalaka te.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello ekokani na Chrome na Windows 11 octet-na-byte. JA3/JA4 hash ekokani na Chrome 120 — empreinte ya misapi ya Vortex moko te.
stealth.h2p2: Padding ya couche ya enregistrement : ba enregistrements nionso ya TLS ekangami na 16 KB. Ba taille ya ba paquets ekokani na trafic ya navigateur en masse.
stealth.h2p3: Tinda na taux constant : molongo ebimisaka cadre moko na N ms nionso sans considération ya activité ya application. Ba périodes ya idée ebimisaka ba cadres mannequins oyo ba marqué na enveloppe ya kati donc ba récepteurs ba bwaka yango.
stealth.h2p4: Jitter ya timing: 0-50 ms retard aléatoire na sortie pona kolonga DPI oyo esalemi na latence.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morpher: distribution ya taille ya paquet, cadence ya explosion, na ba espaces ya silence ekokani na flux en direct ya YouTube. Ba classificateurs oyo bazali koluka ba beats ya motema ya messenger elongi te ko correspondre.
stealth.h3p2: Multipath : écoulement moko ekabwani likolo ya Wi-Fi, cellulaire, mpe VPN nionso oyo ezali kosala na mbala moko. Reassemblage na récepteur. Alongi shaping ya nzela moko.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC tunnel ya canal ya ba données : tango TLS ekangami kasi WebRTC esalaka, Vortex e tunnel na nzela ya DTLS-SRTP na moninga oyo ayebani.
stealth.h3p4: Ba connexions ya décoy: 3 sessions TLS ya occupation oyo ewumeli mingi na Google, YouTube, na Cloudflare. Observeur amonaka comportement normal ya navigateur.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS nionso esilisami na nzela ya DoH kino na Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP emonaka kaka HTTPS na ba résolveurs wana, kasi liste ya domaine ya solo te.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Client chiffré Mbote): SNI chiffré na fungola oyo ebimisami na enregistrement DNS HTTPS. Ba observateurs passifs bakoki komona kombo ya hôte ya destination te.
stealth.h4p3: Détection ya sonde: node elandaka ba demandes na session ya auth te. Ba sondes misatu oyo elongi te kowuta na IP na 5 min e déclenchaka mode "site de décoy" — oyo IP emoni sikoyo page d'atterrissage HTML ya pamba na 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Algorithme ya génération ya domaine): générateur ya domaine déterministe oyo elonamaki na date ya lelo. Soki point final primaire ekangami, ba clients ba calculer candidat oyo elandi mpe bamekaka.
stealth.h5: Niveau 4 — Ba transports oyo ekoki kokangama na fiche
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: ba transports standard ya style V2Ray na config JSON oyo ekoki ko brancher.
stealth.h5p2: Bosolo: TLS-na kati ya-TLS tunnel. Ba cibles ya kosimbana na maboko ya libanda www.microsoft.com; kosimbana na maboko ya kati ezali Vortex. Ba sondes contre ya libanda ezuaka envoyé na Microsoft donc sonde active emonisaka eloko te.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: ba navigateurs volontaires ba relayer Vortex trafic likolo ya WebRTC. Ba usagers oyo ba installer extension ya Snowflake ba pesaka couverture.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: ebongoli ba sondes HTTPS mpo esangisama na bizaleli ya Chromium ye moko tii na microsecond.
stealth.h6p1: Ba services ya matungulu : noeud nionso pe ezo se exposer lokola `.matungulu`. Ba clients oyo bazali na soutien ya Tor bakweyaka na likambo oyo tango nionso mosusu elongi te.
stealth.h6p2: Protocole ya boîte postale aveugle (BMP): kobomba-mpe-kotinda na nkombo te mpo na ba messages. Tala mokapo ya BMP.
stealth.h6p3: Relais multi-hop : ba messages ekoki ko bouncer na nzela ya jusqu’à 5 noeuds intermédiaires, moko na moko ebakisaka couche ya enveloppe. Lokola Tor mais na maille na biso moko.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): oblivious HTTP na nzela ya relais. Moto moko te amonaka ezala bosenga mpe eyano.
stealth.h1_a: Stealth ebongisami lokola ba couches mitano indépendantes. Couche moko na moko elongi classe différente ya adversaire. Echec ya couche moko e dégrader na oyo elandi — ezo cascade te.
stealth.h1_b: Couche 1 normalise empreinte ya misapi na biso ya TLS donc passive DPI ekoki ko classer te. Couche 2 e morphes forme ya trafic po ezala lokola streaming. Couche 3 e camoufler protocole na nzela ya ba tricks ya ECH / DoH / sonde-réponse. Couche 4 e changer na ba transports fichable (vmess, réalité, Snowflake) tango primaire ezali activement bloqué. Couche 5 ezali ya suka: Tor litungulu, BMP, relais multi-hop.
stealth.h1_c: Modèle ya couches ewutaka na architecture ya Tor ya pluggable-transports (2013). Vortex abakisaki ba couches mitano na esika ya misato ya Tor mpo na 2025 paysage adversaire esangisi DPI oyo eyebaki ba transports ya Tor bango moko (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Couche moko na moko ya Vortex ekotisama sima ya incident ya terrain : L1 sima ya blocage ya Kazakhstan (equivalent na 2019), L2 sima ya crackdown ya Iran na 2022, L3 sima ya détection ya DoH ya Chine na 2020, L4 sima ya ba blocs 2023 ya Turquie, L5 na komibongisa.
stealth.h1_f:
Kelasi ya monguna | Balongi na...
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- -----------
passive DPI | L1 (empreinte ya misapi) .
analyse ya trafic | L2 (lolenge) .
na mosala DPI | L3 (eloko ya kosala camouflage) .
kokanga na IP | L4 (ba transports) .
nionso mosusu | L5 (matungulu / BMP) .
stealth.h2_a: Couche 1 ekomisaka trafic Vortex indistinguable na Chrome na Windows 11 na couche TLS.
stealth.h2_b: ClientMbote na komande, liste ya bobakisi, liste ya suite ya chiffre, motuya ya ALPN — nyonso ebongisami mpo na kokokana na ba octets ya sikisiki ya Chrome 120. JA3/JA4 hash ekokani na kobimisama ya Chrome ya lelo. TLS enregistrement padding na 16 KB. Motindi ya taux constant abimisaka cadre moko chaque N ms na ba remplisseurs mannequins na tango ya ralenti. Jitter ya timing 0-50 ms pona kolonga analyse ya latence. Ba connexions ya décoy na Google, YouTube, Cloudflare ezo tambola na fond na ba intervalles ya 45 s.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 empreintes ya misapi ebimisamaki na ba ingénieurs ya Salesforce na 2017. Na 2019 ezalaki standard na entreprise DPI. Normalisation ya empreintes ya misapi ya Vortex esalemi na modèle ya uTLS, bibliothèque Go oyo Snowflake esalela pona tina moko. Ba tindi ya taux constant bazali port direct ya proposition ya "trafic ya couverture" ya WireGuard.
stealth.h2_f:
ClientMbote octets = chrome_120_modèle na { .
  random = random na biso, .
  server_name = kombo ya hôte na biso (to ECH-enveloppé), .
  session_id = id ya session na biso, .
} .
JA4 = t13d_xxxx_xxxx_xxxx (ekokani na stable ya Chrome ya lelo)
stealth.h3_a: Couche 2 e morphes trafic po ezala lokola ba médias ya streaming en masse au lieu ya chat interactif.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morpher: distribution ya taille ya paquet ekokani na 720p ya YouTube en direct (tableau empirique), matchs ya cadence ya explosion, match ya ba espaces ya silence. Multipath : flux logique moko ekabwani likolo ya Wi-Fi, cellulaire, mpe VPN nionso oyo ezali kosala na mbala moko; récepteur ezo reassembler na ordre ya nombre ya sequence. WebRTC fallback ya canal ya ba données : tango TLS ekangami kasi WebRTC aleki, tunnel Vortex na nzela ya canal ya ba données DTLS-SRTP na moninga oyo ayebani.
stealth.h3_c: Bolukiluki ya morphing ya trafic ezongaka na Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 e mettre en œuvre yango lokola sous-mode na yango "morph" na 2014. Meek+domain-fronting eteyaki biso que forme ezali na importance mingi lokola encryption. YouTube-specifiquement eponami mpo ezali site moko ya monene oyo ekangami te na ba réseaux mingi ya restrictive — kobombana na kati ya trafic oyo ezali na forme ya YouTube ezali "kobomba na kati ya ebele ya bato".
stealth.h3_f:
bonene_ya_paquet [i] ~ P(taille | YT-720p)
kotinda_retard [na] ~ P (retard | YT-720p)
dummy_frames ekotisami na tango ya idle mpo na kobatela forme ya enveloppe
stealth.h4_a: Couche 3 e camouflage identité ya protocole yango moko — SNI, DNS, ba codes ya réponse.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): DNS nionso elekaka na DNS-likolo-HTTPS tii na Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ISP amonaka kaka HTTPS na ba résolveurs wana. ECH (RFC 9460): SNI ezali chiffré na fungola oyo ebimisami na enregistrement DNS HTTPS. Ba observateurs passifs ba monaka kaka front-end IP. Détection ya sonde: ba noeuds elandaka ba IPs unauth'd oyo ezo beta `/api/*`; ba échecs misatu na 5 min flip IP na "mode decoy" — que IP amoni sikoyo page d'atterrissage HTML statique na 200 OK. DGA: générateur ya domaine déterministe seeded na date ya lelo po ba clients bazua fallback tango primaire e bloqué.
stealth.h4_c: DoH ebandaki na Firefox 2018 mpe ekomaki par défaut mpo na Chrome na 2019. ECH elekaki na ba projets mitano avant standardisation na 2024 — Vortex etindaki soutien na tango ya draft-13 mpe sikoyo e soutenir spec ya suka. Ba decoys ya sonde-réponse edefami na design ya meek ya 2014 mpe e refiné na 2023 sima ya ba sondes actives ya Iran ko identifier meek na temps ya réponse na yango.
stealth.h4_f:
DoH: POST https://cloudflare-dns.com/dns-query {kombo: x.vortexx.sol} Ezali na ntina mingi kozala na bomoi ya malamu.
ECH: ClientHello.extensions += chiffré_sni(fungola_ya_mokolo_euti_na_enregistrement_ya_HTTPS)
DGA: domaine(t) = base32( SHA256(momboto ∥ YYYY-MM-DD) )[:16] + ".ndakisa".
stealth.h5_a: Couche 4 esalelaka ba transports pluggables — ba tunnels ya troisième partie oyo ezali lokola eloko mosusu mobimba.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: ba transports ya libanda ya ndenge ya V2Ray standard; config ya JSON. Bosolo: TLS-na kati ya-TLS tunnel esika wapi kosimbana na maboko ya libanda etali www.microsoft.com; kosimbana na maboko ya kati ezali Vortex. Ba sondes actives na libanda etindamaka na Microsoft, yango wana sonde emonisaka eloko te. Snowflake: ba navigateurs volontaires ba relayer Vortex likolo ya WebRTC; infra moko te na ngambo na biso. NaiveProxy: ebongoli ba sondes HTTPS mpo esangisama na bizaleli ya sikisiki ya Chromium.
stealth.h5_c: VMess ya V2Ray ebandaki na 2015 na communauté anti-censure ya Chine. Trojan ebandaki na 2019. Réalité ezali ya 2022 — eyano na détection ya empreintes ya misapi ya Great Firewall TLS. Snowflake ezali remplaçant ya Tor Project na 2020 mpo na obfs4; Vortex abakisaki lisungi na v0.0.9 nsima na bloc ya Iran na 2023 na échelle mobimba ya ba points d’entrée ya Tor.
stealth.h5_f:
ndakisa ya bokɔti ya bosolo:
  Nkombo ya mosaleli: www.microsoft.com
  dest: www.microsoft.com:443
  Ids mokuse: ["<na ndenge ya pwasa>"]
client azali ko connecter na IP na biso, SNI=www.microsoft.com, to proxy réponse Microsoft ya solo
soki nzela ekokani na shortId+auth ⇒ nzela na Vortex .
stealth.h6_a: Couche 5 ezali sac ya dernière-resort ya ba astuces : service ya matungulu, BMP magasin-et-forward, relais multi-hop, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Node nionso ebimisaka adresse ya `.onion`. Ba clients oyo bazali na hôte capable ya Tor ba tomber na nzela tango TLS + L1-L4 nionso elongi te. BMP (Protocole ya boîte postale aveugle): motindi abwakaka blob chiffré na node nionso oyo ezali na clé na `HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1")`; maloba mabe epalanganaka; moyambi abendaka uta na node na bango ya ndako. Multi-hop: ba messages ezo bouncer na nzela ya jusqu’à 5 noeuds intermédiaires, moko na moko ebakisi couche ya enveloppe — lokola Tor mais na kati ya maille na biso moko. OHTTP (RFC 9458): oblivious HTTP na nzela ya relais donc parti moko te amona ezala demande na réponse.
stealth.h6_c: Misala ya matungulu ebandi na 2004 na Tor. BMP ezali invention na biso moko, modelé na ba gossip ya descripteur ya service caché ya Tor. Ba miroirs ya relais multi-hop Signal ya sealed-sender plus routage ya matungulu. OHTTP ezali ya 2024, esalemi na Cloudflare mpe Apple mpo na télémétrie oyo ebatelaka bomoto; to adoptaki yango na v0.0.9 lokola fallback ya suka.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP id_ya_boîte de poste = HKDF(pk_ya_moyambi, "bmp-v1", 32)
Dépôt: POST /bmp/dépôt { id_ya_boîte postale, blob }
Kozwa: GET /bmp/ba messages (auth'd)
TTL: 7200 s |  Max blob: 1 MB |  Max na node moko: 500 MB

bmp.title: Protocole ya boîte postale aveugle
bmp.subtitle: Anonyme magasin-et-forward pona ba messages na nzela ya maille ya ba gossip.
bmp.intro: BMP etikaka motindi atia message na node nionso sans ko bimisa identité. Message ezo bilobaloba tiii ekokoma na noeud ya ndaku ya récipient, esika ezo déchiffrer ndenge ezalaka.
bmp.h1p1: Motindi azwi `id_ya_boîte postale = HKDF(fungola_ya_moyambi, info: "bmp-v1", len: 32)`. Kaka motindi (oyo ayebi recipient_pubkey) nde akoki kosala calcul na yango; moyambi mpe ayebi.
bmp.h1p2: Motindi atie `POST /bmp/deposit` na `{mailbox_id, blob}` na node nionso ya masolo.
bmp.h1p3: Node ebombaka paire pendant jusqu'à 7200 s. Node ezali mpe na mailbox_id na filtre Bloom ya tour ya masolo oyo ekolanda.
bmp.h1p4: Ba noeuds misusu ebendaka ba blobs pona ba mailbox_ids oyo ba soucier localement (ba récipients na noeud na bango).
bmp.h1p5: Client ya moyambi azali kosala sondage `GET /bmp/messages` mpe ko déchiffrer ba blobs nionso ya sika na matériel clé na yango ya momesano.
bmp.h2p1: Node moko te ekoki ko relier blob na motindi — connexion TLS ya motindi e identifiaka source IP, kasi chaîne ya hops ya matungulu entre motindi na node BMP ya liboso elongolaka yango pe.
bmp.h2p2: Bobombami ya moyambi: blob ezali chiffré na pubkey ya moyambi. Ba noeuds ya kati emonaka kaka chaîne ya octets opaque na mailbox_id aléatoire.
bmp.h2p3: Confirmation ya livraison te na motindi. Na mbala moko sémantique.
bmp.h3p1: Taille ya blob ya likolo: 1 MB. Esengeli kokata ba charges utile ya minene na nzela ya flux ya fichier ordinaire.
bmp.h3p2: Max stockage par noeud: 500 MB ya ba dépôts na mobimba. LRU kobengana na ndako na cap. Ba opérateurs bakoki ko tune.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: na IP taux ya dépôt limité na 10 / min. Ba ID ya boîte postale oyo emonanaki koleka mbala 3 / ngonga na noeud moko ezali na taux-limité lokola mpela oyo ekanisami.
bmp.h4p1: Ba récipients ya censure ya likolo: motindi azali na besoin te ya koyeba node ya ndaku ya moyambi.
bmp.h4p2: Connexion intermittent : ba blobs ezela tiii tango récipient ako re-connecter pe a sondage.
bmp.h4p3: Déclaration anonyme : litungulu côté motindi + BMP = ba métadonnées te sur nani a déposé nini.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ezali couche ya magasin-et-forward oyo eyebani te. Motindi abwakaka blob na node nionso oyo ezali na gossip-enabled; blob ezali kozela na boîte postale oyo ekangami kaka na fungola ya bato banso ya mozwi.
bmp.h1_b: Motindi azali kosala calcul ya `id_boîte de poste = HKDF(fungola_ya_moyambi, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Kaka moto oyo ayebi `recipient_pubkey` nde akoki kosala calcul na yango — moyambi ayebi, motindi ayebi, moto ya misato ayebi te. Motindi a POST `{mailbox_id, blob}` na node nionso ya masolo. Node ebombaka paire na 7200 s (2 h), mpe esakolaka mailbox_id na filtre Bloom ya échange ya ba gossip oyo elandi. Ba noeuds mosusu oyo ezali komona mailbox_id oyo ekokani na esika moko na boîte postale ya mosaleli oyo ekangami na cache ebendaka blob mpe etindaka na client ya mosaleli wana.
bmp.h1_c: BMP esalemaki uta na ebandeli na ekipi ya Vortex. Totongaki yango mpo ete momemi-nsango moko te ya monene azalaki na mposa ya kobimisa biloko oyo esengeli mpo na kobomba ba métadonnées na nsuka na nsuka — biloko nyonso ya monene ezalaki kotinda chiffrement ya makambo kasi atikaki couche ya bopesi polele, yango wana serveur moko ayebaki kaka nani asololaki na nani mpe ntango nini. Na kati ya équipe tozalaki kaka koloba "messenger sûr oyo a fuite graphique social azalaka kaka demi sécurité." BMP ezali eyano na biso: motindi, moyambi, mpe makambo oyo ezali na kati nyonso ekomi opaque; node moko te na kati ya matiti esimbaka biteni ekoki mpo na kotonga lisusu lisolo. Ezali koleka na tissu ya gossip ya Vortex ye moko na esika ya infrastructure oyo ekangami na boulon, oyo ezali oyo esalaki que coût commercial ezala raisonnable mpe design ezala auditable na kati ya ndako.
bmp.h1_f:
id_ya_boîte de poste = HKDF(fungola_ya_moyambi, info="bmp-v1", len=32)

Dépôt: POST /bmp/dépôt {id_ya_boîte postale: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Annoncer: gossip Filtre ya bloom += id_ya boîte postale
Kozwa: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd) → blobs mpo na ba mailbox_ids ya mosaleli
TTL: 7200 s |  cap ya kobombama na node moko: 500 MB |  taux ya dépôt: 10/min/IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP epesi ba propriétés misato ya vie privée indépendante : kobomba motindi, kobomba-moyambi, kobomba makambo.
bmp.h2_b: Kobomba motindi: TLS boyokani na node ya dépôt emonisaka source IP; kobakisa Tor hop to monyololo oyo esalemi na matungulu na node ya liboso BMP elongolaka yango. Bobombami ya moyambi: mailbox_id ezali hash ya nzela moko ya recipient_pubkey oyo esalemi na mungwa na molongo ya version BMP — node ya katikati emonaka identifiant opaque ya 32 octets. Kobomba makambo: blob ezali déjà E2E-encrypté mpo na moyambi oyo azali kosalela ba touches ordinaires Vortex salle / DM, yango wana node ya katikati emonaka kaka chiphertext.
bmp.h2_c: Formulation ya ba propriétés misato ezali ndenge Pond alimbolaki mikano na yango na 2014. Vortex a refiner yango na kosala que mailbox_id ezala résistant na collision (hash ya 256 bits) mpo ba usagers mibale oyo bazali na boyokani te bakoka te kokabola na mbalakaka boîte postale. TTL ya 7200 secondes euti na observation que 95 % ya ba récipients na beta na biso ba bendaki na kati ya 2 h; ebombelo ya molai TTL gonflé par noeud sans gain ya livraison notable.
bmp.h2_f:
Adversaire oyo amoni état ya noeud:
  - ayebi mailbox_id ezali na tango T
  - est-ce que NOT ayebi motindi (azalaki TLS/Tor hop mosika)
  - est-ce que NOT ayebi moyambi (mailbox_id ezali hash ya nzela moko)
  - est-ce que NOT ayebi contenus (blob ezali E2E-encrypté)
bmp.h3_a: Ba limite ya makasi na taille ya blob, stockage par noeud, na taux ya dépôt ezo bomba BMP ekoma dead-drop pona ba données arbitraires.
bmp.h3_b: Taille ya blob ya likolo: 1 MB. Ba charges utile ya minene esengeli ko chunk na nzela ya système ya ba fichiers ordinaire, oyo ezali na nzela na yango moko ya stockage. Max ya bobateli na node moko: 500 MB total ya BMP ya ba dépôts. Tango cap ekomi, éviction ya kala-ya liboso ekitisaka ba blobs avant TTL na bango — ba opérateurs bakoki ko ajuster via `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Taux ya dépôt par IP: 10 par minute, pona ko résister na mpela oyo ewutaka na attaquant moko. Ba ID ya boîte postale oyo emonanaki koleka mbala 3/heure na kati ya réseau ezali na taux limité lokola "cible ya mpela oyo ekanisami".
bmp.h3_c: 1 MB blob cap ekokani na IRC DCC-send conventions mpe Signal’s sealed-sender cap — monene mpo na ba messages mikuse mpe ba miniatures, moke mpenza ete attaquant akoki kosalela BMP te mpo na hébergement ya fichier. 500 MB na node moko ezali OSS-par défaut sensible; ba opérateurs minene ba tombolaka yango na `BMP_MAX_BYTES`. Ba limite ya taux eyaki sima ya v0.0.8 beta esika script ya test ya tester etondisaki 50 noeuds na ba dépôts na 20 minutes.
bmp.h3_f:
ndelo:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB Ezali ndenge moko na ba .
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB Ezali ndenge moko na ba .
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # na miniti moko na IP .
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # id ya boîte postale moko na ngonga moko
bmp.h4_a: BMP engɛngaka na ba scénarios misato : ba récipients ya censure ya likolo, connectivité intermittente, ba dénoncer anonymes.
bmp.h4_b: High-censorship: motindi ayebi node ya ndako ya moyambi te (mpe mbala mosusu akoki kokoma na yango te ata ndenge nini). Drop na peer nionso, tika ba gossip route. Connexion intermittente : moyambi azali hors ligne na boumeli ya bangonga; blob azelaka, ba retries esengeli te. Déclaration anonyme : litungulu côté motindi + BMP = ba métadonnées te oyo etali nani a déposé nini. Soki basangisi yango na fungola ya shambre oyo eyebani kaka na bato oyo batyelaka motema, makambo oyo ezali na kati ezali mpe opaque mpo na intercepteur nyonso.
bmp.h4_c: Ba cas misato ya bosaleli elandaka ba motivations historiques ya ba gouttes mortes na espionnage physique (époque soviétique), pona `alt.anonymous.messages` na Usenet (1990s), pe pona SecureDrop (2013 en avant). BMP ezali komeka na biso ya komema histoire wana na kati ya momemi-nsango ya mikolo oyo kozanga ete esenga esaleli ekeseni.

push.title: Ba notifications ya push
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Web Push — nyonso na ba enveloppes oyo ekangami mpo ete ba fournisseurs bakoka kotanga te.
push.intro: Ba services ya push standard (APNs, FCM, Web Push) tala charge utile nionso. Vortex ezo envelopper notification moko na moko na couche E2E separate po fournisseur amona kaka blob opaque na id ya chambre, motindi, to texte te.
push.h1p1: Client azuaka jeton ya plateforme (jeton ya dispositif ya APNs, id ya enregistrement FCM, to abonnément ya Web Push JWT).
push.h1p2: Client azali kobimisa fungola ya sika ya 32 octets X25519 `p256dh_pub` mpe sekele ya 16 octets `auth`. POSTs `/api/push/abonnement` na `{point ya suka, p256dh, auth, plateforme}`.
push.h1p3: Node ewumeli `push_abonnements(id_ya_mosaleli, point de fin, p256dh, auth, plateforme, esalemi_na)`.
push.h2p1: Tango notification moko esengeli (message ya sika na chambre mute oyo etiamaki pona koyebisa, kolobela, kobenga invitation), node e chiffrer charge utile na AES-GCM na kosalelaka clé oyo euti na `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` via HKDF.
push.h2p2: Ba paquets ya node `{point ya suka, TTL, urgence, sujet: <collapse_key>, ba données: <ciphertext>}` mpe etindi na ba APNs / FCM / serveur Web Push.
push.h2p3: Mopesi amonaka kaka `donnée` (texte chiffre) + `sujet`. Fuite ya texte ya pamba te.
push.h3p1: Fungola ya motó ya likambo na shambre moko: `shambre:<id>`. Ba messages ebele na chambre moko e collapse na notification moko na niveau OS.
push.h3p2: Sujet ya kobenga moko: `kobenga:<id>`. Koyanola to koboya ebendaka bendele; ba invites ya sika ya kobenga na chambre moko e remplacer oyo ya kala.
push.h4p1: iOS: Extension ya Service ya notification e déchiffrer na processus NSE (kabwani na appli principal). Esalelaka ba primitifs ya CryptoKit ndenge moko.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService e déchiffrer na service ya fond. JobScheduler e programmer mise à jour ya solo UI tango app ezali avant-ground.
push.h4p3: Web: Mosali ya Service a déchiffrer na contexte SW, atie notification locale na nzela ya ba Notifications Web API.
push.h5p1: APNs: esengaka ete token ya fournisseur ezongisama sika chaque 60 min. Bozongisi ya token esalemaka automatique na nzela ya `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + fisyé ya clé p8 ya Apple.
push.h5p2: FCM: libula HTTP esika ya suka esili kozala; tosalelaka esika ya suka HTTP v1 na ba credentiels ya compte ya service OAuth2. Rotation chaque 1 h.
push.h5p3: Web Push: VAPID ba touches (pair moko ya ba touches na noeud moko). TTL capped na mikolo 28 na ba navigateurs mingi.
push.h1_a: Client akomisi jeton ya dispositif (APNs/FCM/Web Push) elongo na clé public ya sika X25519 mpe secret ya auth ya 16 octets.
push.h1_b: Client azali kobimisa `p256dh_priv = rand(32)` mpe `auth = rand(16)`. Ezali kozwa `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/api/push/abonnement` na `{point ya suka, p256dh, auth, plateforme, agent_mosaleli}`. Node ewumeli `push_abonnements(id_ya_mosaleli, point d'arrêt, p256dh, auth, plateforme, esalemi_na,_ya_kozongisa_kozongisa sika_na_ya suka)`. Rotation: client azo s’abonner lisusu na lancement nionso ya app, oyo ezo refresher `last_refreshed_at`. Ba abonnés oyo eleki mikolo 30 e purger.
push.h1_c: Ba champs p256dh + auth ewutaka na Web Push RFC 8291 (2017). Tosalelaki yango lisusu mpo na ba APN mpe FCM atako ba services wana esengaka format oyo ekangami te — kosala yango ebatelaka nzela moko ya code na kati ya misato. Yambo ya v0.0.5 Vortex etindaki ba charges utile ya texte ya pamba na nzela ya ba services ya push; sima ya mise à jour ya vie privée ya push ya Apple na 2022 mpe incident separate esika projet moko ya FCM oyo e configurer mabe e fuite ba notifications, to déplacer nionso na ba enveloppes scellés.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand (32) Ezali ndenge moko na .
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519 Ezali ndenge moko na .
auth = rand(16) ya mbongo.

POST /api/push/abonnez-vous
  { esika ya suka, p256dh: hex (p256dh_pub), auth: hex (auth), plateforme }
push.h2_a: Tango notification moko esengeli, node e chiffrer charge utile po kaka appareil ya récipient nde ekoki kotanga yango. Service ya push (Apple / Google / Mozilla) emonaka kaka blob opaque.
push.h2_b: Node aponaka paire ya ba clés X25519 ya éphémère. Ezali kozwa `ikm = ECDH(priv_ephémère, p256dh_pub)`. Ezali kotambola HKDF(mungwa=auth, ikm, info="aesgcm", len=32) → fungola. Ezali ko chiffrer `{titre, nzoto, id_ya chambre, id_ya message}` lokola CBOR → AES-GCM na clé dérivée + nonce ya 96 bits aléatoire. Etindi `{point ya suka, TTL, urgence, sujet: collapse_key, ba données: texte chiffre, aes128gcm: {mungwa, pub_ephemeral}}` na ba APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Dispositif ezuaka, extension / mosali ya service a tambusaka dérivation ya clé moko na inverse, e déchiffrer, elakisaka notification.
push.h2_c: Poussée scellée ezali directement spec ya Encryption ya Message ya Push Web ya 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple ya 2022 iOS 16 mise à jour ebakisaki lisungi ya kelasi ya liboso mpo na ba extensions ya service ya notification kosala déchiffrement; Android esungaki yango na nzela ya ba messages ya ba données FCM banda ba mbula. Vortex ezali moko ya ba messengers moke oyo e mettre en œuvre flux mobimba na code moko na ba plateformes nionso misato — iOS esalelaka `NotificationServiceExtension`, Android esalelaka `FirebaseMessagingService`, Web esalelaka mosali ya service.
push.h2_f:
priv_ephémère = rand (32);  ephémère_pub = ephémère_priv · G
ikm = ECDH(priv_ephémère, p256dh_pub) Ezali na ba mbongo mingi te.
prk = HMAC-SHA256(mokonzi, ikm)
fungola = HKDF-Kopanzana (prk, "Kokɔtisa makambo-ya: aes128gcm\x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-Expand(prk, "Kosala encodage ya makambo: nonce\x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Chiffrer(fungola, nonce, charge utile)
tinda { esika ya suka, ba données: mungwa∥taille_ya_enregistrement∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct }
push.h3_a: Ba touches ya collapse epekisaka ba notifications ebele oyo ewutaka na chat moko ezala stacking lokola ba bannières individuelles — OS esangisaka yango na moko.
push.h3_b: Kokwea ya shambre moko: sujet = `shambre:<id>`. `apns-collapse-id` ya ba APN mpe `collapse_key` ya FCM eyebisaka OS a remplacer ba notifications ya liboso na sujet moko. Mosaleli amonaka banner moko na chambre moko ata soki ba messages ekomi boni. Kokwea ya kobenga moko: motó ya likambo = `kobenga:<id>`; ba invitations ya sika ya kobenga na chambre moko e remplacer oyo ya kala. Per-mention: topic = `lobela:<mosaleli>:<shambre>`; banner moko ya kolobela na paire moko ya usager-shambre.
push.h3_c: Ba clés ya collapse ebakisami na ba APN na iOS 10 (2016) mpe na FCM na 2014. Yambo na yango, ba explosions multi-message ebimisaki ba stacks multi-banner oyo basaleli bayinaki uniformement. Telegram nde azali pionnier ya kokweya ya chambre moko UX na 2015; momemi-nsango nyonso ya monene alandaki. Vortex's split into room / call / mention collapse ewutaki na ba retours ya usager na v0.0.6 beta que "call invitation remplacer chat banner" ayokaki mabe — ba sujets separates ebongisaki yango.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-collapse-id = chambre:42 → ezongisaka ba pancartes ya liboso
FCM: collapse_key = kobenga:17 → ezongisaka ba pancartes ya liboso
Web: sujet = mention:u12:r5 → ezo remplacer ba bannières ya liboso
push.h4_a: Plateforme moko na moko ezali na ba gotchas na yango. iOS esengeli na Extension ya Service ya Notification; Android esengeli na FCM ba messages ya ba données; Web esengeli na mosali ya service + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: liboke ya app etindi cible ya `NotificationServiceExtension`. Système epesaka charge utile chiffrée na NSE; NSE ezali na 30 s ya CPU + 25 MB ya mémoire mpo na ko déchiffrer mpe ko muter notification avant elakisami. FCM: totindaka ba messages `données` (`notification` te) donc FirebaseMessagingService ya app esala na arrivée — oyo epesaka biso contrôle ya soki to lakisa banner. Web Push: mosali ya service a intercepter ba événements ya `push`, a déchiffrer, alakisaka na nzela ya `self.registration.showNotification`.
push.h4_c: Motindo ya NSE ekɔtisamaki na Apple na iOS 10 (2016) mpenzampenza mpo na makambo ya kosalela nsango-déchiffrement. Yambo na yango, ba messengers chiffrés ya suka na suka basengelaki kopona kati na ba charges utile ya poussée ya texte plain (privacy-hostile) mpe ba poussures ya badge-seul (UX-hostile). WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram nionso e sautaki na ba NSE na kati ya mbula moko. Vortex elandaka ndenge moko.
push.h5_a: Quirks spécifiques ya fournisseur — eteni ya mokapo ya kopusama. Oyo ezali moko ya ba mécanismes ya moboko oyo etalisami na référence mobimba ya Vortex. Tángá mokapo oyo ezali zingazinga mpo na koyeba makambo oyo ezali na kati; eteni oyo ezali kosala zoom na bizaleli ya sikisiki.
push.h5_b: Botali ya bosaleli mpo na "Ba quirks spécifiques ya mopesi". Mecanisme esalemi na module oyo ekokani na se ya `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, to `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README ebengaka banzela ya sikisiki ya fisyé.
push.h5_c: Mecanisme ya "quirks spécifiques ya fournisseur" evoluaki na kati ya ba sorties Vortex. Bokeli yango ebandi na bolukiluki mpe misala ya kobimisa oyo ebimisamaki ya bamemi-nsango ya kala. Histoire ya version na `CHANGELOG.md` ekomaka tango pièce moko na moko ekita pe nini e motiver yango.

controller.title: Service ya contrôleur
controller.subtitle: Attestation ya intégrité, découverte ya entrée, suivi ya santé.
controller.intro: Contrôleur ezali processus Python ekeseni. Surface ya attaque na yango ezali moke (pene na douzaine ya ba routes) mpe confiance na yango ekangami na clé publique moko ya Ed25519 oyo ekangami na ba clients.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/integrité` — mbano ya botangi. Schéma: `{ezalela, signé_na, pubkey_ya_confiance, version, built_at, ekokani, ekokani te, ezangi, ya likolo, message}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/santé` — bomoi. Schéma: `{état: "ok", version, pubkey, statistiques:{en ligne, endimami, total}}`.
controller.h1p3: `GET /v1/entries` — ba URL ya bokoti. Schéma: `[{protocole: "wss"|"https", url}...]`.
controller.h1p4: `GET /v1/mirrors` — ba contrôleurs ya miroir (DNS + IPFS + .ba variantes ya matungulu).
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` — sonde ya bomoi ya node. Esalemi na ba noeuds fédérés mpo na kobatela enregistrement na bango ya sika.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — node ya sika esengi bondimi. Esengaka ndingisa ya administrateur longola se soki `AUTO_APPROVE=solo`.
controller.h2p1: Fisyé ya manifeste: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Ezali na hash moko BLAKE3 + signature ya Ed25519 na fichier moko.
controller.h2p2: Nkola: `python -m vortex_contrôleur.intégrité.esaleli_ya_elembo`. Atangi fungola ya kobimisa uta na `keys/release.key`, atamboli nzete, akomi manifeste.
controller.h2p3: Vérification: contrôleur atangi manifeste na démarrage mpe akokanisaka contre disque. Startup elongi te makasi na mismatch.
controller.h3p1: Ba miroirs ezo tambuisa code ya contrôleur moko na clé ya sortie moko copiée likolo. Ba clients bamonaka `signed_by` identique na kati ya ba miroirs — lolenge moko ya ko détecter faux miroir ezali ya ko comparer ba pubkeys.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS kobimisa ba pointeurs na moko ya ba miroirs ebele. Ba clients bamekaka na ordre ya priorité na ba temps d'expiration.
controller.h3p3: Répertoire `vortex.sol-mirror/` na repo oyo ezali talatala ya trycloudflare oyo ezali prêt ya kokende pona développement.
controller.h1_a: Surface public API ya contrôleur ezali soki douzaine ya ba routes. Nyonso ya mike, nionso etali mingi attestation mpe entrée-URL découverte.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/integrity` — litatoli ya manifeste oyo etiamaki sinyatili. `/v1/santé` — bomoi + pubkey + statistiques. `/v1/entries` — ba URL ya bokoti mpo na boyokani. `/v1/mirrors` — ba contrôleurs ya miroir. `/v1/trusted_nodes` — baninga ya fédération. `/v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` — sonde ya bomoi ya node. `/v1/register` — node ya sika esengi bondimi (ndingisa ya mokambi longola se soki `AUTO_APPROVE=solo`). Yango nde — délibérément étroit mpo na kobatela surface ya attaque minimal.
controller.h1_c: Conception ya surface étroite e informer na observation que processus ya attestation ekomi cible ya valeur ya likolo mbala moko ba clients ba pin na yango. Code ya moke = surface ya moke. Comparer na noeud oyo eza na 120+ routes; contrôleur azali na 12. Motindo ya ndenge moko: apt-get ya Debian etie motema na processus moko ya moke ya `Release.gpg` oyo ekeseni na hébergement ya paquet.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` etambolaka nzete ya source, e hashes fichier nionso, e signer na clé ya sortie, ekomi `INTEGRITY.sig.json`.
controller.h2_b: Esaleli etangi `bafungola/kobimisa.fungola` (fungola ya privé ya Ed25519 ya 32 octets). Tambolaka `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (elongoli ba fichiers gitignoré). Mpo na fisyé moko na moko: `blake3(content) → hash`. Etongami manifeste `{version, built_at, ba fichiers: [{nzela, sha256, taille}]}`. Ezali kosala calcul ya `ba octets_canoniques = CBOR(manifest)`. Bilembo: `sig = Ed25519-Sign(fungola_ya_bobimisi, ba octets_canoniques)`. Akomi `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {manifest, signé_na: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Ba manifestes oyo e signer ezongaka na Release.gpg (1997) ya Debian na ba tarballs ya noyau Linux oyo e signer PGP. Sigstore (2021) a refiné modèle pona attestation ya chaîne d’approvisionnement. Version ya Vortex ezali léger mingi mpo e attesté déploiement moko, kasi chaîne ya sortie multi-partite te. Tokoki ko adopter Sigstore na v0.4 pona ba sorties publiques.
controller.h3_a: Ba miroirs ezo tambuisa code ya contrôleur moko na clé ya sortie moko. Ba entrées ebele DNS / SNS / IPFS elakisaka moko ya ba miroirs ebele.
controller.h3_b: Ba opérateurs ba setup ba miroirs N (typiquement 3-5). Moko na moko azali kosala code `vortex_controller` ndenge moko na `keys/release.key` ndenge moko. Ba clients bamonaka `signed_by` identique na ba miroirs — vérification ya santé ya malamu. DNS/SNS/IPFS akomaka liste ya ba miroirs na ba priorités. Ba clients bamekaka na ordre ya priorité, na 7-secondes timeout na tentative moko. Répertoire `vortex.sol-mirror/` na repo oyo ezali ndakisa ya talatala ya trycloudflare oyo ekangami liboso.
controller.h3_c: Ba miroirs ebele na recherche ya priorité ezali modèle moko oyo SMTP asalelaka pona ba enregistrements MX pe HTTPS asalelaka pona ba enregistrements SRV. Bakonzi ya répertoire ya Tor bazali modèle oyo etali yango — 9 DAs hardcoded + votes. Vortex aponaki "pona talatala oyo esalaka" na esika ya "vote ya quorum" mpo ba designs basés na ba votes ezali plus résistants mais beaucoup plus malembe na bootstrap.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/integrité : GET → mbano ya botangi
/v1/health : GET → {ezalela, version, pubkey, statistiques}
/v1/entries : GET → [{protocole, url}, ...] Ezali na ntina mingi kozala na bomoi ya malamu.
/v1/mirrors : GET → [url_ya_mokonzi, ...]
/v1/trusted_nodes : GET → [{fungola ya pub, esika ya suka, bokolongono}, ...]
/v1/heartbeat/{pk} : POST (euti na ba noeuds enregistrés kaka)
/v1/register : POST (mpo na ba noeuds ya sika)
controller.h2_f:
esaleli = esaleli_ya_elembo
input = nzete ya source, ba touches/release.key
manifeste = { .
  version: "0.1.0",
  etongami_na: unix_ms, .
  ba fisyé: [{nzela, sha256, bonene}, ...]
} .
sig = Ed25519-Sign (bobimisi_priv, CBOR (manifest))
sortie = INTEGRITY.sig.json = {manifest, signé_na: pub_hex, sig: sig_hex}
controller.h3_f:
DNSLink TXT _dnslink.vortexx.sol: lien dnslink=/ipfs/<CID>
SNS enregistrer vortexx.sol: {"ba talatala": [url1, url2, url3]}
IPFS CID: INTEGRITY.sig.json ezongelami
client picks: liboso réponse na ordre ya priorité, 7 s timeout

storage.title: Couche ya kobomba biloko
storage.subtitle: SQLite mpo na dev, Postgres mpo na prod, Alembic mpo na ba migrations, GRDB/Room/IndexedDB na ba clients.
storage.intro: Bobombi ya node ya Vortex ezali SQL. Kobongola kati ya SQLite (dev) mpe Postgres (prod) ezali mbongwana ya DATABASE_URL — ba fourchettes ya code te.
storage.h1p1: `basaleli(id, kombo ya mosaleli, hash_ya_mot ya nzela, x25519_fungola_ya_mokonzi, kyber_fungola_ya_ya_ya_elakiseli?, kombo_ya_elakiseli, avatar_url, telefone, email, esalemi_na, ezali_actif)` — tableau ya identité ya liboso.
storage.h1p2: `ba dispositif_ya_mosaleli(id, id_ya_mosaleli, id_ya_esaleli, agent_ya_mosaleli,_ya_mosusu_na_na_komona_na_kolongola_na)` — milɔngɔ ya session ya dispositif moko.
storage.h1p3: `ba chambre(id, lolenge, kombo, ezali_privé, ezali_channel, ezali_dm, motango_ya_membre, avatar_url, esalemi_na, esalemi_na, ndimbola)` — mesa ya chambre, molongo moko na chambre moko.
storage.h1p4: `ba membres_ya_chambre(id_ya_chambre, id_ya_mosaleli, rôle, joined_at, muted_ti)` — membres + ACL.
storage.h1p5: `messages (id, id_ya_shambre, id_ya_motindi, texte_cipher, nonce, pseudo_ya_motindi, atindami_na, ebongolamaki_na?, elongolami_na?, eyano_na?, id_ya_thread?, lolenge)` — nsango nyonso, indexé na `(id_ya_shambre, id)`.
storage.h1p6: `reactions(id_ya_message, id_ya_mosaleli, emoji, esalemi_na)` — fungola ya liboso ya kosangisa `(id_ya_nsango, id_ya_mosaleli, emoji)`.
storage.h1p7: `fisyé(id, id_ya_mosaleli, lolenge_ya_mime, bonene, sha256 /* ya solo BLAKE3 */, nzela_ya_bobombi, etandami_na)` — métadonnées ya fisyé.
storage.h1p8: `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` — pointeur ya kotanga ya sika na mosaleli moko na chambre moko.
storage.h1p10: `fédérations(pubkey, point final, santé_score, ebakisami_na, ebakisami_na, elongolami_na)` — liste ya baninga.
storage.h1p11: `fédération_outbox (id, node_cible, charge utile, ba tentatives, sima_komeka_na)` — molongo ya kobima.
storage.h1p12: `scheduled_messages (id, id_ya_shambre, ciphertext, nonce, tinda_na, esalemi_na, esalemi_na, annulé_na)`.
storage.h1p13: `contacts(id_ya_mosaleli, id_ya_mosaleli_ya_kokutana, nkombo ya lisɛki, ebakisami_na)` — buku ya baadrɛsi.
storage.h1p14: `saved_gifs(id_ya_mosaleli, url, bonene, bosanda, ebakisami_na)` — lisanga ya mosaleli moko GIF.
storage.h1p15: `ba dossiers(id_ya_mosaleli, id, kombo, id_ya_shambre, ezali_système, esalemi_na)` — ba dossiers ya masolo.
storage.h1p16: `bot_installations(id_ya_mosaleli, bot_id, installé_na)` — bot ya mosaleli moko na moko.
storage.h1p17: `sessions(jti, id_ya_mosaleli, id_ya_appareil, expires_at)` — kozongisa sika registre ya bilembo.
storage.h1p18: `push_abonnements(id_ya_mosaleli, esika ya suka, p256dh, auth, plateforme, created_at)` — kotindika bokomisi nkombo.
storage.h2p1: Alembique na `alembic/versions/`. Histoire linéaire, révision moko na sortie moko (ntango mosusu mwa ndambo na sortie moko).
storage.h2p2: Mode Dev: `kosala_nyonso + ALTER TABLE fallback` mpo na iterations ya mbangu.
storage.h2p3: Mode Prod: `motó ya mise à niveau alembic` liboso ya kobanda. Image ya Docker ezo tambuisa yango na point d'entrée.
storage.h3p1: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — index ya liboso mpo na kozwa nkasa.
storage.h3p2: `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — mpo na kosala ordre oyo esalemi na tango na bobongisi.
storage.h3p3: `reactions(message_id)` — mpo na bosangisi na chambre ya polele.
storage.h3p4: `read_receipts(chambre_id, message_id)` — mpo na `emonani na N` boluki.
storage.h3p5: `user_devices(user_id)` — mpo na kotanga ba dispositifs oyo ezali kosala.
storage.h3p6: FTS ba tableaux virtuels (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) mpo na boluki ya makomi mobimba.
storage.h4p1: `make db-backup` ebimisaka archive oyo ezali na elembo ya ngonga. Chiffré na repos na clé ya opérateur.
storage.h4p2: Bokangami : mokolo na mokolo na boumeli ya mikolo 14, poso na poso na boumeli ya baposo 4, sanza na sanza na boumeli ya sanza 12.
storage.h4p3: Bozongisi: `sala db-kozongisa FILE=<nzela>`. Akimaka na scène moko DB liboso; opérateur a vérifiaka sima a swaps.
storage.h1_a: Bobombi ya node ezali SQL. SQLite mpo na dev mpe ya mike mike oyo eyambami; PostgreSQL mpo na bokeli ya fédéré to ya ba noeuds ebele. Code ya async SQLAlchemy 2.x moko ezo diriger nionso mibale.
storage.h1_b: Config na nzela ya `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` to `postgresql+asyncpg://mosaleli:pw@hôte/db`. Configuration moko, ba fourchettes ya code te. SQLite ezo tambola na kati ya processus; Postgres ezo tambola separatement. Performance: SQLite esimbaka ~50 usagers concurrents na confort na M1; Postgres échelles na ba nkoto. Migration Postgres → SQLite ezali nzela moko na nzela ya `pg_dump --data-only` + importation ya SQLite; ngámbo mosusu ezali ndenge moko.
storage.h1_c: Motindo ya "moko ORM, mibale ya sima" ezali momesano ya SQLAlchemy ya mibu zomi. Vortex esalelaka async 2.x API yango wana motuna nyonso ezali kozela. Toponaki SQLAlchemy Core likolo ya Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / `asyncpg` brut mpo na lisolo ya migration ya riche mpe match na ba idiomes ya async ya FastAPI.
storage.h2_a: 18 tableaux ya moboko : basaleli, ba appareils_ya_mosaleli, ba salles, ba membres_ya_shambre, ba messages, ba réactions, ba fichiers, ba récépiss_read_read, présence, ba fédérations, boîte de sortie_ya fédération, ba messages_programmées, ba contacts, ba_gifs_saved, ba dossiers, ba installations_bots, ba sessions, ba abonnés_ya push.
storage.h2_b: Tableau ya basaleli ezali mosisa ya identité. room_members esimbaka (chambre, mosaleli, rôle, joined_at, muted_ti). ba messages ememaka chiphertext + ba métadonnées; indexé na (room_id, id) mpo na kozwa nkasa. ba réactions ezali tableau composé-primaire-clé. Makambo mosusu nyonso ezali semba. Bobombi ekolaka na ndenge ya linéaire na motango ya ba messages — soki 1 KB na message moko na disque sima ya index ya likolo.
storage.h2_c: Schéma ezalaki stable sima ya v0.0.4. Liboso tozalaki na ba tableaux `dm_messages` na `group_messages` ekeseni; esangisamaki na v0.0.3 sima ya code ya fanout oyo e doublé na kati ya nionso mibale. Ba tableaux 18 ezali minimum mpo na messenger oyo azali na fonctionnalités mobimba; ba déploiements ya minene ebakisi ba tableaux ya analyse mais wana ezali na besoin te pona fonctionnement.
storage.h3_a: Alembic nde azali ko gérer ba migrations. Histoire ya révision linéaire, révision moko na sortie moko. Bobongoli nyonso ezali na misala nyonso mibale `upgrade()` mpe `downgrade()`.
storage.h3_b: `alembic/versions/` esimbaka ba révisions. Moko na moko ezali fichier Python na upgrade/downgrade. CI azali kosala `tête ya mise à niveau alémbique` + `tête ya mise à niveau alémbique -1` + `tête ya mise à niveau alémbique` pona ko vérifier voyage aller-retour. Production: `make db-migrate` ezo exécuter na point d'entrée ya Docker avant app ebanda. Mode Dev esalelaka `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` yango wana iterations ezalaka mbangu sans que ezala na besoin ya ba migrations na rebase nionso.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) ezali esaleli ya bopanzi sango ya SQLAlchemy ya canon. Histoire linéaire (branchement te) ezali pona — ezo éviter problème ya "ba développeurs mibale ba créer numéro ya révision moko". Ba migrations ya Django esalelaka approche moko. Rails elongwaki na linéaire mpe ekómaki na timestamped na 2014 kasi ezwaki lisusu linéaire-na-merge na 2020.
storage.h4_a: Ba index ya ba clés ezuami na bokebi boye ba lectures ya moto (ba messages, ba réactions, ba récépissés ya kotanga) ebeta disque rarement.
storage.h4_b: `messages(chambre_id, id DESC)` — index ya bopanzi sango ya liboso. `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — bozongi sima oyo ebongisami na tango mpo na bobongisi. `reactions(message_id)` — bosangisi na chambre efungwami. `read_receipts(id_chambre, message_id)` — "emonani na N" etangami. `ba dispositif_ya_mosaleli(id_ya_mosaleli)` — liste ya bisaleli. FTS ba tableaux virtuels pona boluki (FTS5 na SQLite, tsvector na Postgres).
storage.h4_c: Ba choix ya index ewutaki na explain-plan-profiling na tango ya test ya charge ya v0.0.4. Tobandaki na ba index naïfs mpe tobakisaki/tolongolaki na kotalela ba modèles ya requête oyo emonanaki. `messages(room_id, id DESC)` ezali index moko oyo eleki molunge — pene na 80 % ya ba lectures ebeti yango. Kobatela yango moke (ba colonnes inclure te) e permettre yango ekota na mémoire.
storage.h1_f:
SQLite (dev): BASE_BASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///./vortex.db
Postgres (prod): BASE_DONNEES_URL=postgresql+asyncpg://u:p@hôte/db

config oyo ekɔtisami na app.database.get_engine() → nzela moko ya code

bots.title: Cadre ya bot
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + zando + antispam.
bots.intro: Ba bots bazali ba participants ya chambre ya classe ya liboso. Ba messages e signer na clé Ed25519 ya bot donc ba fausses ezala détectable.
bots.h1p1: Nzela mibale: Python SDK to Gravitix DSL. Python ezali mpo na ba flux ya mosala ya mindondo; Gravitix mpo na ba bots ya chat oyo etambwisami na makambo oyo esengeli kotindama nokinoki.
bots.h1p2:
Python ndakisa: `uta na vortex_bot import Bot
bot = Bot (jeton=...)
@bot.na_message
async def echo(msg): zela bot.tinda (msg.id_shambre, msg.text)
bot.run ()`. SDK esimbaka WebSocket, reconnexion, échange ya clé ya chiffrement.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix ndakisa: `na /start { emit "Mbote, {ctx.kombo_ya_ya liboso}!" }`. Compile na bytecode mpe ezo tambola na interprète sandboxed.
bots.h1p4: Token ya bot ebimaka na création ya bot. Token ebungaki? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` ebimisi ya sika.
bots.h2p1: Modèles mibale ya déploiement : en processus (coroutine na kati ya noeud) na libanda (bot polls `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: En-processus: zéro saut de réseau, plus vite, mais opérateur asengeli ko confier code bot. Good mpo na ba bots ya bango moko.
bots.h2p3: Ya libanda: webhook to long-poll. Confiance ya niveau ya node esengeli te. Good mpo na ba bots ya bato mosusu mpe zando.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix bots ezo tambola toujours en processus na sandbox — ezalaka na système ya ba fichiers to accès ya réseau te sauf API ya polele.
bots.h3p1: Ba bots publics ekoki ko soumettre na marché. Ba reviseurs ba vérifier code e phish te, e spam te, e fuite ba données ya usager te.
bots.h3p2: Catégories: productivité, jeux, sango, utilités, ai, traduction.
bots.h3p3: Installation: clic moko. Node e abonnés usager na kombo ya usager ya bot donc ba DMs route correctement.
bots.h3p4: Monetisation : ofele, kosomba mbala moko, abonnément. Frais ya plateforme 10 %% ya brut.
bots.h4p1: Chambre nionso ezo surveiller na bot antispam invisible. Ba vérifications : densité ya lien > 3 par minute, rapport ya lettre minene > 70 %% pona 10+ chars, ba messages ya kozongela, explosion brusque ya ba joineurs ya compte ya sika.
bots.h4p2: Misala: kokebisa → ntango ya kosila (5 min) → kobɛta makolo → kopekisa. Ba recours ekendaka na admin ya chambre.
bots.h1_a: Ba bots bazali ba participants ya chambre ya classe ya liboso. Moko na moko ezali na fungola ya Ed25519 mpe elembo; message nionso oyo batindaka e signer, yango wana ba faux ezali détectable.
bots.h1_b: Bokela: nkolo a POST `/api/bots` na `{nkombo ya mosaleli, nkombo_ya_elakiseli, code}`. Node esali molongo ya `basaleli` na `is_bot=true`, esali pair ya ba clés Ed25519, ezongisaka jeton ya bot ya clé privée na nkolo (elakisami mbala moko). Run: bot soit e vivre en-processus lokola coroutine to libanda e sondaka `/api/bots/{id}/updates` na jeton na yango. Ba messages oyo ewutaka na ba bots ememaka drapeau `from_bot: true` mpe e signer na clé privée ya bot.
bots.h1_c: Ba API ya Bot esalemaki na Slack (2014) mpe e refiné na Telegram (2015). Vortex's twist: ba signature ya bot ekangisaka ba messages na identité ya bot, donc noeud moko compromis ekokaki ko fabrication "@bot alobaki X" te. Soutien ya bot ya Matrix ebakisaki propriété oyo na 2021 via ba signature fédérale; Vortex azali na yango banda v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix ezali monoko ya domaine spécifique mpo na kokoma ba bots oyo etambwisami na makambo. Petit, expressif, compilé na bytecode sandboxed.
bots.h2_b: Syntaxe: `on /start { emit "Mbote, {ctx.kombo_ya_ya liboso}!" }`. Ba handlers bakangamaka na ba déclencheur (commandement, regex, événement). Nzoto ezali molongo ya `emit`, `let`, `soki`, `programme`, etc. Compilateur ebimisaka bytecode; runtime e interpréter na sandbox oyo ezali na système ya ba fichiers te, réseau arbitraire te, kaka ya Vortex's API. Référence mobimba na mokapo ya Gravitix docs.
bots.h2_c: Gravitix esalemaki na tango ya v0.0.6 sima ya komona que code ya bot mingi ezalaki 80 % chaudière mpo na ko filer Vortex SDK, na noyau ya logique ya solo na kati. A DSL etiki logique engɛnga mpe epekisaka ko pelle Python arbitraire na environnement ya bot-dev esika ba escapes ya sandbox ezali probable.
bots.h3_a: Chambre nionso ezali na bot antispam oyo emonanaka te oyo etalaka mpela, ba spam ya lien, ba messages oyo ezongaka mbala na mbala, mpe ba explosions ya joint ya compte ya sika.
bots.h3_b: Mibeko : densité ya lien > 3 na minute moko ewutaka na mosaleli moko, rapport ALL-CAPS > 70 % na ba messages ≥ 10 chars, répétition ya message > 3 fois na 30 s, explosion ya ba joineurs na âge ya compte < 24 h > 20 na 60 s. Misala emati : likebisi → 5 minutes timeout → 1 heure kick → interdiction (ndingisa ya administrateur pona interdiction). Tuneable na chambre moko na nzela ya `/antispam config`.
bots.h3_c: Heuristics antispam ewutaka na synthèse ya mibeko ya bot ya IRC-era (Eggdrop, BitchX) na ba systèmes modernes lokola Discord AutoMod. Ba seuils spécifiques na Vortex e tuned contre corpus beta ya 6 mois ya 200k messages; taux ya lokuta-positif ezali ~0,3 % na taux ya interdiction-recours oyo emonanaki.
bots.h4_a: Ba bots publics ba soumettre na marché. Ba reviseurs ba vérifier phishing te / spam te / ba fuites ya ba données te. Ba usagers ba naviguer par catégorie pe ba installer na clic moko.
bots.h4_b: Botindiki: nkolo a poster bot source + description. Motali atambolisaka code na boîte de sable, atangi yango mpo na ba anti-modèles oyo eyebani, a vérifier ba appels nionso ya réseau elekaka na ba API oyo epesami nzela, a vérifier politique ya confidentialité. Liste: catégorie, prix, cote, nombre ya installation. Installation: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` — node esali abonnément ya mosaleli moko. Monetisation: ofele / ya mbala moko / abonnément; plateforme ezuaka 10 %.
bots.h4_c: Ba marchés ya app ezongaka na App Store ya 2008. Annuaire ya ba apps ya Slack (2015), Liste ya ba bots ya Discord (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Vortex ya 10 % ya kokata ezali na nse ya Apple ya 30 % mpe mwa moke na nse koleka 20 % ya Shopify, oyo eponami mpo na kolendisa ba développeurs mpo na kobimisa. Politiki ya botali esalemi na ndakisa ya "botali na ndenge ya libela, bolongoli liste na bofundami" ya GitLab.
bots.h3_f:
makambo oyo ebandisaka:
  densité_ya_lien > 3/min → kokebisa
  ratio_ya_caps_nionso > 0,7 (≥10c) → kebisa
  repeat_count > 3 na ba 30s → kebisa
  new_joiner_burst > 20 na ba 60s → serrure ya chambre

komata ya makasi:
  2 makebisi → 5 min ya ntango ya kosila
  3 makebisi → 1 h kobɛta makolo
  4 makebisi → kopekisa (admin andimi)
bots.h4_f:
biteni : bobimisi, masano, sango, biloko ya kosalela, ai, bobongoli
prix: ofele | mbala moko (USD motuya) | abonnément (USD/sanza)
kokata: 90 % na développeur, 10 % na Vortex
revue: manuel, ~3 mikolo ya mosala cible retour

ops.title: Misala ya kosala
ops.subtitle: Déployer, monitor, retour.
ops.intro: Mosala nionso ya opération ezali na cible `make` to commande CLI. Ba pages ya Ops efandaka na `deploy/`.
ops.h1p1: `docker compose up` ememaka noeud, contrôleur, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1p2: Volumes: `/données/vortex.db`, ​​`/données/uploads`, `/données/logs`. Montant na hôte pona persistance.
ops.h1p3: Environnement: `.env` na misisa ya repo. Komipesa ata mokolo moko te. `.env.example` ezali modèle.
ops.h1p4: Caddy auto-azuaka ba certs ya Let's Encrypt. Let's Encrypt ndelo ya taux esalemaka — salela staging mpo na ba expériences.
ops.h2p1: `sala install` — installer Python deps + bisaleli ya dev.
ops.h2p2: `make dev` — uvicorn na recharge na port 9000.
ops.h2p4: `kosala lint` — ruff + mypy. CI ba blocs na ba échecs.
ops.h2p5: `sala docker-build` — kotonga elilingi oyo ezali na elembo `vortex:<VERSION>`.
ops.h2p8: `sala ci` — kosala pipeline mobimba CI na esika.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` ezali liboke ya PyInstaller oyo ezali na pywebview GUI.
ops.h3p2: Flux ya liboso : pona kombo ya node → kobimisa ba touches ya sortie → configurer TLS (Let's Encrypt / mema-yo-yo moko / auto-signé) → pona ba URL ya entrée → activer stealth → fungola ba ports ya mur de feu.
ops.h3p3: Sima ya configuration, assistent etikalaka lokola console ya administrateur : noeud ya kobanda/kotelemisa, kotala ba journal, ko tourner ba touches, kobakisa ba peers fédérés.
ops.h4p1: Version nionso e marqué na git. Tag pe e signaki na touche ya sortie donc tag yango moko ezala vérifiable.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git checkout <tag> && kosala docker-build && docker ekoma likolo -d`. Ba noeuds oyo ezali kotambola ezo drainer pe ezo restarter.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` esungami mpo na version moko ya moke sima. Kozonga sima esengaka intervention manuelle.
ops.h1_a: `docker compose up` ememi ebele ya Vortex mobimba: node, contrôleur, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` na misisa ya repo. Volumes `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` ekangami na hôte mpo ba données ewumela na kati ya ba restarts. Healthchecks: node ya nzoto kolɔngɔnɔ iff `/santé/prêt` ezongisaka 200; contrôleur iff `/v1/integrité` ezongisi vérifié. Caddy auto-azuaka ba certs ya Let's Encrypt. `.env` epesaka ba secrets (jamais kosala). `.env.example` ezali modèle.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose ezali modèle de-facto mpo na ba services oyo ezo héberger yango moko na ba conteneurs ebele. Umami, Fantôme, Plausible, Miniflux bango nionso basalelaka yango. Fisyé ya composer ya Vortex ezalaki iterée kobanda v0.0.2 en avant; forme ya lelo e stabilisé na v0.0.5. Ba alternatives (k8s, nomade) etikali lokola exercice pona ba opérateurs ya minene.
ops.h2_a: Makefile ezali point d'entrée centrale pona action nionso ya dev na ops. `sala lisalisi` ezali na liste ya ba cibles.
ops.h2_b: `sala install` → `pip installer -r masengi.txt`. `sala dev` → uvicorn na recharge. `sala test` → pytest + couverture, ebimisi `couverture.xml`. `kosala lint` → ruff + mypy. `kosala docker-build` → `docker kotonga -t vortex:$VERSION`. `sala db-migrate` → `motó ya bomatisi ya alembic`. `sala db-backup` / `sala db-kozongisa FILE=...`. `sala ci` → pipeline mobimba CI na esika.
ops.h2_c: Makefile moko lokola point d’entrée canonique ezali pratique Unix ya ba décennies, adoptée na projet nionso ya munene Python (pytest, django, flacon, fastapi). Bisaleli mosusu (Poésie, Hatch, uv) ezali elengi-ya-mbula; Make ezali ennuyeux mpe universel.
ops.h3_a: Assistant ya bobongisi ezali liboke ya PyInstaller (`Vortex Wizard.app`) na pywebview GUI oyo etambolaka opérateur ya mbala ya liboso na nzela ya déploiement.
ops.h3_b: Flux ya liboso: pona kombo ya node → kobimisa ba touches ya liberation (Ed25519 keypair ebombami na `keys/release.key`) → configurer TLS (Let's Encrypt / mema-yo-yo moko / auto-signé) → pona ba URL ya entrée (vortexx.sol / domaine personnalisé / .onion) → activer niveau ya stealth → fungola ba ports ya firewall (ba iptables/ufw/pf) oyo ezali na kati. Sima ya kosala liboso, assistent etikalaka lokola console ya administrateur : node ya kobanda/kotelemisa, kotala ba journal, kobalusa ba touches, kobakisa baninga fédéré.
ops.h3_c: Ba assistents ya configuration ezali modèle ya ba outils auto-hébergements oyo etali ba usagers oyo bazali sysadmin te: onboarding ya Ghost (2015), configuration ya serveur ya Standard Notes, mituna ya installation ya Mastodon. PyInstaller e permettre biso to tinda binaire moko oyo ekoki ko cliquer mbala mibale; pywebview ezongisaka lokasa ya HTML ya esika oyo esalelami na mokambi ya FastAPI API oyo esangisi na 127.0.0.1 — navigateur UX kozanga complexité ya kotonga GUI ya mboka.
ops.h4_a: Bobimisi nyonso ezali na bilembo na git. Rollback ezali `git checkout <tag> && kosala docker-build && docker composer likolo -d`. Ba migrations ezali na ba fonctions ya `downgrade()`.
ops.h4_b: Ba étiquettes e signer na clé ya sortie donc tag yango moko ezala vérifiable. Procédure ya retour : checkout tag ya kala, kotonga lisusu image, ko recréer ba récipients — ba connexions oyo ezali kosala drain na SIGTERM (grace ya 15 s par défaut). DB: `bokiti ya alembic <rev>` ezongisaka bozongeli moko. Koboya kobungisa ba données : tobwakaka jamais ba colonne na sortie moko; ba gouttes esalemaka N+1 après code etiki kotanga yango.
ops.h4_c: Motindo ya bopanzani "code-then-code" (expand-migrate-contract) ezali standard mpo na ba déploiements ya tango ya arrêt zéro. Buku ya migration ya Stripe (2019) elimboli yango malamu koleka. Vortex a adoptaki yango sima ya incident moko na v0.0.3 esika colonne ekita e forcer fenêtre ya entretien ya 30 minutes.
ops.h1_f:
misala ya kosala:
  node: elilingi: vortex:ba ports ya sika: [9000:9000].
  contrôleur: image: ba ports ya contrôleur ya vortex: [8800:8800].
  postgres: elilingi: postgres:16 volumes: [./données/pg:/var/lib/postgresql/données]
  redis: elilingi: redis:7
  coturn: elilingi: ba ports ya coturn/coturn: [3478:3478/udp, 49152-65535:49152-65535/udp]
  caddy: elilingi: ba ports ya caddy: [80:80, 443:443].
ops.h2_f:
kosala install pip installer -r masengi.txt
kosala dev uvicorn --kozongisa charge
kosala test pytest + couverture
kosala ruff ya lint + mypy
kosala docker-tonga docker kotonga -t vortex:$VERSION .
sala db-migrate alembic mutu ya mise à niveau
sala ci lint + test + kosala migration vérification
ops.h3_f:
Vortex Assistant.app
  → Liboke ya PyInstaller
  → ebandi fenêtre ya pywebview (HTML ya esika)
  → asololi na administrateur bundled FastAPI na 127.0.0.1:random-port
  → ebimisaka ba clés, akomaka .env, esali migration ya liboso
ops.h4_f:
flux ya kobimisa:
  1. ko déployer code ya sika; ya kala na ya sika bango mibale batangi "v1".
  2. migration: code ya sika ekomi "v2"; ya kala azali kaka kotanga "v1".
  3. kotondisa sima "v1" → "v2".
  4. sortie oyo elandi: bwaka nzela ya code ya kala
  5. migration: bwaka colonne "v1".

mobile.title: Ba clients ya ba mobiles
mobile.subtitle: iOS mpe Android — native UI, protocole moko.
mobile.intro: Ba clients mobiles nionso mibale bazali ba peers pleins, ba enveloppes web mince te. Look native, performance native, ba intégrations native (CallKit, ConnectionService, ba widgets ya Écran ya blocage).
mobile.h1p1: Package ya mbangu na `ios/Modules/`. 30+ modules ya fonctionnalité, moko na moko SOLID-ekabolami `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: Cible ya app na `ios/VortexApp/`. XcodeGen spec na `ios/project.yml` ezongisaka xcodeproj.
mobile.h1p3: Crypto: Kit ya cripto (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id) oyo ezali na kati ya ba sango.
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Ba mutations nionso elekaka na `db.write`.
mobile.h1p6: Push: Ba APN na nzela ya `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Bobakisi ya Service ya Mayebisi mpo na déchiffrement.
mobile.h2p1: Projet ya Gradle na `android/`. 22 modules ya fonctionnalité na Hilt DI, ndenge moko `api / impl / di / ui` split.
mobile.h2p4: DB: Chambre na ba déclencheur FTS4.
mobile.h3p1: Liboke moko ya bisika 146 na bankombo ya mboka (`Русский ru`, `Lingelesi en`, `中文 zh`, ...).
mobile.h3p2: Catalogue moko ya 1500-emoji na 9 catégories + skin-tones + MRU + boluki.
mobile.h3p3: Même multi-comte X25519 défi-réponse pona changement.
mobile.h3p4: Ba dossiers ya chat moko (Nyonso / Archived / personnalisé) na reordering ya kobenda mpe kobwaka.
mobile.h3p5: Liste ya ba saved-GIFs ndenge moko (Tenor te — collection personnelle kaka).
mobile.h3p6: Ba messages programmés ndenge moko UI, écran ya ba contacts, page ya état premium.
mobile.h1_a: Client iOS ezali Swift Package na 30+ modules ya fonctionnalités. Protocole HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC ndenge moko na client nionso mosusu.
mobile.h1_b: Ba modules oyo ebongisami na fonctionnalité: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Files`, `Ba appels`, `Push`, `Emoji`, `Dossiers`, `Comtes`, `SavedGifs`, `Contacts`, `Scheduled`, `Premium`, `Reactions`, .... Moko na moko ekabwani na `api/` (ba protocoles), `impl/` (ba classes ya béton), `ui/` (ba vues ya SwiftUI). Crypto: CryptoKit mpo na X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift mpo na Argon2id. DB: GRDB na FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFmosala ya cadre. Push: Ba APN oyo ezali na Extension ya Service ya Notification mpo na déchiffrement ya poussée scellée.
mobile.h1_c: Ba forfaits modulaires ezali pratique standard ya Swift banda Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). Bokabwani na biso na api/impl/ui ezali SOLID-ish: inversion ya dépendance (ba modules e dépend na api/ kaka), séparation ya ba soucis, testabilité (swap impl pona ba tests). Motango ya module 30+ ezali pona pona parallèlisme ya kotonga — module moko na moko e compiler na isolement.
mobile.h2_a: Ba miroirs ya client Android iOS: Kotlin + Composer + Hilt DI. 22 modules ya fonctionnalité, ndenge moko `api / impl / di` bokabwani.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), cibleSdk 34 (Android 14) oyo ezali na ntina mingi. Crypto: Bobateli ya AndroidX + Tink mpo na AES-GCM; argon2-jvm mpo na Argon2id. DB: Chambre na ba déclencheur FTS4. WebRTC: Koleka WebRTC Android. Push: FCM na nzela ya FirebaseMessagingService + déchiffrement ya enveloppe oyo ekangami. Gradle multi-module, Hilt ezo connecter ba modules ya fonctionnalité sans ba dépendances directes.
mobile.h2_c: Compose ezali Google's declarative UI toolkit, stable depuis 2021. Hilt (2020) ezali cadre Google-endorsed DI likolo ya Dagger 2. Ensemble ba correspondre na ba enveloppes ya propriété SwiftUI + na iOS pona sentiment architectural presque-identique. Vortex azuaki Compose/Hilt kobanda v0.0.4 kobanda; liboso Android ezalaki View-based.
mobile.h3_a: Ezala iOS mpe Android esangisi ensemble moko ya 146-locale JSON ensemble na ba kombo ya mboka mpe 1500-emoji catalogue — mosaleli moko akomi 🥹 na iOS 17 renders 🥹 na Android 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modules/Sources/I18N/Resources/locales/*.json` ezali na talatala ya `android/app/src/main/assets/locales/*.json`. Ba apps nionso mibale ezo charger locale ya malamu na lancement ya liboso (écran ya picker ya langue) pe ezo persister pona. Catalogue ya emoji ezali JSON ya 9 catégories oyo etindami na ba faisceaux nionso mibale; yango elongolaka divergence ya emoji-set ya niveau OS oyo soki te esalaka ba glyphes `?` oyo ezongisami te na ba OS ya kala.
mobile.h3_c: Kotinda catalogue ya emoji na yo moko ezali modèle oyo Telegram asalelaka ( fourchette na bango ya Twemoji) mpe WhatsApp oyo basalelaka tii na 2022. Trade-off: ~300 KB extra par faisceau ya app mpo na emoji + ~1.2 MB mpo na ba locales. Valeur na yango pona consistance cross-plateforme.
