webclient.title: Client ya web
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanille JS, mode hors ligne, mosali ya service.
webclient.intro: Client web azali vanille-JS PWA. React te, bundler te koleka ESM. ~400 KB gzipped total, kati na yango 146 locales.
webclient.h1p1: `static/js/main.js` ezali bokoti. Ba modules ya fonctionnalité paresseux-charge na usage ya liboso.
webclient.h1p2: Etat: ba tampons ya ring ya chambre moko na IndexedDB, cache déchiffré na kati ya mémoire. Mosali ya Service azali médiateur ya fetch.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Ba effets ya Verre liquide na nzela ya CSS backdrop-filter. Cadre moko te; événement délégation + idempotent kopesa basalisi.
webclient.h2p1: Kokoma nionso oyo esalemi tango ezali na ligne hors ligne na IndexedDB. SW ezo flush tango connexion ezongi.
webclient.h2p2: Clé ya idempotency na POST nionso e permettre ba retries doubles elonga sans danger.
webclient.h2p3: Botangi esalaka mobimba libanda ya internet — makomi nyonso ya chiffre oyo esalemi na synchronisation efandaka na IndexedDB.
webclient.h3p1: 146 ba locales na `static/locales/*.json`. Écran ya boyambi (`lang-picker.js`) ezo cycler na ba conseils ya kombo ya mboka.
webclient.h3p2: Bobongoli ya esika ya tango ya kosala: `document.documentElement.lang = code` + kozongisa ba étiquettes na nzela ya ba attributs `data-i18n`.
webclient.h1_a: Client web azali vanille-JS PWA. Te React, pas ya kotonga etape oyo eleki ESM bundling. Total JS envoyé: ~400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: `templates/base.html` ezali shell oyo esalemi na Jinja2. `static/js/main.js` ezali bokoti ya ES-module. Ba modules ya fonctionnalité na `static/js/<feature>/` lazy-load na usage ya liboso. CSS na `static/css/` na boyokani ya 1-fichier-na-composant. Mosali ya Service azali kosimba cache; charge ya liboso ewutaka na réseau, oyo elandi ewutaka na cache; mise à jour ba vérifications na navigation.
webclient.h1_c: Kotikala libanda ya ba cadres ezalaki décision v0.0.1 délibérée sima ya benchmarking React na Vue PWAs na ~1.5 MB gzipped na ba fonctionnalités ya ndenge moko. Ba modules ya vanille JS + ES epesaka biso ~400 KB. Trade-off ezali mingi DOM-manipulation boilerplate, oyo to mitiger na ba petits aides na `static/js/lib/dom.js`.
webclient.h2_a: Mode hors ligne: sortie akomaka molongo na IndexedDB; Service Worker azali ko flusher tango connexion ezongi.
webclient.h2_b: POST / PATCH nionso oyo mosaleli asali hors ligne ezuaka clé ya idempotency pe ekiti na `outbox` (IndexedDB). Mosali ya Service ayokaka likambo ya `en ligne` mpe azongeli poste na fungola ya idempotency lokola motó. Serveur eyebaka ba doublons na nzela ya clé idempotency mpe ezongisaka réponse originale. Botangi esalaka mobimba hors ligne — chiphertext nionso synchronisé efandaka na IndexedDB mpe e déchiffrer localement na ba touches ya mémoire.
webclient.h2_c: Ba clés ya idempotency pona ba POSTs oyo ekoki komekama lisusu ezali convention ya Stripe ya 2017, oyo ezuami na ba API mingi ya mikolo oyo. IndexedDB lokola boîte de sortie ezali modèle Google Drive web esalela pona ba éditions hors ligne. Misala ya Vortex ezali ~200 lignes na `static/js/lib/outbox.js`.
webclient.h3_a: 146-liboke ya nkota na `static/locales/*.json`. Ba cycles ya écran ya boyambi na nzela ya ba conseils ya kombo ya mboka (`Выберите язык` / `Pona monoko na yo` / `选择语言` / ...).
webclient.h3_b: Lancement ya liboso: `lang-picker.js` elakisaka conseil animation na machine à type oyo ebalukaka na ba locales 97 na 45 ms/char, ezo pause 1,8 s, ezo supprimer na 30 ms/char, ezo avancé. Mosaleli aponaka monɔkɔ moko; ewumeli na `localStorage.vortex_lang`. Kokende mbangu nyonso oyo elandi etangaka kopona oyo ebombami. Commutateur ya tango ya kosala: `setLang(code)` ezo charger JSON, ezo rendre lisusu ba éléments `data-i18n`.
webclient.h3_c: Motindo ya masini ya kokoma-hint ezali lokumu na ba écrans ya kala ya kosopana ya terminal mpe ezwamaki mpo na molunge ya UX nsima ya v0.0.6 beta elakisaki basaleli ba ignoraki déroulant statique. Ba conseils ya cyclisme epesaka fenêtre ya 1 seconde pona usager nionso amona kombo ya monoko na ye pe ayeba yango mbala moko.
webclient.h1_f:
shell: modèles/base.html (Jinja2 oyo esalemi na serveur)
bokoti: statique/js/main.js (module ES)
makambo: static/js/{chat,bashambre,auth,appel,fichiers,bots}/...
SW: statique/mosali-mosala.js
taille: ~400 KB gzipped mobimba
webclient.h2_f:
flux ya kokoma hors ligne:
  1. kosala calcul ya idempotency_key = rand (16).hex
  2. db.outbox.put ({url, lolenge, nzoto, fungola_ya idempotency, ts})
  3. na 'en ligne': boîte de sortie ya kosukola
     mpo na molongo moko na moko: fetch(url, {méthode, nzoto, mitó: {"Idempotency-Key": ikey}})
       → 2xx: kolongola molongo
       → 4xx: molongo ya kokita (echec ya libela) .
       → 5xx/offline: meka lisusu sima
webclient.h3_f:
lang-moponi.js:
  hints = ["Выберите язык", "Pona monoko na yo", "Elige tu idioma", ...]
  type hint na 45 ms/char → pause 1,8 s → supprimer na 30 ms/char → pause 0,2 s → sima

switch ya tango ya kosala:
  Bobombi ya esika.vortex_lang = code
  fetch('locales/' + code + '.json') → kosalela na ba éléments ya data-i18n

security.title: Posture ya sécurité
security.subtitle: Modèle ya menace, défense-en-profondeur, WAF, nzela ya audit, canaire.
security.intro: Vortex esalelaka défense-en-profondeur : kobuka couche moko ekoki te, attaquant réaliste asengeli na ba victoires indépendantes ebele.
security.h1p1: **Motali ya réseau passif**: amoni ba paquets TLS; asalaka analyse ya taille/timing. Balongi na stealth ya Niveau 1.
security.h1p2: **Attaquant ya réseau actif**: akoki kobwaka/kozongisa sima/ko injecter. Balongi na moyibi ya Niveau 2-4.
security.h1p3: **Opérateur ya noeud oyo azali na likama**: emoni texte chiffre + métadonnées. Makambo oyo ezali na nsango etikali sekele.
security.h1p4: **Apareyi ya client oyo bayibaki**: texte ya pamba ya ba messages ya kala oyo emonisami. Double Ratchet limites na session ya lelo; wipe-on-next-unlock ezali.
security.h1p5: **Anguna quantique na trafic ya kala oyo ebombami**: alongi na ba clés ya session hybride Kyber-768 tango baninga nionso mibale basalaki piblisite PQ.
security.h2p1: Inspecteur ya senga: ba modèles ya SQLi, traversal ya nzela, injection ya modèle, LFI, NoSQLi. Ekiti liboso ya code ya app.
security.h2p2: Limite ya taux: mondial 1000 req/s casquette doux na explosion; na nzela moko (kokɔta 10/min, kokomisa nkombo 5/min); na mosaleli moko 100 req/s sima ya auth.
security.h3p1: Makambo oyo etali bokengi (action ya administrateur, mbongwana ya fédération, mise à niveau ya sortie, effacer panique) hash-chained via `app/security/canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Bokabwani ya monyololo ⇒ bobongwani ezwami. Alerte ba moto.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit` emonisaka journal (auth ya admin kaka). Append-bobele.
security.h4p1: Dossier Canary signé mokolo na mokolo na clé ya liberation. Absence ⇒ compromis oyo ba suspecter.
security.h4p2: Bolongoli ya mbalakaka: administrateur a diffuser `{type:"n", événement:"comprome", ...}` na WebSocket nionso. Ba clients ba effacer ba clés cache.
security.h4p3: Rotation: clé ya sortie ya sika, manifeste ya ko signer lisusu, kobimisa lisusu. Ba clients ba re-bootstrap bazo sala lisusu.
security.h1_a: Ba classes minei ya ba ennemis ezo diriger conception : observateur passif, attaquant actif, opérateur comprometté, dispositif compromise. Moko na moko alongi na couche ekeseni.
security.h1_b: Observateur passif : amonaka ba paquets chiffrés TLS, asalaka analyse ya trafic. Balongi na moyibi ya Niveau 1-2. Attaquant actif: akoki kobwaka/retarder/injecter ba paquets. Balongi na moyibi ya Niveau 3-4. Opérateur oyo azali na likama: emoni texte chiffre + métadonnées. Elongi na E2E crypto + métadonnées minimisation. Dispositif compromise: emonaka texte plain ya ba messages ya kala. Ba dégâts limité na sekele ya liboso (Double Ratchet) na effacement ya panique.
security.h1_c: Modèle ya classe minei euti na taxonomie ya modèle ya menace ya Schneier ya 1999 "Applied Cryptography", oyo epanzani na ba observations post-Snowden na oyo etali ba observateurs ya niveau ya l’Etat. Motindo nyonso ya mikolo oyo ya motindami ya libateli etángi likambo ya ndenge wana. Torsion ya Vortex ezali kobakisa classe ya mitano mpo na feuille de route v0.4: adversaire quantique-enabled na trafic ya kala oyo ebombami, oyo Kyber esimbaka.
security.h2_a: WAF etalaka demande nionso avant ekoma na code ya app, eboyaka SQL-i, traversal ya nzela, injection ya modèle, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` esalaka ~50 ba vérifications ya regex contre URL, requête, na nzoto. Ba modèles oyo eyebani-malicieux (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Ba limite ya taux: cap doux ya 1000 req/s ya mokili mobimba na tolerance ya explosion; na nzela moko `/kokɔta` 10/min, `/komisa nkombo` 5/min; na mosaleli moko 100 req/s sima ya auth. Géo-bloquage optionnel via `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` mpo na kokokisa masengi ya etumbu mpo na ba opérateurs oyo bazali kotosa mibeko.
security.h2_c: Ba WAF lokola middleware ezali modèle oyo etiamaki — mod_security (2002), Cloudflare's WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex's eza intentionnellement minimal po WAF ya kilo e créer ba faux positifs oyo ezo zindi ba vrais menaces. Liste ya regex esalemaki na ba signature OWASP Top 10 mpe e refiné na v0.0.5 sima ya règle beta WAF ekangaki chaîne literal "DROP TABLE" na kati ya message ya chat etali SQL.
security.h3_a: Ba événements oyo etali sécurité ekiti na journal ya audit oyo ezali na chaîne hash. Kobukana na monyololo elakisi ete bazali kobongola makambo.
security.h3_b: Action nionso ya admin, changement ya fédération, mise à niveau ya sortie, to effacer panique ekotisami na `audit_log(ts, événement, actor_id, target_id, detail_cbor)`. Molongo moko na moko ememaka `prev_hash = hash(molongo_ya liboso)`. Hash ya molongo ya lelo e calculer likolo ya `ts ∥ événement ∥ prev_hash`. Soki molongo moko elongolami to ebongwani, monyololo ya milɔngɔ oyo elandi' `prev_hash` ebukani — ekoki komonana na kozongela monyololo.
security.h3_c: Ba journal ya audit oyo ezali na chaîne hash ezali primitif ya kala (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Linux auditd esalelaka bango. Git ya commit DAG ezali essentiellement structure moko. Vortex abakisaki yango na v0.0.6 sima ya conseiller moko kolakisa que noeud oyo ezali na compromis ekoki ko effacer na kimia ba lignes ya journal.
security.h4_a: Réponse ya incident ezali pré-planifié : canary prouvé que fungola ya liberation ezali sans compromis; revocation ya urgence epangusa ba clés cachés na ba clients nionso.
security.h4_b: Mokolo na mokolo `canary.txt` oyo etiamaki maboko na fungola ya kobimisa, ebimisami pembeni ya contrôleur. Ba clients ba vérifier optionnellement na démarrage — absence ⇒ compromis suspect. Soki boyokani endimami: admin azali ko diffuser `{type:"n", événement:"compromise", raison}` likolo ya WebSocket nionso. Ba clients ba effacer ba clés cachés, ba forcer re-login. Fungola ya kobimisa ya sika minted, manifeste e signer lisusu, ba clients ba re-bootstrap depuis point final ya intégrité mirroré. Texte chiffre ya kala oyo ekómi ete moto akoki kotángama te na ndenge oyo basali yango.
security.h4_c: Ba fichiers ya Canary ezo tracer na Apple ya 2013 warrant canary na projet `canarywatch.org`. Signal esalelaka bango. Vortex's ezali automatique : cron moko e signer `canary.txt` na touche ya liberation chaque 24 h. Ba émissions ya revocation ya urgence ezali modèle moko oyo Let's Encrypt esalela pona revocation ya certificat en masse.
security.h2_f:
azali kosala vérification na demande nionso:
  SQL injection : koyeba UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE, ; -- etc.
  nzela ya koleka : ko détecter ../, ..%2f, URL-ba variantes codées
  injection ya modèle : ko détecter {{, {% .
  XSS : koyeba <script, javascript:
  NoSQLi : koyeba $ne, $esika, $regex
ndelo ya taux: 1000/s mondial, 10/min ya kokota, 5/min ya registre
security.h3_f:
molongo: {ts, likambo, id_ya_acteur, id_ya_cible, cbor_ya_détail, hash_ya liboso, hash_ya_molongo}
hash_ya_molongo = SHA-256(ts ∥ likambo ∥ id_ya_acteur ∥ ... ∥ hash_ya liboso)
vérifier: kotambola journal, kozongela calcul ya row_hash moko na moko, kokokanisa na valeur oyo ebombami
kobuka ⇒ tampering oyo emonanaki na molongo wana

privacy.title: Bomoi ya moto ye moko mpe kotosa mibeko
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, droit ya effacer, minimisation ya ba métadonnées, portabilité ya ba données.
privacy.intro: Vortex etindi GDPR na CCPA bisaleli libanda ya sanduku. Ba opérateurs na ba jurisdictions réglementées bazali na point final ya administrateur moko pona demande nionso ya statutaire.
privacy.h1p1: IP ekɔtaka te na ndenge ya libela. Ba bandes proxy inverse `X-Real-IP` longola se soki opérateur a opter.
privacy.h1p2: `sender_pseudo` na milɔngɔ ya ba messages e hashes ba ID ya motindi ya solo — dump DB emonisaka kaka ba pseudonymes ya chambre moko.
privacy.h1p3: Boluki esalelaka ba encrypted-tokens. Client azali ko chiffrer ba mots clés na clé ya chambre; node ebombaka ba jetons opaques; lookup ezali exact-match na ba jetons ya texte chiffre.
privacy.h1p4: Last-seen truncated na granularité oyo mosaleli aponaki.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/privacy/erase` e ​​anonymiser molongo ya mosaleli, elongolaka ba messages na bango oyo batindi (métadonnées oyo ebombami pona quorum), elongolaka ba fichiers na disque.
privacy.h2p2: Fédération: maloba mabe oyo etiamaki sinyatili eyebisaka baninga; ba effacer na côté na bango na kati ya 72 h.
privacy.h2p3: Audit: effacement e enregistrer na timestamp na (hashed) id ya usager po opérateur a prouver compliance.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/privacy/export` ezo flux zip: profil JSON, texte chiffre oyo etindami/ezwami, ba références ya fichier na ba touches ya misisa ya fichier moko, liste ya contact.
privacy.h3p2: Tango ya bokeli: ~5 min mpo na ba messages ya 10 k, oyo ekangami na IO.
privacy.h3p3: Moyambi asengeli ko déchiffrer texte chiffre na esika na ye; export tooling etindamaka pembeni.
privacy.h4p1: Logo ya kofina molai 5 s → efface locale mbala moko: ba touches, ba messages cachés, ba pièces jointes.
privacy.h4p2: Effacement couplé: `/api/privacy/panic` pe ezo tombstones compte côté serveur.
privacy.h1_a: IP ekɔtaka te na ndenge ya libela. Ba métadonnées oyo ekoki ko identifier mosaleli te na ba lignes ya message. Boluki ya makomi mobimba likolo ya ba jetons chiffrés.
privacy.h1_b: Proxy inverse elongolaka `X-Real-IP` liboso ete node emona yango longola se soki opérateur a opter pona ko limiter taux. Milɔngɔ́ ya nsango ebombaka `motindi_id` (mpo na ACL) mpe `motindi_pseudo` (mpo na fan-out); sender_pseudo ezali HMAC(mungwa_ya_chambre, id_ya_motindi) yango wana dump ya DB emonisaka te nani alobaki nini na ngambo mosusu ya ba chambre. Boluki: client azali ko chiffrer ba mots clés na clé ya chambre; node ebombaka ba jetons opaques; lookup ezali exact-match na ba jetons ya texte chiffre, index ya texte ya pamba te.
privacy.h1_c: Minimisation ya métadonnées ezali consensus post-Snowden — Signal e popularisaki yango na 2014, WhatsApp elandaki na sender-pseudo na 2019. Boluki chiffré likolo ya ba jetons ya texte chiffre ezali modèle ya CryptDB (2011) mpe ShadowCrypt (2014). Vortex ya mise en œuvre ezali version stripped-down oyo eteka mua flexibilité ya requête pona simplicité.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/privacy/erase` e ​​anonymiser molongo ya mosaleli, epangusa chiphertext na bango oyo batindi, elongolaka ba fichiers, mpe eyebisaka baninga ya fédération.
privacy.h2_b: Côté serveur: `ba usagers` molongo ya ba champs sensibles zéro (`kombo ya mosaleli = "elongolami-<id>"`, `telefone = null`, `email = null`, `kombo_ya_elakiseli = "[elongolami]"`); `messages.ciphertext` set NULL mpo na milɔngɔ nyonso esika `motindi_id = u.id`; ba fichiers oyo ekangami na ba messages wana oyo elongolami na disque. Baninga oyo ba fédérés bazwaka maloba ya mabe oyo etiamaki maboko na `{event: "erasure", user_id, signed_by}`; basalaka purge moko na ngambo na bango na kati ya 72 h (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: Droit ya effacer ezali GDPR esengelami ya article 17 banda 2018. CCPA elandaki na 2020; LGPD (Brésil) na 2021. Vortex etindi ba primitifs libanda ya boîte po ba opérateurs na ba jurisdictions réglementées basengeli te kotonga yango. Fédération SLA ya 72 h ekokani na fenêtre ya réponse ya mikolo 30 ya GDPR na esika ya mutu pona propagation.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/privacy/export` ezo flux zip: profil JSON, texte chiffre oyo etindami/ezwami, ba références ya fichier na ba touches ya misisa ya fichier moko, liste ya contact.
privacy.h3_b: Generation eza async po ba comptes minene ezo zua ba minutes. Ba POSTs ya client demande → node enqueues mosala → mosala ezo tambola na fond → ba sondages ya client `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 na signé URL tango prêt. Makambo ya zip: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (moko na shambre moko), `messages.jsonl.enc` (texte chiffre + bafungola ya misisa ya fisyé moko), `fichiers/` (blobs téléchargé-comme-ezali).
privacy.h3_c: Portabilité ya ba données ezali exigences ya mapasa na effacement na GDPR. Apple, Google, Telegram, Signal nionso ezali na bisaleli ya kozua. Vortex's ebakisi matériel ya clé (file_root par fichier) po basaleli bakoka ko déchiffrer exportation localement — soki te exportation ezali na tina te. Sans détail oyo ba Apple / Google takeouts ezali efficacement plaintext-seul po ba déchiffré déjà.
privacy.h4_a: Panic wipe: long-press logo Vortex pendant 5 secondes pona kobebisa mbala moko ba touches nionso na ba données cachées na appareil. Ekoki kobongwana te.
privacy.h4_b: Côté client : na 5-secondes long-press, lakisa confirmation; na confirmer, benga `wipeKeychainItems ()` / `effacer Keystore ()` / `LocalStorage.effacer () + indexéDB.ba bases de données (). mpo naChaque(effacerDatabase)`. Texte chiffre cache esili, ba clés esili, ba JWT esili. Effacement couplé optionnel: `POST /api/privacy/panic` pe ezo tombstones côté serveur ya compte pe ezo fédéré bilobaloba ya effacement.
privacy.h4_c: Ba boutons ya panique / ba commutateurs ya mutu akufi ezali na histoire ya kala na messagerie sécurisée : "Shred" ya Wickr ya 2014, "Forget" ya Cryptocat ya 2013, proposition ya "Effaration sécurisée" ya Signal (2016, jamais envoyé). Vortex's 5-second long-press is deliberately hard to trigger accidentally — toyekolaki ba réactions haptiques na iPhone 15 mpe Pixel 8 mpe toponaki 5 s lokola esika ya sukali kati na "rapide assez na urgence" mpe "ekoki ko tirer te na pocket-button".
privacy.h1_f:

debugging.title: Débogage na diagnostic
debugging.subtitle: Bisaleli mpo na kolandela makambo na dev, staging, mpe prod.
debugging.intro: Sous-système nionso ezali na logging structuré mpe surface ya /metrics. Tala buku ya lisano ya diagnostic ya momesano.
debugging.h1p1: JSON-ebongisami na ndenge ya libela. `logger.info("mosala", extra={"id_ya_mosaleli": ...})` ebimisaka `{"ts":..., "lvl":"INFO", "msg":"mosala", "id_mosaleli": ...}`.
debugging.h1p2: Bambolá na 100 MB; bomba 14 gens na gzipped.
debugging.h1p3: Niveau na module moko na nzela ya `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG` (e.g. `LOG_LEVEL_TRANSPORT=DEBUG`).
debugging.h1p4: Id ya corrélation: bosengi nionso ezuaka `X-Request-Id`; ba RPC ya se basalelaka yango lisusu.
debugging.h2p1: Format ya Prometheus na `/metrics` (ezali authentiqué na admin na prod).
debugging.h2p2: RED: taux / mabunga / ntango molai na nzela moko.
debugging.h2p3: USE: bosaleli / saturation / mabunga na DB piscine, WebSocket fan-out, TURN relais.
debugging.h2p4: Personnalisé: ba chambres actives, ba messages/s, histogramme ya niveau ya kobombana.
debugging.h3p1: `py-spy` mpo na échantillonnage ya tango ya kosala. Bokanga na node oyo ezali kotambola PID.
debugging.h3p2: `memray` mpo na profilage ya tas. Instantané ya 1 minute emonisaka ba fuites noki.
debugging.h3p3: Rust extension `vortex_chat` e exporter `--profile` drapeau oyo ekomaka trace oyo ekokani na flamegraph.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` etambolisaka enregistrement/kokɔta/tinda/kozwa/kobima na node ya esika. Ebimaka non zéro na échec nionso.
debugging.h4p2: CI ezo kima milinga na PR nionso lokola pe na ba fusions na main.
debugging.h4p3: Milinga ya production : sonde ya libanda ezo beta compte canaire mbala moko na minute.
debugging.h1_a: Ba journals ezali JSON-structurés na ndenge ya défaut. Line nionso ya journal ezali na ts, niveau, module, message, na id ya corrélation.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info("mosaleli_asali", extra={"id_ya_mosaleli": u.id})` ebimisaka `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "msg":"mosaleli_asali", "id_mosaleli": 42, "req_id": "..."}`. Id ya corrélation euti na motó ya `X-Request-Id`; RPC nyonso oyo ezali na nse ya mai esalelaka yango lisusu. Bobaluki na 100 MB; bomba 14 génération gzipped. Niveau par-module na nzela ya `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG`.
debugging.h1_c: Structured JSON logging ezali consensus ya lelo — adopté na Stripe, Datadog, motekisi nionso ya observabilité ya mikolo oyo. Ba ID ya corrélation ezo tracer na X-Request-Id (RFC 4557) pe ekomaki canonique na ba microservices via Jaeger / Zipkin (2015). Vortex esalela id ya corrélation simple propagée par tête au lieu ya ba traces distribuées po outilisation ya trace distribuée ebakisi complexité oyo tozali nanu besoin na yango te.
debugging.h2_a: Ba metrics ya Prométhéus na `/metrics` (authentiqué na admin na production). Ba tableaux de bord ya Grafana etindami na `deploy/grafana/`.
debugging.h2_b: RED ba métriques par-route: taux ya demande, taux ya erreur, histogramme ya durée. USE ba métriques par ressource : DB bosaleli ya piscine, WebSocket saturation ya ventilateur, TURN bande passante ya relais. Personnalisé: ba salles actives, ba messages par seconde, histogramme ya niveau ya kobombana. Tableau de bord ya administrateur na `/admin/metrics` elakisaka ba tableaux ya likolo; Prométheus azali kokatakata mpo na histoire mobimba.
debugging.h2_c: RED (taux / erreurs / durée) ezali sigle ya Weaveworks ya 2016. USE (utilisation / saturation / erreurs) ezali méthodologie ya Brendan Gregg na 2013. Ensemble ba couvrir ba signaux ya niveau ya service na niveau ya ressource. Prometheus + Grafana ezali default ya source ouverte banda 2016.
debugging.h3_a: `py-spy` mpo na échantillonnage ya tango ya kosala; `memray` mpo na bilili ya liboke; `vortex_chat` Rust bobakisi ezali na `--profile` mpo na ba traces ya flamegraph.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` mpo na 60 s ebimisaka flamegraphe SVG oyo ezali kolakisa ba piles ya moto Python. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` elandaka ba allocations; `memray flamegraph mem.bin` ezali kosala. Rust extension e exporter ba profils internes lokola Chrome-tracing JSON tango ebengami na `--profile`. Bosangisi moko ya oyo na load-test oyo ezali koleka na nzela ya `scripts/smoke/all.sh` mpo na ba shapes oyo ekokani.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) ezali profilateur statistique non intrusif oyo ekangamaka na processus Python oyo ezali kosala sans changement ya code — Go ya ba profileurs Python. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) ezali profilur ya tas Python ya malamu koleka lelo. Rust écosystème ya profilage ya Rust ye moko ezali mature kasi moins intégré; extension na biso e exporter Chrome-tracing spécifiquement mpo navigateur nionso ezalaka na viewer oyo etongami na kati.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` ba exercices ya kokomisa/kokota/kotinda/kozwa/kobima na node ya esika. CI atambolisaka yango na PR nionso.
debugging.h4_b: Milinga ezo tambola na ~5 secondes. Asalaka ba comptes mibale ya sika, afungoli DM, atinda message, a vérifier livraison, abimisi nionso mibale. Ebimaka non zéro na échec nionso. CI ebengaka yango post-build. Canary ya milinga ya prod ekeseni etambolaka miniti nyonso uta na sonde ya libanda contre compte ya test dédié na noeud ya production.
debugging.h4_c: Ba tests ya milinga ezali métaphore ya usine ya Toyota (1950s) — sala vérification ya mbangu pona ko confirmer système ezali évidemment kobukana te. Na logiciel bakomaki standard sima ya "Working Effectively with Legacy Code" (2004) ya Michael Feathers. Script ya milinga ya Vortex ezali ~200 lignes ya bash + curl.

testing.title: Stratégie ya komeka
testing.subtitle: 29 k lignes ya ba tests na kati ya Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Couche nionso ezalaka na suite ya test na yango. CI akimaka bango nionso na moins de 10 minutes.
testing.h1p1: `pytest app/tests` etali ba routeurs, bokengi, transport, ba bots.
testing.h1p2: Hypothèse ba tests basées na propriété na crypto : `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` pona 1000 m aléatoire.
testing.h1p3: AFL-style fuzz na WAF: ba millions ya ba entrées malformées — affirmer pas de fuites 5xx.
testing.h2p1: `test ya mbangu` na `ios/Modules/` esalaka ba tests unitaires contre ba vecteurs ya test RFC 7748 / 8032 / 5869 / 8446.
testing.h2p2: XCUI ba tests ezo diriger ba vues ya SwiftUI na simulateur sans mutu; snapshot-kokanisami.
testing.h3p1: `./gradlew test` ezo tambola JVM-kaka ba tests (noki).
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew connectedCheck` esalaka ba tests instrumentés na émulateur oyo ezali kosala.
testing.h4p1: Playwright azali ko diriger client web, Chrome sans mutu + Firefox sans mutu. Ba appels esalemaka na `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream`.
testing.h4p2: Ba scénarios : enregistrer ba comptes mibale → DM → tinda fichier → supprimer → vérifier synchronisation → suka.
testing.h1_a: Python ba tests esalela pytest + couverture. Routeur nionso, primitif nionso ya sécurité, module nionso ya transport ezalaka na ba tests. ~80 % ya couverture.
testing.h1_b: `pytest app/tests` ezo tambuisa suite mobimba na moins de 2 minutes na noyau moko. Ba tests basées na propriété ya hypothèse na ba primitifs crypto : `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` pona 1000 messages aléatoires. AFL-style fuzz tests na WAF: ba millions ya ba entrées malformées assertée que ebimisaka réponse ya 4xx (5xx te). `pytest --cov=app` mpo na bozipi.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) azali mopoti mbangu ya momekano ya solo Python. Hypothèse (2015) pona test basé na propriété e portaki idée ya QuickCheck ewutaki na Haskell. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) mpo na fuzz ezali fuzzer oyo etambwisami na bozipi ya canon. Vortex's stack ezali ya monene; elengi se moko ezali préférence na biso ya parametrisation ya pytest sur héritage ya classe ya test.
testing.h2_a: Ba tests ya Swift na `ios/Modules/` ezo couvrir ba primitifs ya crypto contre ba vecteurs ya test RFC plus ba tests ya instantané ya SwiftUI.
testing.h2_b: `swift test` uta na `ios/Modules/` esalaka ba tests unitaires na se ya 1 s. RFC 7748 (X25519) ba vecteurs. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) ba vecteurs. RFC 5869 (HKDF) ba vecteurs. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) biloko ya kokangama. SwiftUI aperçu ba snapshots ekokanisi na nzela ya image diff contre git-tracked baseline; régression na pixel nionso elongi te kotonga.
testing.h2_c: Komeka crypto contre ba vecteurs ya test officiel ezali pratique oyo ekoki koleka masasi — soki code na yo eyokani na ba vecteurs RFC, ezali conformant na définition. Test ya snapshot mpo na SwiftUI ezali ~2022 état ya art, popularisé na pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing. Vortex esalela version minimal in-house pona ko éviter dépendance.
testing.h3_a: Ba tests ya Kotlin: JVM-kaka na nzela ya `./gradlew test`; instrumented via `./gradlew connectedCheck` na émulateur oyo ezali kosala.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` esalemaka na mwa ba secondes — cadre Android moko te esengeli, kaka JUnit + Hilt-android-testing. Ba cibles ya test unitaire : crypto, ba présentateurs, ba flux basés na coroutine. `./gradlew connectedCheck` ezo tourner émulateur moko, ezo installer app, ezo sala ba tests UI na nzela ya Espresso. E2E esopanaka: kota → tinda message → tala na chat.
testing.h3_c: Kokabola ba tests JVM-seul na ba tests instrumentés ezali convention ya Android 2019+. JVM ba tests ezalaka mbangu (ba secondes); ba tests instrumentés ezalaka malembe (miniti). Robolectric (2014) ezalaki kosala pont ya écart kasi e remplacé mingi mingi na bokabwani oyo na développement moderne Android.
testing.h4_a: Playwright azali ko diriger client web na Chrome sans tête na Firefox, kosala exercice ya registre ya solo → DM → ba flux ya ba appels.
testing.h4_b: `playwright-tests/` esimbaka ba scénarios na TypeScript. Node moko ya kobwaka + Postgres ebalukaka na session ya test moko na nzela ya docker compose. Ba tests ezo diriger web UI : enregistrer ba comptes mibale, kofungola DM, kotinda message, ko vérifier livraison, kosala appel vidéo na ba drapeaux `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` + `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` po Chrome e produire audio/vidéo synthétique. Ba scénarios ezo tambola en parallèle via ba travailleurs ya Playwright.
testing.h4_c: Mokomi ya masano (Microsoft, 2020) azwaki esika ya Selenium mpo na komeka mingi ya web E2E mpo ezali mbangu, ya kotyela motema, mpe ezali na débogage ya malamu koleka. WebRTC komeka na ba navigateurs sans tête ezalaki point ya pasi tii tango Chrome 69 ebakisaki ba drapeaux ya fake-appareil; banda wana ekomi pratique standard.

apiSurface.title: API likolo ya likolo
apiSurface.subtitle: Point final nionso ya HTTP node e exposer, groupé par zone.
apiSurface.intro: Oyo ezali liste autoritaire ya ba routes publics. Carte ya point final moko na moko epanzani pona kolakisa tina, auth tier, ba schémas ya demande / réponse, tableau ya erreur, pe exemple ya curl. Banzela ya bopeto ya ndako ya kati na se ya `/internal/*` elongolami na politiki.

auth.title: Bondimi ya bondimi
auth.subtitle: Kokomisa nkombo, kota, kozongisa sika, kozongisa — mpe banzela ya bozongisi.
auth.intro: Ba routes nionso na se ya `/api/authentication/*`. JWT oyo ebimi na login ya malonga ememaka `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: accès|refresh}` signé HS256 likolo ya secret ya node. Accès ewumeli 15 min, refresh mikolo 30.

register.title: POST /api/bondimi/komisa nkombo
register.subtitle: Bosala mosaleli ya sika na identité X25519 + mot de passe Argon2id.
register.h1_a: Esali compte ya sika ya mosaleli mpe ebimisaka paire JWT ya ebandeli. Ekangaka fungola ya bato nyonso X25519 ya mosaleli oyo eumelaka mingi na kɔnti banda na kobenga ya liboso mpenza.
register.h1_b: Node e validaka ba champs nionso na nzela ya Pydantic, e vérifier kombo ya mosaleli na x25519_public_key uniqueness, e tambuisaka Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) na mot de passe, ekotisaka na `ba usagers`, `user_devices`, `push_abonnements`, accès ya mints + refresh JWTs.
register.h1_c: Etindami na v0.0.1 lokola esika ya suka ya liboso. Paramètre X25519 pubkey ebakisami na v0.0.2 sima ya ko réaliser identité na compte esengeli esalama atomiquement — soki te serveur akokaki MITM usager entre registre na upload ya liboso ya clé.
register.h2_a: Esengaka: **ezali moko te**. Middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` e porte nzela oyo mpe eboyi na `401 unauthenticated` soki credentiel oyo esengeli ezali te to ezali na ntina te.
register.h2_b:
- `moko te` — oyo endimami te (yambo ya kokota).
- `jwt` — Momemi JWT elembo ya bokɔti na motó ya `Ndingisa`.
- `kozongisa sika` — Momemi JWT elembo ya kozongisa sika.
- `admin` — JWT oyo ba réclamations na ye ezali na `is_admin: vrai`.
- `peer-signed` — nzoto ya bosengi oyo etiamaki maboko na fungola ya Ed25519 ya moninga oyo batyelaka motema.
register.h2_c: Auth tier elakisaka principe ya moins de privilège : ba points d’arrêt avant login ezali strictement limité na création mpe récupération ya compte; nionso oyo ezali sima ya JWT emonaka mosaleli ya solo; ba points d'arrêt ya admin elakisaka badge na UI donc usage ya mabe eza observable.
register.h3_a: JSON nzoto na kombo ya mosaleli oyo esengeli + mot de passe + x25519_fungola_ya bato banso; téléphone optionnel (E.164), email (RFC 5322 lite), kombo_ya_affichage, emoji_ya avatar, code_ya_kobengisa, clé_ya_kyber_public.

  "email": "a@example.com", // ya bolingi
  "avatar_emoji": "🦊", // ya kopona, 1 emoji
  "invite_code": "...", // optionnel soki mode INVITE
  "kyber_public_key": "<1184 hex>" // ya bolingi, mpo na PQ
} .

login.title: POST /api/bondimi/kokɔta
login.subtitle: Verifier kombo ya mosaleli + mot de passe, zongisa JWT paire.
login.h1_a: Echanger ba credentiels pona paire JWT. Mot ya nzela e vérifié contre hash Argon2id na `users.password_hash`. Timing ezali constant-time ata mpo na ba kombo ya basaleli oyo eyebani te mpo na kotelemela enumeration.
login.h1_b: Etali mosaleli na nkombo ya mosaleli na makomi mike, etambolisaka `argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(ebombami, etindami)`. Soki mosaleli azali te, azali ko vérifier contre hash mannequin pré-computé mpo na ko égaliser timing. Elonga → kobimisa JWT + `ba dispositif_ya_mosaleli` molongo.
login.h1_c: Envoyé na registre na v0.0.1. Hashing ya mannequin ya temps constant ebakisami na v0.0.2 sima ya balukiluki kolakisa enumeration ya timing na design ya liboso.
login.h2_a: Esengaka: **ezali moko te**. Middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` e porte nzela oyo mpe eboyi na `401 unauthenticated` soki credentiel oyo esengeli ezali te to ezali na ntina te.
login.h2_b:
- `moko te` — oyo endimami te (yambo ya kokota).
- `jwt` — Momemi JWT elembo ya bokɔti na motó ya `Ndingisa`.
- `kozongisa sika` — Momemi JWT elembo ya kozongisa sika.
- `admin` — JWT oyo ba réclamations na ye ezali na `is_admin: vrai`.
- `peer-signed` — nzoto ya bosengi oyo etiamaki maboko na fungola ya Ed25519 ya moninga oyo batyelaka motema.
login.h2_c: Auth tier elakisaka principe ya moins de privilège : ba points d’arrêt avant login ezali strictement limité na création mpe récupération ya compte; nionso oyo ezali sima ya JWT emonaka mosaleli ya solo; ba points d'arrêt ya admin elakisaka badge na UI donc usage ya mabe eza observable.
login.h5_a: Enveloppe ya erreur standard Vortex `{libunga, ezalela, nzela}`. `401` na ba credentiels ya mabe; `403` na ntina ya libaku malamu oyo ekoki te; `422` na ntina ya bondimi; `429` na ndelo ya taux; `5xx` na libunga ya kati.
login.h5_f:
401 invalid_credentials kombo ya mosaleli to mot ya nzela ya mabe
401 compte_suspended compte ekangami
401 totp_esengeli kopesa totp mpe komeka lisusu
429 rate_limited >10 komeka/min/IP .

curl -X POST 'https://node.exemple/api/bondimi/kokɔta' \

deposit.title: POST /bmp/dépôt ya mbongo
deposit.subtitle: Botia blob moko
deposit.h1_a: Endimi `{id_boîte de poste: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}`. Magasins mpo na kino 7200 s; esakoli mailbox_id na filtre Bloom ya bilobaloba oyo elandi.
deposit.h1_b: Mosali ya nzela oyo afandaka na module oyo ekokani na yango na nse ya `app/`. Motindo ya nzela `/bmp/deposit` esakolami na `@router.post('/bmp/deposit')`.
deposit.h1_c: Etindami na bobimisi ya yambo Vortex lokola eteni ya makoki ya `dépôt`.
deposit.h2_a: Esengaka: **ezali moko te**. Middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` e porte nzela oyo mpe eboyi na `401 unauthenticated` soki credentiel oyo esengeli ezali te to ezali na ntina te.
deposit.h2_b:
- `moko te` — oyo endimami te (yambo ya kokota).
- `jwt` — Momemi JWT elembo ya bokɔti na motó ya `Ndingisa`.
- `kozongisa sika` — Momemi JWT elembo ya kozongisa sika.
- `admin` — JWT oyo ba réclamations na ye ezali na `is_admin: vrai`.
- `peer-signed` — nzoto ya bosengi oyo etiamaki maboko na fungola ya Ed25519 ya moninga oyo batyelaka motema.
deposit.h2_c: Auth tier elakisaka principe ya moins de privilège : ba points d’arrêt avant login ezali strictement limité na création mpe récupération ya compte; nionso oyo ezali sima ya JWT emonaka mosaleli ya solo; ba points d'arrêt ya admin elakisaka badge na UI donc usage ya mabe eza observable.
deposit.h5_a: Enveloppe ya erreur standard Vortex `{libunga, ezalela, nzela}`. `401` na ba credentiels ya mabe; `403` na ntina ya libaku malamu oyo ekoki te; `422` na ntina ya bondimi; `429` na ndelo ya taux; `5xx` na libunga ya kati.
deposit.h5_f:
401 elembo oyo ezangi/ezali na ntina te oyo endimami te
403 epekisami libaku malamu oyo ekoki te
422 bopekisami ya esika ya validation_error ebukami
429 rate_limited ba tentatives ebele
500 internal_error mbeba ya mosaleli oyo ekanisamaki te

roadmap.title: Feuille de route
roadmap.subtitle: Nini ekanamaki mpe ntango nini.
roadmap.intro: Botali ya nivo ya likolo. Ba dates ezali aspirational; makambo ya bokengi epekisaka mosala ya makambo.
roadmap.h1: v0.2 — kobimisama ya mibale na bato nyonso
roadmap.h1p1: Kyber-768 PQ efungolami na ndenge ya libela na ba installations ya sika.
roadmap.h1p2: Ba groupes jusqu'à 50 000 membres na clé Variant-B publish.
roadmap.h1p3: Emballage ya bureau (Tauri) mpo na macOS / Windows / Linux.
roadmap.h1p4: Bot marché efungwami na ba soumissions publiques.
roadmap.h2p1: Groupe oyo ezali kaka na audio ebengi ba participants kino 100 na nzela ya SFU.
roadmap.h2p2: Opus DTX + diffusion simultié + bitrate adaptatif.
roadmap.h2p3: Per-participant mute / kick na appel UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Toile collaborative ya style Miro likolo ya CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) na nzela ya couche ya messagerie.
roadmap.h3p2: Présence ya curseur na tango ya solo.
roadmap.h3p3: Botindiki libanda na PNG / SVG / PDF.
roadmap.h4p1: Escrow en chaîne mpo na kosomba bot (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p2: Part ya revenu ya opérateur, 10 %% ya frais ya plateforme.
roadmap.h4p3: Rampe ya kofungola/kokangama ya Fiat na nzela ya boyokani ya Stripe.
roadmap.h5p1: Likolo stabilisé, audit officiel ya sécurité, ba constructions reproducibles, SemVer congelé.
roadmap.h5p2: Programme ya bounty ya ba insectes en direct.
roadmap.h5p3: Ata botali moko ya bokengi ya lipanda na bokomi ya bato banso.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 — kobimisama ya mibale na bato nyonso. Kyber PQ on par défaut, ba salles publiques ya minene via Variant-B, ba forfaits ya bureau Tauri, marché bot ouvert.
roadmap.h1_b: Kyber-768 ezo défaut na activé pona ba installations ya sika; ba clients sans soutien gracement ba kitisa. Ba chambre jusqu'à 50 000 membres via Variant-B key publish — pas de fanout ya enveloppe ya membre moko na rotation. Bureau (enveloppe ya Tauri 2 autour ya client web) ebimisami pona macOS, Windows, Linux na même faisceau. Zando ya Bot efungwami na ba soumissions publiques na revue ya mikolo 3 ya mosala SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 ezali mpo na kosala échelle ya ba primitifs oyo ezali na esika ya ko inventer ya sika. Kyber azalaki ntango nyonso na plan ya nzela; ko changer na défaut etali stabilité sous charge. Tauri eponami likolo ya Electron mpo paquet ezali ~5 MB vs ~150 MB. Bot marketplace public soumissions ezalaki bloquées na infrastructure ya revue oyo ekita na v0.1.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 — kobenga ya etuluku. Ba groupes audio oyo esalemi na SFU tii na 100; bituluku ya bavideo kino na bato 32; diffusion ya mbala moko oyo ekoki kobongwana.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU esalemi na Rust mpo na bosali. Opus DTX + FEC + diffusion ya mbala moko mpo na audio. VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast mpo na video na SFU couche ya kopona na motali moko na kotalela lien ya nse oyo elobami. Per-participant mute mpe kick uta na UI. Enregistrement ya ba appels (consent-gated, off par défaut) ebombami chiffré na se ya clé ya misisa ya appel moko moko oyo ekabolami na kati ya ba participants.
roadmap.h2_c: Ba appels ya groupe ezali fonctionnalité moko oyo esengami mingi na v0.1 beta. SFU design elandi ba modèles ya Jitsi Videobridge + Janus. Rust mise en œuvre au lieu ya kosalela lisusu mediasoup po temps d'exécution ya Node.js ya mediasoup ebakisi latence tolingi te na nzela ya moto.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 — toile ya boyokani. Miro-style shared board likolo ya CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) na nzela ya couche ya messagerie oyo ezali.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT document sync piggybacks na ba messages ya chambre oyo ezali. Bobongisi ya tableau moko na moko ezali opération CRDT oyo esalemi na sérieux lokola CBOR, chiffré na clé ya chambre, etie lokola message ya `kind:"board_op"`. Ba clients ba désérialiser, ba appliquer, ba rendre. Bozali ya curseur na tango ya solo na nzela ya lolenge ya message ya `kind:"board_cursor"` ekeseni. Exporter na PNG / SVG / PDF na nzela ya rendu ya toile côté client.
roadmap.h3_c: Ba CRDT (Shapiro et al. 2011) ekomaki na bokeli na ba Yjs (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma célèbrement batongaki collaboration na bango na structure personnalisée CRDT-like. Likanisi ya kosalela lisusu couche ya message chiffré na biso na esika ya kotonga ba canaux WebSocket ekeseni ewuti na principe moko : ba nzela ya transport moke, ba insectes moke.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 — kofuta mbongo. Escrow na monyololo (Solana + EVM) + rampe ya kofungola/kokangama ya fiat na nzela ya Stripe Connect.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot achats route na nzela ya contrat ya escrow en chaîne. Mosombi andimi; 24 h ya kokangama; na nsima misolo ebimisami na motɛki moins 10 % ya mbongo ya plateforme. Matata ekendaka na ba arbiteurs communautaires oyo baponamaki na nzela ya enjeu. Fiat on-ramp: Ba comptes ya Stripe Connect na opérateur moko to na motekisi ya bot; off-ramp: transfert bancaire direct to USDC ya réglementation. Lisungi ya crypto: SOL, USDC, USDT na Solana mpe na Ethereum.
roadmap.h4_c: Ba contrats intelligents ya Escrow ezali ya kala (OpenBazaar 2016) mais encore rude autour ya ba bords en termes ya UX. Vortex a hériter complexité kasi ebombaka mingi na yango — basombi bamonaka bouton "kosomba" oyo bameseni na yango. Frais ya plateforme ya 10 % ekokani na ba conventions ya App Store (atako Apple ezuaka 30 %); kokata na nse ezali na nko mpo na kobenda batekisi.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 — kozala na bosikisiki. Audit ya sécurité, ba constructions reproducibles na ba plateformes nionso, SemVer congelé.
roadmap.h5_b: Audit ya troisième partie programmé avant 1.0 congelé — probablement Trail of Bits to NCC Groupe sur la base ya ba citations commerciales. Ba builds reproducibles elakisi nzete ya source moko ebimisaka ba binaire bit-identique na ba machines nionso mibale ya kotonga; yango emonisaka ete bazali kobongola makambo na molongo ya bopesi biloko. SemVer congelé elakisi ba protocoles ya fil, schéma ya stockage, na surface public SDK ezuaka ba garanties ya backward-compat na kati ya 1.x. Programme ya bug bounty ebandi na niveau ya likolo ya $25k pona exécution ya code à distance na noeud.
roadmap.h5_c: Sequence ya stabilise-audit-freeze ezali modèle Signal, Tor, I2P, na WireGuard nionso elandi. Ba builds reproducibles ekomaki ya monene sima ya projet ya Reproducible Builds (2014). Vortex esalelaka buku ya bisaleli ya Reproducible Builds. Ba bounties ya ba bug ezali standard pona projet nionso oyo esimbaka ba données ya usager; $25k ezali mid-tier na ba normes ya 2025.

v0.2 bopesi (ebongisami):

  ba chambre ya minene : Variant-B publié clé, jusqu'à 50k membres

  mbongo ya plateforme : 10 % ya brut
