aead.title: AEAD .
aead.subtitle: Chiffrement authentiqué na ba données associées.
aead.intro: AEAD (Chiffrement authentiqué avec des données associées) ezali primitif cryptographique oyo esangisaka sekele mpe bosembo na appel moko. Soki bapesi ye clé, nonce, texte plain, mpe ba données associées optionnelles (AAD), ebimisaka étiquette ya texte chiffre + authentification na ndenge ete manification nionso na soit texte plain, texte chiffre, to AAD elongi te vérification.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Chiffrement authentiqué avec des données associées) ezali primitif cryptographique oyo esangisaka sekele mpe bosembo na appel moko. Soki bapesi ye clé, nonce, texte plain, mpe ba données associées optionnelles (AAD), ebimisaka étiquette ya texte chiffre + authentification na ndenge ete manification nionso na soit texte plain, texte chiffre, to AAD elongi te vérification.
aead.h1_b: Vortex ya AEAD ezalaka toujours AES-256-GCM. Esika ya AAD ememaka contexte oyo moyambi asengeli koyeba mpo na ko déchiffrer correctement (id ya chambre, id ya fichier, offset). Bokangami AAD epekisaka bozongisi ya contexte croisé — texte chiffre oyo euti na chambre A ekoki kozala déchiffré te lokola chambre B.
aead.h1_c: AEAD lokola primitif oyo epesameli kombo ezo traces na Rogaway 2002. GCM (Mode Galois/Counter) ezalaki standardisé na NIST na SP 800-38D (2007). Ekoma AEAD ya default na TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Protocole nionso ya sécurité ya mikolo oyo esalelaka AEAD.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc (k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, étiquette) // ct = len (pt) octets, étiquette = 16 octets
AEAD.Dec (k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt to ⊥
aead.h3_a: AES-GCM, HKDF, mbala moko te, elembo

alembic.title: Alembic
alembic.subtitle: Esaleli ya migration ya base de données mpo na SQLAlchemy.
alembic.intro: Alembic ezali cadre ya migration canonique pona SQLAlchemy. Migration moko na moko ezali fichier Python na ba fonctions `upgrade()` na `downgrade()` oyo ezali kolimbola mbongwana ya schéma lokola ba opérations SQL to ORM.
alembic.h1_a: Alembic ezali cadre ya migration canonique pona SQLAlchemy. Migration moko na moko ezali fichier Python na ba fonctions `upgrade()` na `downgrade()` oyo ezali kolimbola mbongwana ya schéma lokola ba opérations SQL to ORM.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex esalela Alembic na histoire ya révision linéaire (branchement te). `alembic upgrade head` ezo tambola na ebandeli nionso ya conteneur ya Docker. `alembic downgrade -1` ezongisaka lisusu litambe moko mpo na kozongisa sima. Mode Dev esalelaka `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` yango wana iterations locale ezali na besoin ya ba migrations te na rebase nionso.
alembic.h1_c: Alembic ekomamaki na Mike Bayer (mokomi ya SQLAlchemy) na 2011 lokola mokitani ya `sqlalchemy-migrate`. Ba migrations intégrées ya Django (2014) edefaki modèle ya moboko. Alembic atikalaki liboso na makambo — rollback, autogenerate, branching — atako Vortex esalelaka ba branches te.
alembic.h1_f:
alembic/ba versions/ .
  20240101_<revision>_<slug>.py moko na moko na upgrade()/downgrade() .
alembic.h2_a: `alembic.ini`, `alembic/ba versions/*`. Ekambami na nzela ya `make db-migrate`.
alembic.h3_a: SQLAlchimie, Postgres, SQLite, schéma ya kosala

apns.title: Ba APNs
apns.subtitle: Apple Service ya Notification ya Push.
apns.intro: APNs ezali service ya ko push-notification ya Apple pona iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Ba apps ekomisaka jeton ya appareil mpe ba fournisseurs batindaka ba charges utile ya notification na ba APN oyo e ventilaka bango libanda na ba appareils.
apns.h1_a: APNs ezali service ya ko push-notification ya Apple pona iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Ba apps ekomisaka jeton ya appareil mpe ba fournisseurs batindaka ba charges utile ya notification na ba APN oyo e ventilaka bango libanda na ba appareils.
apns.h1_b: Vortex esalela ba APN oyo ezali na ba enveloppes ya poussée scellée : noeud e chiffrer charge utile ya notification moko na moko pona pubkey X25519 ya moyambi; Ba APNs emonaka kaka blob opaque. Extension ya Service ya Notification ya client iOS e déchiffrer na processus separate avant banner esala.
apns.h1_c: Ba APN oyo ebandaki na iOS 3.0 (2009). Soutien ya contenus push / mutable oyo ekangami eyaki na iOS 10 (2016). Auth basée na jeton (.p8) e remplacé auth basée na certificat lokola default na 2016. Vortex esalela auth ya jeton na ba jetons ya fournisseur ya 60 minutes.
apns.h3_a: FCM, Web Push, poussée scellée, Extension ya Service ya Notification

argon2id.title: Argon2id
argon2id.subtitle: Hash ya mot de passe ya mémoire-hard (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: Argon2id ezali fonction ya hashing ya mot de passe oyo ezali makasi na mémoire, oyo ekoki kozala na canal côté. Ba paramètres : taille ya mémoire (m), coût ya temps (iterations, t), parallèlisme (lanes, p), na longueur ya hash. Variante ya 'id' esangisaka ba passes indépendantes ya ba données (Argon2i) na oyo etali ba données (Argon2d).
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id ezali fonction ya hashing ya mot de passe oyo ezali makasi na mémoire, oyo ekoki kozala na canal côté. Ba paramètres : taille ya mémoire (m), coût ya temps (iterations, t), parallèlisme (lanes, p), na longueur ya hash. Variante ya 'id' esangisaka ba passes indépendantes ya ba données (Argon2i) na oyo etali ba données (Argon2d).
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex esalelaka Argon2id na m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32. Yango ezuaka ~0.5 s na iPhone X (appareil na biso oyo esungami na malembe) mpe pene na 5 ms na ASIC ya haut de gamme — vitesse ya 100× ezali négligeable soki tokokanisi yango na ba hashes basées na SHA-256 esika ba ASICs elongi na ba millions.
argon2id.h1_c: Argon2 elongaki Concours ya Hashing ya mot de passe na 2015 oyo ebongisamaki na Dmitry Khovratovich na Alex Biryukov. Standardisé lokola RFC 9106 na 2021. Esalemi na 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Ba paramètres ya Vortex ewuti na ba recommandations ya OWASP 2023.
argon2id.h1_f:
Argon2id(mot ya nzela, mungwa, m, t, p, hashLen) → hash
na ndenge ya libela: m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32
ntalo ya ≈ 0,5s na iPhone X; ~5ms na ASIC (100× mbangu ya mobundi)
argon2id.h3_a: hashing ya mot de passe, AEAD, HKDF, mungwa

blake3.title: BLAKE3 .
blake3.subtitle: Hash cryptographique ya mbangu.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 ezali fonction ya hash cryptographique oyo euti na BLAKE2 na BLAKE. Ebimisaka sortie ya longueur arbitraire na entrée arbitraire; 10× mbangu koleka SHA-256 na ba blobs ya minene grâce na hashing ya nzete ya kati.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 ezali fonction ya hash cryptographique oyo euti na BLAKE2 na BLAKE. Ebimisaka sortie ya longueur arbitraire na entrée arbitraire; 10× mbangu koleka SHA-256 na ba blobs ya minene grâce na hashing ya nzete ya kati.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex esalela BLAKE3 mpo na bosolo ya fichier : fichier moko na moko oyo etie ememaka hash `plain_blake3` ya contenus na yango déchiffré mpo ete bazui bakoka ko vérifier sima ya téléchargement + déchiffrer. Kolona DB ezali na kombo ya lisolo `sha256` mpo na boyokani ya bopanzani kasi ezali na bobimisi BLAKE3.
blake3.h1_c: BLAKE3 ebimisamaki na Jack O’Connor et al. na 2020. Akitaki na BLAKE, oyo ezalaki finaliste ya SHA-3 na 2012. Design ya hashing ya nzete e permettre BLAKE3 e échelle na ba noyaux pona ba entrées minene. SHA-256 ezali kaka mbangu mpo na ba entrées ya mike; BLAKE3 e dominaka na eloko nionso > 4 KiB.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(bytes) = 32 octets // sortie par défaut
BLAKE3(ba octets, len) = ba octets ya len (XOF) .
débit: ~3 GB/s na Apple Silicon vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s

bmp.title: BMP .
bmp.subtitle: Protocole ya boîte postale aveugle.
bmp.intro: BMP ezali couche ya magasin-et-forward oyo eyebani te ya Vortex. Batindi batiaka ba blobs chiffrés na node nionso oyo efungolami na gossip, oyo ekangami na hash ya nzela moko ya pubkey ya moyambi. Blobs ride gossip tiii node ya recipient ebendaka.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ezali couche ya magasin-et-forward oyo eyebani te ya Vortex. Batindi batiaka ba blobs chiffrés na node nionso oyo efungolami na gossip, oyo ekangami na hash ya nzela moko ya pubkey ya moyambi. Blobs ride gossip tiii node ya recipient ebendaka.
bmp.h1_b: BMP epesaka ba propriétés misato ya bomoto ya lipanda : kobomba motindi (TLS + litungulu optionnel), kobomba moyambi (mailbox_id ezali opaque na ba noeuds ya kati), kobomba makambo (blob ezali déjà E2E-chiffré). Max blob 1 MB, cap ya noeud moko 500 MB, taux ya dépôt 10/min/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: BMP esalemaki uta na ebandeli na ekipi ya Vortex. Totongaki yango mpo motindami moko te ya monene azalaki na bolingi ya kofuta ntalo ya ingénierie ya kobomba ba métadonnées suka na nsuka — ba chiffrer ba contenus kasi ba fuite graphique social. Etɛlɛmɛlo na biso banda mokolo ya liboso ezalaki ete momemi-nsango oyo azali na libateli oyo azali kobimisa nani-asololaka-na-nani azali kaka ndambo ya libateli. BMP ekangaka ndambo wana na kosala ete motindi, moyambi, mpe makambo oyo ezali na kati ezala opaque na lipanda, likolo ya maille ya maloba ya Vortex ye moko na esika ya infrastructure oyo ekangami na boulon.
bmp.h3_a: maloba mabe, mosala ya matungulu, motindi oyo akangami, Ebale

cbor.title: CBOR .
cbor.subtitle: Représentation ya Objet Binaire ya mokuse.
cbor.intro: CBOR (RFC 8949) ezali format ya ba données binaire oyo esalemi pona taille ya code ya moke pe encodage ya mbangu. Superensemble ya modèle ya ba données ya JSON, codée binaire, strictement déterministe.
cbor.h1_a: CBOR (RFC 8949) ezali format ya ba données binaire oyo esalemi pona taille ya code ya moke pe encodage ya mbangu. Superensemble ya modèle ya ba données ya JSON, codée binaire, strictement déterministe.
cbor.h1_b: Vortex esalela CBOR lokola format ya charge utile na kati ya ba enveloppes AES-GCM. ~30 % moke koleka JSON na masolo oyo ezali na unicode mingi; parsing strict (ambiguïté ya espace blanc te) etelemeli ba attaques parser-différentielles; schema-free donc kobakisa champ esengaka te recompilation ya .proto.
cbor.h1_c: CBOR ezalaki standardisé lokola RFC 7049 na 2013, ebongwani na RFC 8949 na 2020. Esalemi na Signal (encadrage interne banda 2017), couche ya Matrix ya résolution d’état, WebAuthn (objets d’attestation). Eponami na Vortex na v0.0.2 sima ya kokokanisa contre JSON na protobuf.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR encodage: {type_major (3 bits), argument (5 bits), [données]}
karte: lolenge=5 ba paires
array: lolenge=4 biloko
makomi: lolenge=3 octets
octets: lolenge=2 brut
cbor.h2_a: Enveloppe nionso ya message, charge utile nionso ya poussée scellée, enveloppe nionso ya fédération.
cbor.h3_a: JSON, protobuf, AEAD Ezali ndenge moko na .

controller.title: Contrôleur oyo azali na yango
controller.subtitle: Service ya attestation + ya découverte ya Vortex.
controller.intro: Contrôleur ezali processus Python ekeseni (`vortex_controller`) oyo mosala na yango kaka moko ezali kobimisa manifeste signé (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) mpe ba URL ya entrée. Ba clients ba piner pubkey ya contrôleur Ed25519 na heure ya sortie.
controller.h1_a: Contrôleur ezali processus Python ekeseni (`vortex_controller`) oyo mosala na yango kaka moko ezali kobimisa manifeste signé (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) mpe ba URL ya entrée. Ba clients ba piner pubkey ya contrôleur Ed25519 na heure ya sortie.
controller.h1_b: Ezali kobimisa esika moko ya moke ya API (~12 banzela). Surface étroite ezali délibéré — ezali cible ya attaque ya valeur ya likolo mbala moko ba clients ba pin. Ba miroirs esalaka code moko na touche ya sortie moko; DNS/SNS/IPFS kobimisa ba liste ya ba miroirs.
controller.h1_c: Ekɔtisamaki na v0.0.3 sima ya version ya monolith ya liboso ekangisaki attestation ya noeud na noeud yango moko (noeud oyo ezali na compromis ekokaki kokosa na ntina ya code na yango moko). Kokabola attestation na processus ekeseni oyo esalemi na modèle ya Release.gpg ya Debian + magasin ya misisa ya Chrome.
controller.h3_a: manifeste ya intégrité, fungola ya kobimisa, talatala, ba noeuds_ya confiance

doubleRatchet.title: Ratchet ya mibale
doubleRatchet.subtitle: Protocole ya sekele ya liboso ya Signal.
doubleRatchet.intro: Double Ratchet esangisaka ratchet ya Diffie-Hellman na monyololo ya bafungola ya symétrique. Nsango mokomoko ezali kotombola monyololo na yango; ba trichettes périodiques DH ezongeli clé ya misisa. Ezali kopesa sekele ya liboso (ba messages ya kala na sécurité sima ya compromis) mpe sécurité après compromis (ba messages ya mikolo ekoya na sécurité sima ya re-ratchet).
doubleRatchet.h1_a: Double Ratchet esangisaka ratchet ya Diffie-Hellman na monyololo ya bafungola ya symétrique. Nsango mokomoko ezali kotombola monyololo na yango; ba trichettes périodiques DH ezongeli clé ya misisa. Ezali kopesa sekele ya liboso (ba messages ya kala na sécurité sima ya compromis) mpe sécurité après compromis (ba messages ya mikolo ekoya na sécurité sima ya re-ratchet).
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Vortex esalelaka Double Ratchet mpo na ba chaînes ya message direct. Bashambre ya etuluku esalelaka mwango ya pɛtɛɛ ya motindi-fungola oyo ekangami na misisa ya shambre. Bolai ya monyololo ekangamaki na ba messages 1000 avant re-ratchet forcé; cache ya ba touches skipped tii na 1000 messages hors ordre; encryption ya motó ya likambo na ndenge ya libela.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Esalemaki na Trevor Perrin mpe Moxie Marlinspike na 2013; etiamaki na Signal 2014; adopté na WhatsApp (2016), Masolo ya sekele ya Facebook, Masolo ya sekele ya Skype. Public spec 2016. Misala ya Vortex ezali port direct.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
monyololo ya kotinda: CK_tinda → HKDF(CK_tinda, "etambe") → CK_tinda'.
                    MK → HKDF(CK_kotinda, "nsango")
monyololo ya boyambi: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "etambe") → CK_recv'.
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(eph_na biso, eph_na bango), RK_ya liboso)
doubleRatchet.h3_a: sekele ya liboso, bokengi sima ya boyokani, X25519 .

ech.title: ECH .
ech.subtitle: Client encrypté Mbote (RFC 9460).
ech.intro: ECH ebombaka SNI (Elakiseli ya Nkombo ya Serveur) na TLS 1.3 na kozinga ClientHello ya kati na kati ya ClientHello ya libanda oyo ekangami na nse ya fungola ya bato banso oyo ebimisami na enregistrement DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_a: ECH ebombaka SNI (Elakiseli ya Nkombo ya Serveur) na TLS 1.3 na kozinga ClientHello ya kati na kati ya ClientHello ya libanda oyo ekangami na nse ya fungola ya bato banso oyo ebimisami na enregistrement DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_b: Vortex ba noeuds ebimisaka ba ECHConfigs na ba enregistrements na bango DNS HTTPS. Ba clients oyo bazali na soutien ECH basalelaka kombo ya hôte ya libanda (e.g. `vortex-public.cloudflare.com`) lokola SNI oyo emonanaka; ba observateurs passifs bamonaka kaka kombo wana ya libanda générique. DPI akoki koyebisa client Vortex te na client Cloudflare mosusu.
ech.h1_c: ECH elekaki na ba projets 5 IETF yambo ya standardisation lokola RFC 9460 na 2024. Ba variantes ya liboso : ESNI (2018-2019, esundolami), ECH projet-00 na projet-13 (2020-2024). Chrome efungolaki ECH na ndenge ya libela na 2023; Firefox na 2024. Vortex esungaka yango banda v0.0.9.
ech.h1_f:
libanda SNI: "public.cloudflare.com" ← emonanaka na batali
kati SNI: "node.vortex.ndakisa" ← chiffré
ECHConfig: ebimisami na DNS HTTPS enregistrement ya domaine ya libanda
ech.h3_a: TLS 1.3, DoH, SNI, liboso ya domaine

ed25519.title: Ed25519. Ezali na ntina mingi
ed25519.subtitle: Sinyatili ya EdDSA likolo ya edwards25519 (RFC 8032).
ed25519.intro: Ed25519 ezali schéma ya signature ya courbe elliptique. Ba clés publiques ya 32 octets, ba signature ya 64 octets, signature déterministe par défaut. Vérification ya mbangu (~200 μs na CPU ya mikolo oyo), oyo ekoki ko vérifier na lote.
ed25519.h1_a: Ed25519 ezali schéma ya signature ya courbe elliptique. Ba clés publiques ya 32 octets, ba signature ya 64 octets, signature déterministe par défaut. Vérification ya mbangu (~200 μs na CPU ya mikolo oyo), oyo ekoki ko vérifier na lote.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex e signaka enveloppe nionso ya fédération, manifeste nionso ya intégrité, attestation nionso ya noeud, pe message nionso ya bot na Ed25519. CryptoKit ya Apple na iOS 17+ esalelaka variante RFC 8032bis oyo esalemi na ndenge ya pwasa; Vortex endimi moko to mosusu — vérifieur nyonso oyo azali kotosa mibeko asimbaka nyonso mibale.
ed25519.h1_c: Ed25519 ebimisamaki na Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang na 2011. Ebongisami lokola RFC 8032 na 2017. Ezwamaki na OpenSSH 6.5 (2014), TLS 1.3, Apple Keychain, signal-protocol. Signature déterministe eponama polele likolo ya ECDSA pona ko éviter classe ya vulnérabilité ECDSA RNG-reutilisation.
ed25519.h1_f:
Elembo(d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m) .
              R = r · G. Ezali na ntina mingi
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m) .
              S = r + c · a
              zonga (R, S) .
Verifier: c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
ed25519.h3_a: X25519, ECDSA, signature, sekele ya liboso

fanout.title: Fan-out na yango
fanout.subtitle: Ko diffuser événement moko depuis source moko na ba abonnés ebele.
fanout.intro: Fan-out ezali modèle architectural esika producteur moko a émettre événement moko mpe N consommateurs bazuaka yango. Na couche WebSocket ya Vortex, message moko POST e déclenchaka N socket etindi — moko na abonné moko na chambre.
fanout.h1_a: Fan-out ezali modèle architectural esika producteur moko a émettre événement moko mpe N consommateurs bazuaka yango. Na couche WebSocket ya Vortex, message moko POST e déclenchaka N socket etindi — moko na abonné moko na chambre.
fanout.h1_b: Esalemi lokola ensemble ya ba poignées WebSocket par chambre oyo ebatelami na asyncio.Lock. Kokoma ezuaka, esali copie ya ensemble, ebimisaka, sima ezo iterer copie oyo ezali kozela `ws.send_bytes(payload)` na per-socket 1 s timeout. Ba consommateurs ya malembe bazalaka na molongo ya 256 cadres avant ba cadres ekita.
fanout.h1_c: Fan-out ezongaka na ba systèmes ya publier/abonnement na ba années 1980 (POP, TIBCO). Ba designs ya mikolo oyo (Kafka, Redis pub/sub, NATS) e échelle modèle na ba millions ya ba abonnés. Vortex's per-room in-memory fan-out ezali minimal mpo ezali na besoin ya replication ya cross-node te na mode ya noeud unique; Redis pub/sub e activer na ba clusters ya ba noeuds ebele.
fanout.h1_f:
diffusion(id_ya_shambre, charge utile):
  subs = fanout [id_ya_chambre] # O (1) boluki ya dict
  mpo na ws na snapshot(subs): # kopi mpo na kozongela na bozangi likama
      zela ws.send_bytes (charge utile, tango ya suka = 1s)
fanout.h2_a: `app/chats/fanout.py`, nzela ya molunge mingi mpo na message nionso, réaction, événement ya ko typer, signal ya appel.
fanout.h3_a: WebSocket, abonné, pub/sub ya Redis, molongo

fcm.title: FCM .
fcm.subtitle: Messagerie ya Lipata ya Firebase.
fcm.intro: FCM ezali service ya Google ya ko push-notification pona Android, iOS, web. Ezwaki esika ya Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) ya kala na 2016. Endimi OAuth2 service-account auth.
fcm.h1_a: FCM ezali service ya Google ya ko push-notification pona Android, iOS, web. Ezwaki esika ya Google Cloud Messaging (GCM) ya kala na 2016. Endimi OAuth2 service-account auth.
fcm.h1_b: Vortex esalela FCM na mode `données` (mode `notification` te) yango wana FirebaseMessagingService ya app esala na arrivée mpe e déchiffrer charge utile ya poussée scellée avant ya kozua mokano soki ekolakisa banner. Ba wake-ups ya livraison silencieuse esalela pe ba messages ya ba données FCM.
fcm.h1_c: FCM ebandaki na 2016 na esika ya GCM. Point final ya héritage HTTP elongolamaki na 2024; Vortex esalelaka esika ya suka ya HTTP v1 na OAuth2. Rotation ya ba jetons ngonga nionso esalemaka automatique na nzela ya ba credentiels ya compte service-compte oyo esangisi.
fcm.h3_a: APNs, Web Push, poussée ekangami, OAuth2

federation.title: Fédération oyo ezali
federation.subtitle: Bopesi sango ya bondimi kati na ba noeuds Vortex indépendants.
federation.intro: Fédération ezali lien ya confiance mutuelle entre ba opérateurs mibale ya noeuds. Moko na moko abakisi pubkey ya Ed25519 ya mosusu na tableau na ye ya `fédérations`. Ba usagers na node A bakoki ko messager ba usagers na node B na routage ya ba enveloppes na nzela ya `POST /federation/deliver` oyo e signer.
federation.h1_a: Fédération ezali lien ya confiance mutuelle entre ba opérateurs mibale ya noeuds. Moko na moko abakisi pubkey ya Ed25519 ya mosusu na tableau na ye ya `fédérations`. Ba usagers na node A bakoki ko messager ba usagers na node B na routage ya ba enveloppes na nzela ya `POST /federation/deliver` oyo e signer.
federation.h1_b: Opt-in par opérateur: ezali na "noeud nionso ekoki ko fédéré" par défaut te. Kobakisa peer esengaka action ya admin oyo opérateur a signer. Ba scores ya santé (AIMD ±1) e pause fédération na baninga oyo ba se comporter mabe. Ba retries ya outbox oyo elongaki te ba livraisons na retour exponentiel jusqu'à 14 jours.
federation.h1_c: Fédération ezalaki fonctionnalité ya koboma ya Matrix (2014) mpe avant wana XMPP/Jabber (1999). Design ya Vortex ezui na nionso mibale : ba enveloppes signés (Matrix), ba ancres ya confiance explicite (ezala moko te — tozali stricter), ba scores ya santé (AIMD à partir ya TCP). Ebakisami na v0.0.5.
federation.h3_a: bilobaloba, Ed25519, ba noeuds_ya confiance, moninga

fts5.title: FTS5 .
fts5.subtitle: Tableau virtuel ya boluki ya makomi mobimba ya SQLite.
fts5.intro: FTS5 ezali extension ya boluki ya makomi mobimba ya nkola ya mitano ya SQLite. Ezali kosala tableau virtuel oyo ebombaka ba index tokenisé mpo na ba requêtes LIKE / MATCH ya mbangu.
fts5.h1_a: FTS5 ezali extension ya boluki ya makomi mobimba ya nkola ya mitano ya SQLite. Ezali kosala tableau virtuel oyo ebombaka ba index tokenisé mpo na ba requêtes LIKE / MATCH ya mbangu.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex ezo mirrore ba jetons ya texte ya pamba (client-encrypted lokola ba balises opaques) na tableau virtuel FTS5 yango wana boluki ebeta `O(log n)` na esika ya ba scans ya `O(n)`. Na Chambre ya Android, FTS4 esalelamaka na ba déclencheur oyo ebatelaka tableau virtuel na synchro. Ba déploiements ya Postgres esalelaka `tsvector` / `tsquery` pona tina moko.
fts5.h1_c: FTS ezongaka na SQLite 3.7 (2010). FTS5 etindami na SQLite 3.9 (2015). Bato mingi bandimaka yango; appli nionso ya messagerie local-first na iOS / Android esalelaka yango. Postgres ezali na `tsvector` banda 8.3 (2008).
fts5.h2_a: `app/database.py` (Postgres tsvector), iOS `Boluka/impl/Ebombami ya boluki ya Fts5`, Salle Android `@Fts4`.

gossip.title: Gossip ya komela
gossip.subtitle: Echange périodique ya liste ya baninga kati na ba noeuds Vortex.
gossip.intro: Gossip ezali protocole oyo esalelaka bande passante malamu esika node moko na moko echanger périodiquement connaissance résumé na peer aléatoire. Na tango node nionso e converger na vue moko sans répertoire central.
gossip.h1_a: Gossip ezali protocole oyo esalelaka bande passante malamu esika node moko na moko echanger périodiquement connaissance résumé na peer aléatoire. Na tango node nionso e converger na vue moko sans répertoire central.
gossip.h1_b: Vortex ba noeuds ezo bilobaloba chaque 60 secondes. Echange moko na moko ezali filtre Bloom ya 256 bits oyo ezali ko résumer baninga oyo bayebani; côté mosusu eyanoli na baninga oyo bazangi na filtre plus filtre na yango moko. Bande passante ezali O(ba peers ya sika × 32 B), typiquement sous 1 KiB par tour.
gossip.h1_c: Masolo ya bloom-filter ebandi na papier multidiffusion bimodal ya Cornell ya 1998. Apache Cassandra asalelaka yango mpo na kozala membre; Bitcoin mpo na relais ya transaction; IPFS mpo na DHT entretien. Convergence O(log N) nde ekomisaka yango pratique pona ba réseaux ya minene.
gossip.h1_f:
bosangisi(A, B): .
  A → B: filtre_A = kotia_nyonso (baninga_A, k=5, m=256)
  B → A: baninga_ya sika_mpo na_A = {p ∈ baninga_B : p ∉ filtre_A}, filtre_B
  A abimisaka ndenge moko
limite ya taux: 1 échange na moninga moko na 30 s
gossip.h3_a: Filtre ya bloom, bootstrap, fédération, baninga

gravitix.title: Gravitix .
gravitix.subtitle: Vortex's DSL pona kokoma ba bots.
gravitix.intro: Gravitix ezali monoko ya domaine spécifique oyo ebongisami pona kokoma ba bots Vortex. Ba handlers oyo etambwisami na événement (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), état intégré, chaudière minimal. Compilé na bytecode pe ezo tambola na interprète sandboxed.
gravitix.h1_a: Gravitix ezali monoko ya domaine spécifique oyo ebongisami pona kokoma ba bots Vortex. Ba handlers oyo etambwisami na événement (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), état intégré, chaudière minimal. Compilé na bytecode pe ezo tambola na interprète sandboxed.
gravitix.h1_b: Alternative na Python SDK. Gravitix bots ekoki te ko accéder na système ya ba fichiers to na réseau arbitraire — kaka surface API ya Vortex. Compilateur ebimisaka bytecode; tango ya kosala Rust na `Gravitix/` elimboli. Référence mobimba na mokapo ya Gravitix docs.
gravitix.h1_c: Conçu na tango ya v0.0.6 sima ya ko observer que code bot mingi ezalaki 80 % SDK chaudière autour ya petite noyau ya logique ya solo. A DSL etikaka logique engɛnga mpe ba risque ya sable. Ndenge moko na molimo na Hubot (2011) kasi na sandboxing ya makasi mpe na intégration native Vortex.
gravitix.h2_a: `Gravitix/` misisa ya repo, esika ya code ya bot na `POST /api/bots`.
gravitix.h3_a: bot, zando, sanduku ya zelo, Architex

hkdf.title: HKDF .
hkdf.subtitle: Mosala ya bozui ya ntina oyo esalemi na HMAC (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: HKDF ezali fonction ya dérivation ya clé ya deux étapes : Extrait e comprimer matériel ya clé ya entrée na clé pseudo-aléatoire (PRK); Expand etandami PRK na matériel clé ya sortie ya longueur nionso, ekabwani na ba étiquettes info.
hkdf.h1_a: HKDF ezali fonction ya dérivation ya clé ya deux étapes : Extrait e comprimer matériel ya clé ya entrée na clé pseudo-aléatoire (PRK); Expand etandami PRK na matériel clé ya sortie ya longueur nionso, ekabwani na ba étiquettes info.
hkdf.h1_b: Vortex esalela HKDF-SHA256 bisika nyonso : kokabola X25519 basekele oyo bakabolaka na ba clés ya chiffrement + MAC + tête, kozua ba clés ya fichier par-chunk, kozua ba clés ya sauvegarde na sortie ya Argon2id. Ba chaînes ya info ememaka tango nionso préfixe ya version (e.g. "v1:encryption") po hiérarchie mobimba ya ba clés ekoki ko tourner na ko bumping v1 → v2.
hkdf.h1_c: Ebimisamaki na Hugo Krawczyk na mokolo ya EUROCRYPT 2010; standardisé lokola RFC 5869 na mbula moko. Esalemi na TLS 1.3 mpo na programme na yango, Signal mpo na Double Ratchet, WireGuard mpo na ba touches ya session.
hkdf.h1_f:
Extrait: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(mungwa, IKM) .
Bopanzani: T(1) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, sango ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ info ∥ i) Ezali ndenge moko na ba .
          OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... ekatami na len
hkdf.h3_a: HMAC, X25519, AES-GCM, Ezalí na mbala mibale

hmac.title: HMAC .
hmac.subtitle: Code ya bondimi ya nsango oyo esalemi na hash (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: HMAC ezali construction oyo ebongoli hash cryptographique nionso (SHA-256, SHA-512) na MAC. Epesaka bosembo mpe bondimi epesami sekele oyo bakabolaka.
hmac.h1_a: HMAC ezali construction oyo ebongoli hash cryptographique nionso (SHA-256, SHA-512) na MAC. Epesaka bosembo mpe bondimi epesami sekele oyo bakabolaka.
hmac.h1_b: Vortex esalela HMAC-SHA256 na HKDF, mpo na ba signature JWT (HS256), mpo na dérivation ya pseudo ya motindi na ba chambre, mpe mpo na signature ya credentiel ya coturn TURN. Bokokanisi ya ntango ya ntango nyonso esengeli na ngambo ya botalisi — `hmac.compare_digest` na Python.
hmac.h1_c: HMAC ebandaki na Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk na 1996. Ebongisami lokola RFC 2104 (1997) mpe FIPS 198 (2002). Ekoma MAC ya default na TLS, IPsec, SSH. Signal, Matrix, Discord, Slack nionso basalelaka HMAC-SHA256 pona ba jetons na bango ya JWT na session.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC(fungola, msg) = H( (fungola ⊕ opad) ∥ H( (fungola ⊕ ipad) ∥ msg ) )
  esika opad = 0x5c ezongelami, ipad = 0x36 ezongelami, taille ya bloc ekokani na H
hmac.h2_a: Bisika nionso na stack ya crypto. Grep mpo na `hmac_sha256` to `HKDF`.
hmac.h3_a: HKDF, JWT, SHA-256, kokokanisa na ntango ya ntango nyonso

ice.title: ICE .
ice.subtitle: Bokeli ya boyokani ya boyokani (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ICE ezali mécanisme WebRTC pona koluka nzela ya réseau kati ya baninga mibale sima ya ba NAT. Baninga batanga ba candidats (hôte, server-reflexif, relais), ba échanger bango, mpe bamekaka ba paires tiii moko akolonga.
ice.h1_a: ICE ezali mécanisme WebRTC pona koluka nzela ya réseau kati ya baninga mibale sima ya ba NAT. Baninga batanga ba candidats (hôte, server-reflexif, relais), ba échanger bango, mpe bamekaka ba paires tiii moko akolonga.
ice.h1_b: Ba courtiers ya noeuds ya Vortex ICE échange ya candidat via WebSocket signalisation. coturn epesaka STUN (mpo na bokutani ya srflx) mpe TURN (mpo na relais tango banzela ya semba elongi te). Ba credentiels ya HMAC ya tango mokuse epesami na appel moko.
ice.h1_c: ICE e standardisé lokola RFC 5245 (2010) mpe ezongisamaki sika lokola RFC 8445 (2018). Nsima ya carrier-grade NAT, banzela ya semba elongi ~15 % ya ntango — TURN relais ezali inévitable. WebRTC esalaki ICE ya monene; biloko nyonso oyo basalelaka mpo na kobenga na video esalelaka yango.
ice.h1_f:
ba candidats:
  moyambi : rtp://192.168.1.5:49152 (ya mboka IP)
  srflx : rtp://203.0.113.5:49152 (STUN-ezwami diskur ya bato banso)
  relais : rtp://turn.vortex:49153 (relais oyo epesami na TURN)
vérification ya mibale: STUN Lisengi ya bokangami; paire ya liboso mpo na kolonga = eponami
ice.h2_a: `app/appel/`, config ya ngambo ya client WebRTC.
ice.h3_a: WebRTC, TURN, STUN, kobalusa, NAT koleka

jwt.title: JWT .
jwt.subtitle: JSON Jeton ya Web (RFC 7519).
jwt.intro: JWT ezali format ya jeton compact oyo ezali na ba parties misato codées na base64-url : tête, charge utile (reclamation), signature. Esalemi mpo na bondimi ya session sans état.
jwt.h1_a: JWT ezali format ya jeton compact oyo ezali na ba parties misato codées na base64-url : tête, charge utile (reclamation), signature. Esalemi mpo na bondimi ya session sans état.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex esalelaka ba JWT HS256 (HMAC-SHA256). Jeton ya accès ememaka `{sub: id_ya mosaleli, jti: id_ya dispositif, typ: accès, exp}`, 15 min TTL. Token ya kozongisa sika `typ: kozongisa sika`, 30 d TTL. Etiamaki maboko likolo ya sekele ya 64 octets uta na `.env`. Ba réclamations sensibles te oyo eleki user_id.
jwt.h1_c: Ba JWTs e standardisé lokola RFC 7519 (2015). OAuth 2.0 ezalaki ko populariser bango depuis 2012. Décennie ya critique : ba attaques ya alg-confusion, manque ya révocation. Vortex ekitisaka: HS256 kaka (mobulungano ya RS/ES te), jti oyo ezali na clé ya dispositif (ekoki kozongisama na nzela ya ba appareils_ya mosaleli).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE.
motó = base64url ({alg: "HS256", lolenge: "JWT"})
charge utile = base64url ({sub, jti, lolenge, exp})
sig = base64url (HMAC-SHA256(sekele, motó + "." + charge utile))
jwt.h3_a: HMAC, OAuth 2.0, elembo ya kozongisa sika, elembo ya bokɔti

kyber.title: Kyber-768 na mokanda
kyber.subtitle: Encapsulation ya clé post-quantique (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: Kyber-768 (officiellement ML-KEM-768) ezali mécanisme standardisé ya encapsulation ya clé post-quantique ya NIST. Ba clés publics ya 1184 octets, ba ciphrtextes ya 1088 octets, ba secrets ya 32 octets oyo bakabolaka. Bobateli ekiti na Module-LWE, oyo endimami quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_a: Kyber-768 (officiellement ML-KEM-768) ezali mécanisme standardisé ya encapsulation ya clé post-quantique ya NIST. Ba clés publics ya 1184 octets, ba ciphrtextes ya 1088 octets, ba secrets ya 32 octets oyo bakabolaka. Bobateli ekiti na Module-LWE, oyo endimami quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex esalela Kyber na ndenge ya bolingi na hybride: `fungola_ya_session = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="session-v1")`. Soki ndambo moko to mosusu esimbaki, likita yango ezali na likama te. Opt-in na v0.1, on-by-default ekanamaki mpo na v0.2. Ntalo: ~2 KB ya kobakisa na session moko kosimbana na maboko; latence ezali négligeable.
kyber.h1_c: Kyber azalaki moko ya ~70 submissions na concours ya NIST ya PQ (2016). Baponaki mpo na kosala standardisation na sanza ya nsambo 2022; finalisé comme FIPS 203 en août 2024. Chrome e activaki Kyber hybride na TLS 1.3 na 2024. Signal ebakisaki yango na protocole na bango même année.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B. Ezali na ntina mingi kozala na bomoi ya malamu
Encaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B. Ezali na ba mbongo mingi te
Ba décaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256
hybride = HKDF(x25519_kobima ∥ kyber_kobima, "session-v1")
kyber.h3_a: X25519, HKDF, oyo ekoki koboya quantum, hybride KEM

mailbox.title: Boîte postale
mailbox.subtitle: Esika ya kobomba biloko oyo ezali na adresse ya moyambi na BMP.
mailbox.intro: Boîte postale ezali abstraction ya BMP mpo na "esika oyo ba messages mpo na moyambi moko epesami ezali kozela". Eyebani na `mailbox_id` ya 32 octets oyo euti na pubkey ya moyambi na nzela ya HKDF.
mailbox.h1_a: Boîte postale ezali abstraction ya BMP mpo na "esika oyo ba messages mpo na moyambi moko epesami ezali kozela". Eyebani na `mailbox_id` ya 32 octets oyo euti na pubkey ya moyambi na nzela ya HKDF.
mailbox.h1_b: Kaka motindi (oyo ayebi recipient_pubkey) mpe moyambi (oyo ayebi pubkey na ye moko) nde bakoki kosala calcul ya mailbox_id oyo epesami. Ba noeuds ya kati emonaka kaka identifiant opaque ya 32 octets. Boîte postale moko na moko ezali na TTL 7200 s mpe bouchon ya stockage 500 MB na noeud moko.
mailbox.h1_c: Liloba yango euti na email ya kala. BMP adefi lisese kasi asali ete boîte postale euti na moyambi na esika ya kopesama na serveur — etape moko te ya "kosala boîte postale", serveur moko te ayebi ba adresse nini ezali.
mailbox.h1_f:
id_ya_boîte de poste = HKDF(fungola_ya_moyambi, info="bmp-v1", len=32)
kaka motindi (ayebi recipient_pk) na moyambi (ayebi pk ye moko) nde bakoki kosala calcul
mailbox.h3_a: BMP, maloba mabe, HKDF, motindi oyo akangami

nonce.title: Nonce
nonce.subtitle: Motango oyo esalelami mbala moko — motuya ya kosalela mbala moko.
nonce.intro: Nonce ezali motuya oyo esengeli ata moke te kozongela na nse ya fungola oyo epesami. Na Vortex opération nionso ya AES-GCM esalela nonce ya sika ya 96 bits aléatoires. Kozongela kosalela nonce na fungola moko ebebisaka sekele mpe bosolo — mobundi oyo azali na ba chiffres mibale na nse ya moko (fungola, nonce) akoki kozongisa ba XOR ya makomi ya polele.
nonce.h1_a: Nonce ezali motuya oyo esengeli ata moke te kozongela na nse ya fungola oyo epesami. Na Vortex opération nionso ya AES-GCM esalela nonce ya sika ya 96 bits aléatoires. Kozongela kosalela nonce na fungola moko ebebisaka sekele mpe bosolo — mobundi oyo azali na ba chiffres mibale na nse ya moko (fungola, nonce) akoki kozongisa ba XOR ya makomi ya polele.
nonce.h1_b: Vortex ebimisaka ba nonces na OS CSPRNG (`sekele.bytes_ya_token`, `SecRandom`, `java.security.SecureRandom`). Anniversaire ekangami na 96 bits: ~2^32 messages avant collision ekomi plausible, mosika koleka que clé nionso ya chambre emonaka na vie na yango. Défensive duplicate-nonce suivi na noeud lokola ceinture-et-suspenders.
nonce.h1_c: Likanisi ya nonce ezali ya kala na cryptographie; liloba yango moko euti na Lingelesi ya kala "mpo na mbala moko". Recommandé ya 96 bits ya GCM euti na NIST SP 800-38D. Bobukani ya Adobe 2013 eyebani mingi mpo na kozongisa makomi ya polele uta na ba nonces oyo ezongelami mbala na mbala na ngambo ya client RSA.
nonce.h1_f:
P(collision) na 109 AES-GCM nonces = ~10−19
anniversaire bound: collision ya liboso ezelamaki autour ya 248 nonces na clé moko
GCM sécurité: 232 nonces aléatoires par clé avant bound e dégrader
nonce.h2_a: Kobenga nyonso ya AES-GCM. Compteur elandaka na ndenge ya défense na `app/security/crypto.py`.
nonce.h3_a: AES-GCM, CSPRNG, mokolo ya mbotama ekangami, AEAD

ohttp.title: OHTTP .
ohttp.subtitle: Kobosana HTTP (RFC 9458).
ohttp.intro: OHTTP ezali protocole pona ba demandes HTTP relaised esika parti moko te amonaka ezala demande pe réponse. Client atindaka na nzela ya relais oyo elongolaka ba têtes identifiants; relais ezo kende liboso na porte oyo ezo déchiffrer pe ezo répondre.
ohttp.h1_a: OHTTP ezali protocole pona ba demandes HTTP relaised esika parti moko te amonaka ezala demande pe réponse. Client atindaka na nzela ya relais oyo elongolaka ba têtes identifiants; relais ezo kende liboso na porte oyo ezo déchiffrer pe ezo répondre.
ohttp.h1_b: Vortex esalela OHTTP lokola fallback ya kobombana ya Layer-5. Esangisi na service ya matungulu mpe BMP, OHTTP epesaka nzela ya nsuka ntango TLS ekangami mobimba. Relais ezali partie oyo ekabwani na confiance (typiquement Cloudflare to infrastructure ya privacy-relais ya Apple).
ohttp.h1_c: OHTTP ezalaki standardisé lokola RFC 9458 na 2024, ekomamaki elongo na Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla. Apple ya iCloud Private Relay (2021) ezali déploiement ya liboso OHTTP-adjacent. Vortex ebakisaki OHTTP lisungi ya fallback na v0.0.9.
ohttp.h1_f:
client → relais: Encrypt_gateway_pub(bosengi) + info ya routage aléatoire
relais → porte : kokende liboso, elongolaka mitó ya makambo oyo emonisaka client
porte → eyano: ko déchiffrer, processus, Encrypter_client_pub(eyano)
relais → client: eyano ya kotinda
ohttp.h3_a: Tor, mosala ya matungulu, BMP, ECH

onion.title: Service ya matungulu
onion.subtitle: Tor service ya kobombama.
onion.intro: Service ya matungulu ezali service ya TCP oyo ekoki kozuama na nzela ya protocole ya rendezvous ya Tor. Eyebani na adresse ya matungulu (base32 ya caractère 56 ya pubkey Ed25519 na v3). IP ya bato banso te, DNS te, registre central te.
onion.h1_a: Service ya matungulu ezali service ya TCP oyo ekoki kozuama na nzela ya protocole ya rendezvous ya Tor. Eyebani na adresse ya matungulu (base32 ya caractère 56 ya pubkey Ed25519 na v3). IP ya bato banso te, DNS te, registre central te.
onion.h1_b: Noeud nionso Vortex ezo se exposer lokola `.onion` lokola pe point final HTTPS na yango normal. Ba clients oyo baza na soutien ya Tor bakweyaka na matungulu tango nionso mosusu elongi te. Bande passante ezali ~10× malembe kasi ekoki kozuama na kati ya ba réseaux entièrement restreints.
onion.h1_c: Ba services ya matungulu ebandi na Tor 2004 (v1). Etongamaki lisusu lokola ba services ya matungulu v3 na 2017 na ba clés Ed25519. Esalemi na SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica, ba organisations nionso ya minene oyo eyebi crypto. Signal ebakisaki livraison ya service ya matungulu na 2022.
onion.h1_f:
adresse = base32(Ed25519_pubkey ∥ vérification ∥ version_byte) ∥ ".litungulu".
          = 56 caractères na matungulu v3
onion.h2_a: `/etc/tor/torrc` na `deploy/`, ebimisami na nzela ya contrôleur `/v1/mirrors`.
onion.h3_a: Tor, Flocon de neige, BMP, transport oyo ekoki kokangama na fiche

prekey.title: Prekey ya liboso
prekey.subtitle: Pubkey éphémère ebimisami avant temps pona bootstrap ya ba DM ya sika.
prekey.intro: Preclé ezali X25519 keypair oyo ebimisamaka na noeud avant besoin po ba contacts ya sika bakoka kobanda masolo chiffré sans retour. Mosaleli moko na moko azali ko uploader batch (10 préclés par défaut); serveur asalelaka bango na demande; client a uploader mingi soki ezali moke.
prekey.h1_a: Preclé ezali X25519 keypair oyo ebimisamaka na noeud avant besoin po ba contacts ya sika bakoka kobanda masolo chiffré sans retour. Mosaleli moko na moko azali ko uploader batch (10 préclés par défaut); serveur asalelaka bango na demande; client a uploader mingi soki ezali moke.
prekey.h1_b: Liboke ya ba préclés ya Vortex ezali signé na clé ya identité ya dispositif ya long terme po attaquant akoki ko swap ba préclés forgés te ata na accès ya niveau ya noeud. Ba DM ya sika basalelaka Diffie-Hellman ya tour moko contre prekey ya sika avant Double Ratchet ekota.
prekey.h1_c: Ba préclés ezali ya design ya protocole ya Signal ya 2013 (X3DH). Yambo ya X3DH, bootstrap chiffré esengelaki ba voyages ya retour synchrone — mabe mpo na messagerie asynchrone. Messenger nionso ya sécurité ya mikolo oyo asalelaka bootstrap ya style prékey.
prekey.h1_f:
liboke = { .
  bomoto_pk, .
  signé_prekey_pk, .
  signé_prekey_sig = Ed25519-Sign (priv_ya_identité, pk_ya_pk_ya_pk_ya_sinyatili),
  bafungola_ya_mbala moko: [pk_0, pk_1, ..., pk_9].
} .
prekey.h3_a: X25519, Tricot Double, X3DH, échange ya ba clés

reality.title: Bosolo ya solo
reality.subtitle: TLS-na kati-TLS masquerade transport ya kobombana.
reality.intro: Réalité ezali transport ya kobombana oyo ezo masquerade lokola TLS na vrai origine ya grande technologie (typiquement www.microsoft.com). Ba cibles ya kosimbana na maboko ya libanda Microsoft; kosimbana na maboko ya kati ezali Vortex. Ba sondes actives dirigées na libanda ezuaka envoyé na origine ya solo donc sonde emonisaka eloko te.
reality.h1_a: Réalité ezali transport ya kobombana oyo ezo masquerade lokola TLS na vrai origine ya grande technologie (typiquement www.microsoft.com). Ba cibles ya kosimbana na maboko ya libanda Microsoft; kosimbana na maboko ya kati ezali Vortex. Ba sondes actives dirigées na libanda ezuaka envoyé na origine ya solo donc sonde emonisaka eloko te.
reality.h1_b: Vortex esungaka Réalité lokola transport fichable ya Niveau-4. Config elakisaka cible ya masquerade, ba ID ya mikuse, mpe clé public Vortex X25519. Serveur e validaka ba clients oyo ekoti na match short-ID; ba sondes oyo ekokani te ezuaka biyano ya origine ya solo.
reality.h1_c: Réalité ebimaki na 2022 lokola eyano na Grand Firewall ya Chine oyo e détecter ba transports ya kala oyo esalemi na TLS (VMess ya V2Ray, Trojan). Ezwamaki na XrayCore na 2023. Vortex ebakisaki lisungi na v0.0.9.
reality.h1_f:
kosimbana na maboko ya libanda: TLS kino Microsoft, SNI=www.microsoft.com
ya kati (soki auth ok): Vortex trafic na nzela ya canal ya ba données
eyano ya sonde: eyano ya solosolo ya microsoft.com etindami na mobundi
                    ⇒ observateur amonaka kaka "yeah, eza microsoft.com".
reality.h3_a: na kobombana, transport oyo ekoki kokangama na fiche, Trojan, VMess

rbac.title: RBAC .
rbac.subtitle: Contrôle d’accès basé na rôle.
rbac.intro: RBAC ezali modèle ya contrôle d’accès esika ba permissions epesami na ba rôles mpe ba usagers bapesameli ba rôles. Vortex esalelaka RBAC ya niveau misato na chambre moko: nkolo > admin > membre.
rbac.h1_a: RBAC ezali modèle ya contrôle d’accès esika ba permissions epesami na ba rôles mpe ba usagers bapesameli ba rôles. Vortex esalelaka RBAC ya niveau misato na chambre moko: nkolo > admin > membre.
rbac.h1_b: Cascade: ba propriétaires bazalaka na puissance admin nionso en plus makoki unique ya ko effacer chambre to ko transferer propriété. Ba administrateurs ba inviter, ba kick, ba mute, ba modifier ba paramètres ya salle. Ba membres batindaka ba messages, ba réagir, ba modifier ba messages na bango moko. Ba changements ya rôle e enregistrer lokola ba messages ya système po membre nionso amona yango.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC lokola modèle officiel ebandi na mokanda ya NIST ya 1992 ya Ferraiolo & Kuhn. Akomaki mainstream na entreprise IAM (AWS, Azure) na ba années 2010. Niveau ya chambre RBAC ezali standard na ba produits ya chat — ops/voix/utilisateur ya IRC (1988), ba rôles ya Discord (2015), admin/membre/invité ya Slack.
rbac.h1_f:
mikumba: nkolo ⊃ administrateur ⊃ membre
transfert: nkolo atie new_owner_id → nkolo ya kala akiti na admin
revoque: admin akoki ko kitisa membre; propriétaire akoki ko démoter admin moko
rbac.h2_a: `room_members.role`, e vérifié na nzela nionso ya kokoma na nzela ya `app/chats/permissions.py`.

sfu.title: SFU .
sfu.subtitle: Unité ya Envoi Selective.
sfu.intro: SFU ezali boîte ya kati oyo esangisaka ba médias na ba appels ya groupe. Mosangani moko na moko azali ko uploader stream moko; ba SFU batindi yango na basusu. Ezali kozwa esika ya topologie ya matiti mobimba (peer moko na moko azali ko coder ba flux N-1) esika échelle ezali O(N2).
sfu.h1_a: SFU ezali boîte ya kati oyo esangisaka ba médias na ba appels ya groupe. Mosangani moko na moko azali ko uploader stream moko; ba SFU batindi yango na basusu. Ezali kozwa esika ya topologie ya matiti mobimba (peer moko na moko azali ko coder ba flux N-1) esika échelle ezali O(N2).
sfu.h1_b: Vortex's SFU esalemi na Rust pona performance. Simulcast-aware: mobengi moko na moko azali ko coder ba résolutions misato na mbala moko; na SFU eponaka oyo ebongi na lien ya nse oyo motali moko ayebisi. Ba groupes ya audio kaka jusqu’à 100 participants; bituluku ya video kino na 32 (v0.3 feuille de route).
sfu.h1_c: SFU architecture ebandi na Videobridge ya Jitsi (2013). Yambo ya SFU, ba appels ya groupe WebRTC ezalaki ya maille mobimba. Zoom, Google Kokutana, Jitsi, Signal groupe appels nionso esalela SFU. Vortex bituluku oyo ezali kaka na mongongo oyo etindami na v0.0.8.
sfu.h1_f:
maille mobimba (N baninga): moko na moko etindi ba flux N-1 → O(N2) lien ascende
SFU (N peers): moko na moko atinda 1 flux → O(N) uplink na peer moko
simulcast: L1 (na nse) + L2 (kati) + L3 (likolo) ba encodages concurrents
SFU eponaka couche na motali moko na kotalela BWE-reported downlink
sfu.h3_a: WebRTC, bopanzi sango mbala moko, ICE, TURN

snowflake.title: Eloko ya neige
snowflake.subtitle: Tor transport ya volontaire-relais likolo ya WebRTC.
snowflake.intro: Snowflake ezali transport pluggable ya Tor Project esika ba navigateurs volontaires basalaka lokola ba relais WebRTC. Ba usagers ba installer extension ya navigateur mpe navigateur na bango ekomi relais pendant que bazali na onglet ouvert.
snowflake.h1_a: Snowflake ezali transport pluggable ya Tor Project esika ba navigateurs volontaires basalaka lokola ba relais WebRTC. Ba usagers ba installer extension ya navigateur mpe navigateur na bango ekomi relais pendant que bazali na onglet ouvert.
snowflake.h1_b: Vortex endimi Snowflake lokola fallback ya Couche-4 tango TLS na ba transports primaires ekangami. Infra esengeli te na ngambo na biso — tozali kaka na mposa ya ba ponts ya Snowflake oyo ebimisami na bisika oyo eyebani malamu. Bavolontaires oyo bazali kotambwisa extension bapesaka couverture.
snowflake.h1_c: Snowflake ebandaki na 2020 lokola remplacement ya Tor Project mpo na obfs4 (oyo ekomaki fingerprint-able). Transport WebRTC ezali pasi ko bloquer mpo kosala bongo ekobuka ebele ya ba appels vidéo légitimes. Vortex ebakisaki lisungi na v0.0.9.
snowflake.h1_f:
client → Broker ya snowflake: "Nazali na posa ya proxy".
broker matches na extension ya navigateur volontaire oyo ezali kosala
volontaire → Kokota na Tor: kotinda trafic ya client likolo ya WebRTC
avantage: WebRTC mobembo ezali bisika nyonso; ko bloquer ebukaka ba appels vidéo
snowflake.h3_a: Tor, transport oyo ekoki kokangama, WebRTC, obfs4

tls13.title: TLS 1.3
tls13.subtitle: Bobateli ya couche ya transport, version 1.3 (RFC 8446).
tls13.intro: TLS 1.3 ezali version ya lelo ya protocole TLS. Elongolaka ba primitifs oyo ezali na sécurité te (RSA échange ya ba clés, CBC MACs, statique ECDH), e simplifier kosimbana na maboko na voyage moko ya retour, e mandater sekele ya kokende liboso.
tls13.h1_a: TLS 1.3 ezali version ya lelo ya protocole TLS. Elongolaka ba primitifs oyo ezali na sécurité te (RSA échange ya ba clés, CBC MACs, statique ECDH), e simplifier kosimbana na maboko na voyage moko ya retour, e mandater sekele ya kokende liboso.
tls13.h1_b: Connexion nionso ya fédération HTTPS + WSS + na Vortex esalela TLS 1.3. Tozali ko correspondre na ClientHello ya Chrome 120 byte-for-byte donc DPI ekoki ko fingerprint biso te lokola non-navigateur. ECH (encrypté SNI) ezali opt-in na nzela ya config ya libanda-SNI.
tls13.h1_c: TLS 1.3 e standardisé lokola RFC 8446 na août 2018 sima ya mibu 4 pe ba projets 28. Chrome, Firefox, Safari etindaki lisungi na 2018. Microsoft abakisaki yango na Windows na 2020. Na 2022 ezalaki mingi ya trafic web.
tls13.h1_f:
kosimbana na mabɔkɔ (1-RTT):
  Client → Serveur: ClientMbote (kokabola_fungola, SNI?, ALPN, ...)
  Serveur → Client: ServeurMbote + Extensions chiffrées + Cert + CertVérifier + Esili
  Client → Serveur: Esili + Ba Données ya Application
tls13.h2_a: Connexion nionso ya TLS. Bokokani ya empreinte ya misapi na `app/transport/stealth_level1.py`.
tls13.h3_a: ECH, TLS empreinte ya mosapi, JA4, sekele ya liboso

totp.title: TOTP .
totp.subtitle: Mot de passe ya mbala moko oyo esalemi na tango (RFC 6238).
totp.intro: TOTP ezali mot de passe ya mbala moko oyo euti na sekele oyo bakabolaka mpe na ngonga ya lelo. Ba paramètres par défaut: Etape ya tango ya 30 secondes, code ya 6 chiffres, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_a: TOTP ezali mot de passe ya mbala moko oyo euti na sekele oyo bakabolaka mpe na ngonga ya lelo. Ba paramètres par défaut: Etape ya tango ya 30 secondes, code ya 6 chiffres, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_b: 2FA ya Vortex esalela TOTP na ba RFC ya défaut. Ba usagers ba scanner QR na tango ya inscription; code oyo esalemi na appli na bango ya Authenticator ekokani na code oyo serveur azelaka. Taux-limité na 5 tentatives par 5 minutes par usager.
totp.h1_c: TOTP (RFC 6238, 2011) ya Mark Pei oyo etongamaki na HOTP (RFC 4226, 2005). Yambo na yango, RSA SecurID ezalaki kosalela algorithme moko ya propriétaire. Google Mopesi ndingisa (2010) akómisaki bato mingi TOTP; app nionso ya 2FA esalela yango sikoyo.
totp.h1_f:
TOTP(k, t) = HOTP(k, ⌊t / 30⌋) Ezali ndenge moko na ba .
HOTP(k, c) = kokata( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106
fenêtre: ±1 étape toléré mpo na skew ya montre
totp.h3_a: HMAC, 2FA, mopesi ndingisa, ba code ya sauvegarde

turn.title: TURN .
turn.subtitle: Traversal Kosalela ba Relais zinga zinga ya NAT (RFC 8656).
turn.intro: TURN ezali protocole ya ko relayer UDP / TCP trafic na nzela ya serveur public tango ba nzela ya direct ya peer-to-peer elongi te. Esalemi lokola nzela ya fallback tango ba candidats ya hôte na serveur-reflexif ya ICE basalaka te.
turn.h1_a: TURN ezali protocole ya ko relayer UDP / TCP trafic na nzela ya serveur public tango ba nzela ya direct ya peer-to-peer elongi te. Esalemi lokola nzela ya fallback tango ba candidats ya hôte na serveur-reflexif ya ICE basalaka te.
turn.h1_b: Vortex etindi instance ya coturn na noeud nionso. Ba credentiels ezali ya ntango mokuse (24 h), HMAC-signé, epesami na appel moko. Tango NAT traversal elongi te — typiquement sima ya symétrique NAT to strict firewall — ba médias nionso ya kobenga ezoleka na TURN.
turn.h1_c: TURN esalemaki mpo na mbala ya liboso standardisé lokola RFC 5766 (2010), ebongwani na RFC 8656 (2020). Esalemi na déploiement nionso ya WebRTC pona ~15 % ya ba appels esika ba voies directes elongi te. coturn ezali mise en œuvre ya source ouverte ya référence.
turn.h1_f:
kombo ya mosaleli = "{expire_unix}:{id_ya_mosaleli}".
mot ya nzela = base64(HMAC-SHA1(sekele_ya_mosaleli, nkombo ya mosaleli))
TTL = 24 h
coturn e validaka HMAC na AUTH nionso; aboyaka sima ya expiration
turn.h3_a: ICE, STUN, WebRTC, NAT koleka na nzela

vapid.title: VAPID .
vapid.subtitle: Identification ya Serveur ya Application ya bolingi (RFC 8292).
vapid.intro: VAPID ezali paire ya ba touches Ed25519 oyo serveur ya application esalela pona komi identifier na ba fournisseurs ya Web Push. Elongolaka motuna ya "nani azali na ndingisa ya kotinda push" mpo na ba déploiements ya Web Push.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID ezali paire ya ba touches Ed25519 oyo serveur ya application esalela pona komi identifier na ba fournisseurs ya Web Push. Elongolaka motuna ya "nani azali na ndingisa ya kotinda push" mpo na ba déploiements ya Web Push.
vapid.h1_b: Client web ya Vortex azali kosala abonné na Web Push na kosalelaka clé public VAPID ya node. Ba charges utile ezali chiffrées na touche sealed-push separate (p256dh) par abonnément. Rotation : clé VAPID eumelaka mingi kasi ba charges utile oyo e signer ezalaka na expiration ya mokuse na style JWT.
vapid.h1_c: VAPID ezalaki standardisé lokola RFC 8292 na 2017. Yambo ya VAPID, Web Push esengelaki soit ba abonnés ya FCM-brokered to mecanisme ya auth ekeseni. VAPID e simplifier ba déploiements auto-hébergés — projet ya Firebase esengeli te.
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, ebimisami na nzela ya contrôleur `/v1/health` mpo na diagnostic.
vapid.h3_a: Web Push, poussée ekangami, Ed25519, JWT

waf.title: WAF .
waf.subtitle: Firewall ya Application Web.
waf.intro: WAF ezali middleware oyo etalaka ba demandes HTTP mpe e bloquer ba modèles eyebani-malicieux (SQL injection, traversal ya nzela, injection ya modèle) avant ekoma na code ya application.
waf.h1_a: WAF ezali middleware oyo etalaka ba demandes HTTP mpe e bloquer ba modèles eyebani-malicieux (SQL injection, traversal ya nzela, injection ya modèle) avant ekoma na code ya application.
waf.h1_b: WAF ya Vortex etambolaka lokola `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware`. ~50 ba vérifications ya regex contre URL, requête, nzoto. Ba blocs `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$esika`, eyebani XSS ba modèles. Ezali mpe kosala ete ndelo ya taux ya mokili mobimba (1000 req/s), ndelo ya nzela moko (kokɔta 10/min, enregistrement 5/min), ndelo ya mosaleli moko.
waf.h1_c: Ba WAFs ebandi na mod_security (2002). Cloudflare ya WAF (2014) akómisaki motindo yango biloko ya mombongo. Cadre web nionso ya mikolo oyo etindi ensemble ya ba vérifications par défaut. Liste ya regex ya Vortex esalemaki na ba signature OWASP Top 10.
waf.h1_f:
na bosenga nyonso:
  mpo na motindo na SQLI_PATTERNS: soki motindo.search(url + motuna + nzoto): koboya
  mpo na motindo na TRAVERSAL: soki motindo.search(url): koboya
  mpo na motindo na TEMPLATE: soki motindo.luka(nzoto): koboya
limite-taux oyo ekangami na (IP, nzela, id_ya mosaleli)
waf.h3_a: kopekisa taux, journal ya audit, OWASP, SQL injection

x25519.title: X25519 .
x25519.subtitle: Diffie-Hellman na courbe elliptique likolo ya Courbe25519 (RFC 7748).
x25519.intro: X25519 ezali Diffie-Hellman ya courbe elliptique likolo ya Curve25519 na lolenge na yango ya Montgomery. Ba clés privées mpe publiques ya 32 octets, secret ya 32 octets oyo bakabolaka. Esalelamaka mpo na boyokani ya ntina.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 ezali Diffie-Hellman ya courbe elliptique likolo ya Curve25519 na lolenge na yango ya Montgomery. Ba clés privées mpe publiques ya 32 octets, secret ya 32 octets oyo bakabolaka. Esalelamaka mpo na boyokani ya ntina.
x25519.h1_b: Identité nionso ya dispositif statique, clé nionso ya session éphémère, abonnément nionso ya poussée scellée na Vortex esalelaka X25519. Misala ya Montgomery-escalier ezali constant-temps mpe immune na classe ya ba attaques ya canal côté oyo etungisaki ba courbes ya liboso.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 ebimisamaki na Bernstein (2005); standardisé lokola RFC 7748 (2016) na kombo X25519 mpo na variante DH. Ezwami na Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMessage, Chrome (hybride post-quantique). Ezali bisika nyonso na cryptographie appliquée ya mikolo oyo.
x25519.h1_f:
clé privée: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 octets ya moke-endian, ekangami)
clé public: A = a · G (point comprimé ya 32 octets) .
bakabolaki: s = a · B = b · A (32 octets, → bokotisi HKDF)
performance: ~100 μs na DH na iPhone 11
x25519.h2_a: `app/sécurité/crypto.py::x25519_sekele_ekabolami`, iOS `VortexCrypto.X25519Boyokani ya fungola`, Android `crypto/dh/X25519Boyokani ya fungola`.
x25519.h3_a: Ed25519, HKDF, Courbe25519, Protocole ya signal

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket biloko ya kati ya ventilateur
websocketFanout.subtitle: Ndenge nini node moko epesaka événement moko na ba nkoto ya ba abonnés.
websocketFanout.what: WebSocket fan-out ezali ensemble Python-natif ya ba poignées ya abonné na chambre moko. Tango message moko e POST, dispatcher ya fan-out a iterer ensemble mpe a enqueuer cadre sérieux na queue ya envoi ya abonné moko na moko.
websocketFanout.why: Fan-out ekimi coût ya N-copie ya émission : déchiffrement moko na côté ya motindi, cadre moko sérieux, N poussée ya molongo ya kotinda. Poussée moko na moko ezali O(1); motuya ya kopi epusami na noyau na tango ya `send()` na nzela ya ba tampons ya kopi zéro tango OS esungaka yango.
websocketFanout.where: Esalemi na `app/chats/fanout.py`. `FanoutRegistry` ya nivo ya likolo esimbaka `dict[id_room, set[WebSocket]]`. Ba écrites ya registre e gardé na `asyncio.Lock`; ba reads ezali ba snapshots sans lock.
websocketFanout.how: Na message POST routeur ebengi `zela fanout.broadcast(id_ya_chambre, ba octets_ya_charge utile)`. Méthode ezo copier ensemble na se ya blocage, ebimisaka, sima ezo iterer copie oyo ezali kozela `ws.send_bytes(payload)` na 1-second timeout par socket. Ba sockets oyo esili na temps e marqué mabe mpe e purgé.
websocketFanout.when: Message nionso, réaction, botangi-reçu, indicateur ya type, signal ya appel, mpe rotation ya touche ya chambre ezoleka na ventilateur oyo kaka. Bonene ya cadre ezali na ndelo na 64 KiB; ba charges utile ya minene eboyamaka mpe ezongisamaka na moto oyo abengi na nzela ya HTTP.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` — na abonné moko atinda bozindo ya molongo. Overflow ekitisaka cadre ya kala koleka.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — ndelo ya likolo na `kotinda_bytes`. Koleka e marquer socket mabe.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` — eboyi fan-out na ba chambre ya minene koleka oyo. Ba chambre minene esalelaka mode ya canal na modèle ya kobenda na esika na yango.
websocketFanout.fail1: Consommateur malembe — molongo ya socket moko e déborde. Ba cadres ya kala mingi ekweaki. Client azuaka via `banda` na reconnect.
websocketFanout.fail2: Socket ekufa — `send_bytes` etomboli `ConnexionEkangama`. Dispatcher alongoli na set mpe azali kokende liboso.
websocketFanout.fail3: Bursty producteur — soki producteur azali > 5× mbangu koleka bande passante ya consommateur agrégé, pression ya sima ekoti na nzela ya `zela` ko suspendre motindi.
websocketFanout.fail4: Memory blow-up — molongo ya abonné moko na capped na 256 cadres; na 64 KiB moko na moko yango ezali 16 MiB max par consommateur lente. Consommateur oyo akimaki akozua déconnecté na chèque ya liveness avant abeta plafond wana.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus gauge `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{sambre,mosaleli}` — bozindo ya molongo ya socket moko.
websocketFanout.mon2: Compteur `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — ba cadres oyo ebwaki na raison (débordement, temps d'exploit, ekangami).
websocketFanout.tune1: Tombolá `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` mpo na ba clients na ba réseaux ya malembe kasi ya stable.
websocketFanout.tune2: Kitisa `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS` na ba clusters ya matata ya likolo esika ba sockets ya malembe ezo boma basusu nzala.
websocketFanout.tune3: Kabola ba chambre minene na ba sous-shambre to changer yango na mode chaîne na ba mises à jour basées na pull.
websocketFanout.edge1: Ba événements ya rotation ya chambre (`type:"k"`) etindamaka na 2 s timeout na esika ya 1 s mpo ba clients basengeli ko re-importer ba clés avant ya kondima ba messages mingi.
websocketFanout.edge2: Makambo ya kokoma emekami lisusu te — kobungisa "mosaleli atiki kokoma" ezali na likama te.
websocketFanout.edge3: Ba mises à jour ya présence esalemi na lote : ba flips ya présence ya usager ebele na fenêtre moko ya 250 ms esangisi na cadre moko.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 esalelami na shambre moko `asyncio.Queue`s — ezwaki esika na v0.0.5 na motindo ya kokanga-kopi-iterate mpo na nse na nsango moko CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Future: tango Redis ekozala disponible, fan-out eko préférer pub/sub donc ba clusters multi-noeux e reproduire ba événements sans fan-out ya maille.
websocketFanout.ts1: Taux ya chute ya likolo : vérifier réseau na consommateur ya malembe; bonene ya molongo ya bump; koluka koyeba bizaleli ya ba clients.
websocketFanout.ts2: Bolai ya kotinda ya likolo: mbala mosusu TLS renegociation oyo ezali kosalama to NAT ya traversal timeout; tala ba journal ya noyau pona ba retransmissions ya TCP.
websocketFanout.ts3: Creep ya mémoire: kotala `vortex_fanout_queue_depth` na mosaleli moko; kotya elembo na mosaleli nyonso oyo azali na bozindo oyo eumelaka > 200 lokola client oyo ekoki kozala malembe to ya mabe.
websocketFanout.faq1: Q: Nini esalemaka soki client azangi ba cadres na tango ya déconnexion? R: Ezali ko reconnecter na `since=<last_seen_id>` mpe serveur ezo replayer depuis DB. Fan-out ezali milende ya malamu koleka na ntango ya solosolo; durability efandaka na DB.
websocketFanout.faq2: Q: Abonné ya mabe akoki ko ralentir fan-out? R: Bakitisaka molongo na bango moko, oyo etondisaka, ebwakaka ba cadres, mpe ekataka yango. Interférence croisée ya ba abonnés te.
websocketFanout.faq3: Q: Ndenge nini nakoki ko déboguer livraison ya usager moko spécifique? R: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` ebwakaka bozindo ya molongo na bango, elembo ya ntango ya kotinda ya nsuka, mpe ekiti ya sika.

nonceManagement.title: Nonce gestion
nonceManagement.subtitle: Ndenge nini Vortex ebatelaka AES-GCM nonces unique na kati ya ba appareils, ba chambres, mpe ba reboots.
nonceManagement.what: Opération nionso ya AES-GCM ezuaka nonce ya 12 octets oyo MUST ezala unique pona clé moko donnée. Kozongela kosalela nonce na fungola moko ebebisaka sekele mpe bosolo — mobundi oyo azali na ba chiffres mibale na nse ya moko (fungola, nonce) akoki kozongisa makomi ya polele XOR.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex ebimisaka fungola moko ya shambre mpe esalela yango mpo na bankóto ya bansango. Nonce moko oyo ekómi na likama na kati ya bamesaje mibale ekobimisa makomi ya pɛtɛɛ. Ba nonces nionso yango wana esalemi na OS CSPRNG na 96 bits — région ya anniversaire-bound-safe ezali soki 2^32 messages par clé, mosika koleka clé moko nionso eko chiffrer.
nonceManagement.where: Nkola ya nonce na ngambo ya client efandaka na `VortexCrypto` (iOS), module `crypto/aead` (Android), `app.security.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node). Node yango esalaka pe vérification défensive duplicate-nonce.
nonceManagement.how: Etape na etape : client abimisaka 12 octets aléatoires, alekisaka na AES-GCM chiffrer, a cadrer texte chiffre lokola `{ciphertext, nonce}` mpe ba POSTs. Node ekomaka `(room_id, nonce)` na cache ya kati ya mémoire LRU oyo ezali na bonene ya 10^6 entrées. Na POST, node e vérifier cache — double ⇒ 400 `doublon_nonce`. Sous usage normal oyo jamais ezo tirer (P(collision) na 10^9 messages eza ~10^-19).
nonceManagement.when: Na kotinda nyonso. Côté ya récepteur: vérification ya nonce te — tag ya AES-GCM esimbaka intégrité. Soki nonce moko na ndenge moko to mosusu ezongelami, déchiffrement ya mibale elingaki kaka kolonga kasi sekele ekozala na likama.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — motango ya ba nonces ya sika oyo elandami na node moko.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — ba entrées ya kala elongolami sima ya 24 h (ba touches mingi ebalukaka na ba heures ata ndenge nini).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG échec na client — très improbable na OS-epesameli CSPRNG. Tozongaka lisusu te na ba RNG oyo ezali cryptographique te.
nonceManagement.fail2: Cache miss na restart ya node — endimami mpo cache ezali défence-en-depth; ba clients jamais ba réutiliser légitimement ba nonces po miss efungola fenêtre ya attaque te.
nonceManagement.mon2: Jauge `vortex_nonce_cache_size` — esengeli kozala stable nzinganzinga ya cache cap.
nonceManagement.tune1: Ba chambre minene: komatisaka taille ya cache pona ko couvrir ba fenêtres ya rotation ya milayi.
nonceManagement.tune2: Ba clusters ya ba noeuds ebele : kokabola cache na nzela ya Redis tango ezali.
nonceManagement.edge1: Client hors connexion ko re-connecter na ba messages oyo ezali na molongo : message moko na moko oyo ezali na molongo ememaka nonce na yango moko ya pamba pamba. Coordination esengelaki te.
nonceManagement.edge2: Envoyer multi-appareil : ba dispositifs nionso mibale ebimisaka ba nonces aléatoires indépendantes. P(collision) na 2 dispositifs × 10^4 messages = négligeable.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 esalelaki na mokuse ba nonces oyo esalemi na ba contre-basées seeded na id ya dispositif — elongolamaki sima ya papier moko elakisaki ba collisions croisées ya dispositif na se ya clock-skew. Random-96 ezali sikoyo nzela se moko oyo epambolami.
nonceManagement.ts1: Tala ba rejections ya `duplicate_nonce`: tala client pona buggy RNG; vérifier source ya entropie ya dispositif.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: vérifier taille ya cache contre taux ya kokoma ya chambre; soit kotombola taille to kokitisa TTL.
nonceManagement.faq1: Q: Est-ce que soki ba clients mibale bazui nonce moko par hasard? R: Na 96 bits ya randomness, kozela collision ya liboso na kati ya basaleli banso ezali na ~2^48 messages — mingi bomoi ya Vortex bosaleli. Soki mokolo mosusu esalemaki, node ekoboya oyo ya mibale.
nonceManagement.faq2: Q: Pourquoi 96 bits et non 128? R: bolai ya nonce standard ya AES-GCM. 96 bits ebombaka pe 4 octets na message moko.

keyRotation.title: Rotation ya ba clés
keyRotation.subtitle: Ntango nini mpe ndenge nini bafungola ya esika, ya aparɛyi mpe ya kobimisa ebalukaka.
keyRotation.what: Fungola nyonso oyo eumelaka mingi na Vortex ebalukaka na programɛ moko to na déclencheur. Bafungola ya chambre ebalukaka na changement ya membres to périodiquement (poso na poso). Ba touches ya dispositif ebalukaka na choix ya usager. Ba touches ya liberation ebalukaka tango ba suspecter compromis.
keyRotation.why: Rotation e limitaka rayon ya explosion ya compromis. Clé ya chambre oyo bayibaki lobi etiki ko déchiffrer ba messages ya lelo. Fungola ya kobimisama oyo bayibaki ya 2024 etiki kopesa litatoli ya kobimisama ya 2026.
keyRotation.where: `app/keys/` ezali na logique ya rotation côté serveur. Côté client: `ios/.../Bafungola/impl/Mopesi ya fungola ya ndako.swift`, `android/.../bafungola/impl/Mopesi ya fungola ya ndako.kt`.
keyRotation.how: Rotation ya chambre: admin nionso akoki ko déclencher; rotation ordinaire na conge ezalaka automatique. Rotateur ezuaka misisa ya sika ya 32 octets, ezongeli enveloppe na ba membres oyo batikali, ezo poster `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` na ba enveloppes ya sika. Node ezo mettre à jour atomiquement `room_keys` pe ezo diffuser `{type:"k"}`.
keyRotation.when: Chambre: na conge, na déclencheur ya admin, chaque 7 jours automatiquement. Dispositif: chaque 90 jours par défaut (configurable). Bobimisi: ad-hoc na compromis oyo ba suspecter.
keyRotation.cfg2: `DEVICE_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS=90` — bobaluki ya liboso ya dispositif moko.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=solo` — boma mpo na koleka rotation na conge (ekitisaka bokengi mpo na CPU ya nse).
keyRotation.fail1: Client hors ligne na tango ya rotation: azuaka connection oyo elandi. Node ebombaka 5 rotations ya suka donc ba reconnexions balukaka toujours enveloppe na bango.
keyRotation.fail2: Race ya minting ya enveloppe : ba administrateurs mibale ba roter en même temps. Node endimi oyo ya liboso mpe ezongisaka 409 Conflict na ya mibale.
keyRotation.tune1: Ba chambre publiques na > 1000 membres: changer na Variant-B key publish. Rotation na conge ekomi no-op; ba membres ba confier signature ya pubkey oyo ba poster.
keyRotation.tune2: Ba salles oyo etali tango (e.g. ba chaînes ya source ya journalisme): cadence ya rotation ya mokuse (mokolo na mokolo to na ngonga).
keyRotation.edge1: Salle ya membre unique après que basusu nionso bakende: rotation ezali na tina te mais encore déclenché pona consistance; membre lone azui enveloppe ya sika pona bango moko.
keyRotation.edge2: Nkolo atiki : propriété e transférer na admin oyo a joindre longtemps; enveloppe ya kala ya nkolo elongolami.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 ebalukaki kaka na conge. v0.2 ebakisi rotation périodique contrôlée na `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS`.
keyRotation.ts1: Ba clients bakangamaki na déchiffrement: vérifier tableau ya enveloppe; assurer que événement ya rotation ezala diffusé.
keyRotation.ts2: Ba échecs ya rotation : mingi mingi réseau na membre moko ya malembe. Meka lisusu motango oyo ekɔtisami na nzela ya audit.
keyRotation.faq1: Q: Rotation ezo encrypter ba messages ya kala? R: Te. Texte chiffre ya kala etikalaka na nse ya fungola ya kala; ba clients ba bomba ba clés ya kala na cache local na bango pona déchiffrement historique.
keyRotation.faq2: Q: Ezali boni soki mosaleli moko akoti mpe abimi nokinoki mbala 100? R: Mosala moko na moko ebalukaka. Na ba chambre ya minene oyo ezali cher — to rate-limit ba événements ya membres na 1/min par usager.

rateLimiting.title: Kopekisa ba taux
rateLimiting.subtitle: Na- IP, na mosaleli moko, na nzela moko na ndelo ya token-bucket.
rateLimiting.what: Ba limite ya taux ezali défense ya liboso contre abuse en masse : login brute-force, inondation ya enregistrement, spam ya message, exhaustion ya upload ya fichier.
rateLimiting.why: Kozanga ndelo, abuser nionso oyo azali authentiqué akokaki ko échapper disque, ko saturer fan-out, to brute-force ya 2FA ya 4 chiffres. Ba limite ezali ya talo moke (~10 ns par chèque) mpe ebongoli ba attaques autrement-triviales na oyo ya talo.
rateLimiting.where: `app/security/limits.py` esimbaka ndelo. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` ezali enveloppe mince mpo na ba routes ya auth.
rateLimiting.how: Algorithme ya token-seau na (porte, clé). Ba recharges ya seau na taux R, capacité C. Demande ezuaka 1 jeton. Seau ya pamba ⇒ 429. Bobombi ya tracker: dict na kati ya mémoire na noeud moko; Redis tango `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Bosengi nionso na nzela ya WAF middleware. Salta liste pona ba biens statiques na ba vérifications ya santé.
rateLimiting.cfg3: `MSG_RATE_PER_USER=30` na miniti moko na mosaleli moko.
rateLimiting.cfg4: `FILE_UPLOAD_RATE=10` na miniti moko na mosaleli moko.
rateLimiting.fail1: Mosaleli oyo azali na mibeko nsima ya kokabola NAT (biro, eteyelo) abeti na ndelo moko na moko — mosaleli oyo azali kotala 429 na nsango ya bonkonde.
rateLimiting.fail2: Memoire blow-up na explosion munene — capped na 100k ba clés distinctes; LRU kobengana bato.
rateLimiting.mon2: Histogramme `vortex_rate_limit_check_duration_seconds` — esengeli kotikala na se ya 100 μs.
rateLimiting.tune1: Nsima ya CDN oyo ezali kolongolaka IP ya solo: tia `TRUSTED_PROXIES` mpo totanga `X-Forwarded-For`. Soki te trafic nionso ebeti limite na se ya sortie ya CDN IP.
rateLimiting.tune2: Ba bots ya volume ya likolo: pesa fungola API na `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000`.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: tozali kopekisa na /64 na esika ya na adresse moko mpo na kopesa compte ya ba allocations ya minene ya ISP.
rateLimiting.edge2: Bibimi ya Tor: tosalelaka ndelo ya kokangama (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) mpo na koboya kopesa etumbu na basaleli ya Tor na kobima ya kokabola.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 esalelaki `slowapi` na decorator-per-route — elongolamaki na v0.0.5 mpo na middleware centralisé.
rateLimiting.ts1: False-positive 429: vérifier config ya proxy ya confiance, vérifier ba setups shared-NAT, bump scope limit soki trafic légitime ezali kobeta yango.
rateLimiting.ts2: Bypassed: kotala ba journals ya accès pona ba abuse IP; bakisa na `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var mpo na bloc ya makasi.
rateLimiting.faq1: Q: Ba ndelo ezali kokabolama na kati ya ba noeuds? R: Na mode ya node moko, ba limite ezali par-node. Na Redis, ndelo ezali ya mokili mobimba na kati ya cluster.
rateLimiting.faq2: Q: Ndenge nini nakoki kopesa mingi mpo na ngai moko? R: Ba usagers authentiqués bakoki kosenga quota ya likolo na nzela ya `/api/admin/quota`. Ba administrateurs ba ndimaka cas par cas.

emojiCatalog.title: Catalogue ya emoji
emojiCatalog.subtitle: Ensemble ya ba données ya 1500-emoji ekabolamaki na ba clients nionso.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex etindi ensemble na yango moko ya emoji na esika ya kotia motema na disponibilité ya version Unicode. 1500 emojis ebongisami na 9 catégories (smileys, bato, banyama, bilei, mobembo, misala, biloko, bilembo, drapeaux). Ndenge moko JSON oyo esalelamaka na iOS (`Emoji/Makoki/emoji.json`), Android (`android/app/src/principal/assets/emoji.json`), mpe client web (`statique/assets/emoji.json`).
emojiCatalog.why: Consistance: usager oyo azali kotinda 🥹 na iOS 17 il faut a rendre lokola 🥹 na Android 9. Emoji ya système natif e diverger na ba versions OS par 1-3 ans, yango wana to envoyer ya biso moko pona ko garder cartographie stable.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON ebongiseli: `{catégorie: [emoji_char, ...]}`. Ba clients ba charger na démarrage, ba plat na index ya recherche, pe ba render na nzela ya grille LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS.
emojiCatalog.when: Na app start mpe tango nionso usager afungola picker. MRU liste ezali kowumela na UserDefaults / SharedPreferences / localStorage.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Cap ya sika: 30 na iOS, 30 na Android, 20 na web.
emojiCatalog.cfg2: Ba catégories ebongisami na ordre — reordering ebukaka layout ya picker.
emojiCatalog.fail1: OS ya mosaleli ekoki kosala emoji te: ekweyi lisusu na glyphe `?`. Toponaka ba points de code na Unicode ≤ 15.0 oyo OS nionso ya mikolo oyo esimbaka.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Ba paquets emoji personnalisés: basaleli bakoki ko installer ba paquets ya stickers oyo ezo comporter ndenge moko mais ezo rendre ba images raster.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Variantes ya ton ya loposo: catalogue na biso ebombaka kaka ba emojis ya base; ba variantes ezali composées côté client via ba séquences ZWJ.

appStoreDistribution.what: appStoreDistribution ezali sous-système Vortex. Ezali ko participer na protocole ya messenger ya suka na suka mpe ezali documenté pembeni ya ba sous-systèmes mosusu na référence oyo.
appStoreDistribution.why: Sous-système ezali mpo protocole ezali na slot bien défini mpo na yango. Kolongola yango ekotika esika ya mosala oyo basaleli batyelaka motema.
appStoreDistribution.where: Tala nzete ya Vortex ya source. Convention ya kopesa kombo ezali `app/<feature>/` na node, `static/js/<feature>/` na client web, `ios/Modules/Sources/<Feature>/` na iOS, `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/<feature>/` na Android.
appStoreDistribution.how: Ba clients ba invoquer sous-système na nzela ya surface na yango API; ba routes ya node, ebombaka, mpe e ventilateur libanda ndenge esengeli. Ba détails ya mise en œuvre efandaka na README ya module esika ezali.
appStoreDistribution.when: Tango nionso appStoreDistribution ezali na tina — tala code pona ba sites ya invocation.
appStoreDistribution.cfg1: Configuration par défaut esalaka pona cas commun.
appStoreDistribution.cfg2: Drapeau ya fonctionnalité ezali na `.env.example` — luka `APPSTOREDISTRIBUTION_ENABLED`.
appStoreDistribution.cfg3: Ba boutons ya tuning oyo ekomamaki na README ya module.
appStoreDistribution.fail1: Service dégradé au lieu ya échec makasi.
appStoreDistribution.fail2: Bobakisi ya ba metrics; ekebisi moto soki seuil eleki.
appStoreDistribution.fail3: Ba retries ezali na ndelo; ba boucles oyo ezangi nsuka te.
appStoreDistribution.mon3: Kota na INFO mpo na banzela oyo elongi, WARN mpo na mabunga oyo ekoki kozongisama.
appStoreDistribution.tune2: Tala ba metrics na boumeli ya poso moko yambo ya kobongola.
appStoreDistribution.tune3: Kokoma ntina ya mbongwana nyonso ya tuning.
appStoreDistribution.edge1: Asimbaka ba cas ya bord oyo ezelamaki na spec ya protocole.
appStoreDistribution.edge2: Ba cas ya bord oyo eyebani te e enregistrer pona revue ya opérateur.
appStoreDistribution.mig1: Révision alémbique etali mbongwana nyonso ya schéma.
appStoreDistribution.mig2: Rollback esungami mpo na version moko ya moke.
appStoreDistribution.ts2: Filtrer ba journals na id ya corrélation.
appStoreDistribution.ts3: Tala eteni ya README ya kosilisa mikakatano ya module.
appStoreDistribution.faq1: Q: Est-ce que fonctionnalité oyo ezali stable? R: Ee, version mineure stable. Ba versions ya minene ekoki kobuka compatibilité.
appStoreDistribution.faq2: Q: Nakoki ko désactiver yango? R: Ee na nzela ya drapeau ya fonctionnalité.
appStoreDistribution.faq3: Q: Ezali activé par défaut? R: Etali; vérifier `.env.ndakisa`.

intro.p1: Architex ezali monoko ya déclaratif UI oyo etongami mpo na Vortex Mini Apps. Na esika ya kokoma JavaScript oyo ebongoli DOM, olimboli écran oyo olingi mpe tango ya kosala ebatelaka ba pixels na synchronisation na état automatiquement.
intro.p2: monoko ezali moke : ba déclarations minei (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), préfixe moko mpo na ba variables réactives (~), mpe chaîne moko ya opérateur mpo na styling (::).
intro.p3: Soki osilá kokoma HTML + CSS + JS, Architex ekomiyoka ete oyebi malamu kasi na 10× moins de chaudière. Soki osali yango te, Architex ezali pe introduction doux na programmation réactif po langue eza muke mingi okoki kosimba yango nionso na mutu.
intro.p4: Eteni mokomoko ya référence oyo etongami likoló na oyo ya liboso. Sauter na kati esika nionso olingi soki oyebi déjà cadre déclaratif UI mosusu; tanga likolo tii na nse soki ozali kobanda sika.
intro.li1: Declaratif — kolimbola lolenge ya UI, kasi matambe ya kotonga yango te
intro.li2: Reactive — devoir moko ezo mettre à jour étiquette, classe, to noeud nionso oyo etali yango
intro.li3: Portable — .arx ndenge moko esalemaka na ba hôtes web, iOS, mpe Android
intro.li4: Tiny — parser + renderer masuwa na se ya 30 KB gzipped
intro.ct1: Architex ezali ya domaine spécifique. Ekozwa esika ya monoko ya ntina mingi te — kasi mpo na kotinda écran na kati ya lisolo ezali mbangu koleka cadre nyonso oyo tomekaki.
intro.ct2: Construction nionso na langue ezo carte na primitif moko ya temps d'exécution. Eza na magie moko te oyo okoki ko expliquer te.

syntax.p1: Programme nionso ya Architex etongami na ba déclarations minei ya niveau ya likolo : @screen, @theme, @import, @component, bakisa nzoto ya boucle @for. Moko na moko ebandi na colonne 0; nionso oyo ekɔtisami na nse ezali ya bloc wana.
syntax.p2: Ba variables réactives ekomami ~name — préfixe tilde e marquer yango lokola ba cellules suivi. Tanga na ~name, pesa na =, sala calcul na :=.
syntax.p3: Ba composants ezali ba identifiants ya pamba na ligne na bango moko : text, button, image, col, row, pe bongo na bongo. Argument positionnelle na bango eyaka mbala moko sima ya : text ~message, button "Save".
syntax.p4: Ba modificateurs ba attache sima ya ::. Okoki ko chaîner ebele ndenge olingi: :: pad(24) gap(16) center color(#4f8ef7) bold size(20).
syntax.p5: Misala e vivre sima ya =>. Mosala moko na flèche moko; monyololo ya ba flèches ebele: button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false.

syntax.td8: Bloc ya ba jetons ya thème — ba couleurs, ba rayons, ba taille.

syntax.td10: Limbola composante oyo ekoki kosalelama lisusu na ba paramètres oyo ezali na kombo.

variables.h2: Ba variables oyo esalemi na calcul
variables.p1: Variable réactive esimbaka valeur moko mpe eyebisaka automatiquement mutu nionso oyo akotanga yango tango okomi valeur ya sika. Kosakola na =, kozongisa na =, kosala mise à jour na += / -= / *= / /=.
variables.p2: Ba variables calculées ezuaka valeur na yango na expression oyo ezo évaluer lisusu tango nionso entrée nionso ebongwanaka. Sakola na := na esika ya =. Ba abonnés manuels te, ba bugs ya valeur stale te.
variables.p3: Annoter type na : Type sima ya kombo. Mitindo oyo esungami: number, string, boolean, array, object. Ba annotations ezali optionnel; lolenge yango ezwami na motuya ya ebandeli.
variables.p4: Salelá lowerCamelCase to nyoka_case; Architex pe ezo enforcer te. Bomba bankombo mokuse: écran oyo ezali na ebele ya bankombo milai ebebisaka indentation.
variables.p5: Portée : variable réactive oyo esakolami na kati ya @screen emonanaka kaka na kati ya nzoto ya écran wana. @theme ba jetons ezali komonana na mokili mobimba.
variables.p6: Cycle de vie: état e vivre tant que écran e monté. Kotambola na masuwa mosika ebebisaka yango; kozonga sima ezongisaka yango na valeur ya ebandeli.
variables.p7: Persistance: mpo na koleka écran, benga send(action: "save", data: ~state) mpe tika hôte ya bot a persister.
variables.cc4: ~total := ~count * ~step // calculé — ezongaka lisusu tango moko to mosusu ebongwanaka
variables.cc5: ~mbote := "Mbote, {~kombo}!"  // esalemi na nzela ya molongo ya modèle
variables.li1: Esengeli kobanda na ~ mpo na ba cellules réactives.
variables.li2: Sima ya ~, ba lettres, ba chiffres, ba soulignements : ~user_count, ~page2.
variables.li4: Ba mots clés (on, in, if) ebombami ata sima ya ~.
